        if not e then return 0 end
        local base = e.Generation
        if not base then local mod = (okG and _G_ and _G_.Game and _G_.Game.AnimalGanerationModifier) or 0 base = (e.Price or 0) * mod end

local function _jafParsePSInput(input) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE), ERROR_HANDLING(false))
    if type(input) ~= "string" then return nil end
    input = input:gsub("%s+", "")
    if input == "" then return nil end
    local placeId = tonumber(input:match("/games/(%d+)"))
    local direct = input:match("[?&]privateServerLinkCode=([%w%-_]+)") or input:match("[?&]linkCode=([%w%-_]+)")
    if direct then return direct, placeId, false end
    if input:match("[?&]code=([%w%-_]+)") then return nil, placeId, true end
    if input:match("^[%w%-_]+$") then
        local looksShare = (#input == 32) and (input:match("^[0-9a-f]+$") ~= nil)
        if looksShare then return nil, placeId, true end
        return input, placeId, false
    end
    return nil
end
_G.JAF_ParsePSInput = _jafParsePSInput
_G.JAF_TeleportToPrivateServer = function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE), ERROR_HANDLING(false))
    local linkCode, placeId, shareWarn = _jafParsePSInput(Config.PrivateServerCode)
    if shareWarn then return false, "that's a SHARE code, not a linkCode" end
    if not linkCode then return false, "no valid private-server link code saved" end
    placeId = placeId or game.PlaceId
    local ok = pcall(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE), ERROR_HANDLING(false))
        game:GetService("ExperienceService"):LaunchExperience({ placeId = placeId, linkCode = linkCode })
    end)
    if ok then return true end
    local ok2, err = pcall(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE), ERROR_HANDLING(false))
        TeleportService:TeleportToPrivateServer(placeId, linkCode, { LocalPlayer })
    end)
    if ok2 then return true end
    return false, tostring(err)
end
_G.JAF_KickToPrivateServer = function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE), ERROR_HANDLING(false)) return _G.JAF_TeleportToPrivateServer() end
local function triggerClosestUnlock(yLevel, maxY) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE), ERROR_HANDLING(false))
    if not SAB_LIVE() then return end
    local character = LocalPlayer.Character
    local hrp = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not hrp then return end
    local playerY = yLevel or hrp.Position.Y
    local Y_THRESHOLD = 5
    local bestPromptSameLevel = nil
    local shortestDistSameLevel = math.huge
    local bestPromptFallback = nil
    local shortestDistFallback = math.huge
    local plots = Workspace:FindFirstChild("Plots")
    if not plots then return end
    local hrpPos = hrp.Position
    for _, obj in ipairs(plots:GetDescendants()) do
        if obj:IsA("ProximityPrompt") and obj.Enabled then
            local part = obj.Parent
            if part and part:IsA("BasePart") then
                local partPos = part.Position
                if maxY and partPos.Y > maxY then
                else
                    local distance = (hrpPos - partPos).Magnitude
                    local yDifference = math.abs(playerY - partPos.Y)
                    if distance < shortestDistFallback then shortestDistFallback = distance bestPromptFallback = obj end
                    if yDifference <= Y_THRESHOLD then
                        if distance < shortestDistSameLevel then shortestDistSameLevel = distance bestPromptSameLevel = obj end
                    end end end end end
    local targetPrompt = bestPromptSameLevel or bestPromptFallback
    if targetPrompt then
        if fireproximityprompt then
            fireproximityprompt(targetPrompt)
        else
            targetPrompt:InputBegan(Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1)
            task.wait(0.05)
            targetPrompt:InputEnded(Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1)
        end end end

function buildCustomThemeFromColor(accent) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE), ERROR_HANDLING(false))
    if typeof(accent) ~= "Color3" then return false end
    local r, g, b = accent.R * 255, accent.G * 255, accent.B * 255
    local function toward(c, t, amt) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(ERROR_HANDLING(false))
return c + (t - c) * amt end
    local hex = tostring(Config.CustomThemeHex or "FFC800"):gsub("#", ""):gsub("%s", "")
    local cr = tonumber(hex:sub(1, 2), 16) or 255
    local cg = tonumber(hex:sub(3, 4), 16) or 200
    local cb = tonumber(hex:sub(5, 6), 16) or 0
    local clum = 0.299 * cr + 0.587 * cg + 0.114 * cb
    if clum < 120 then
        local lift = (120 - clum) / 120 * 0.7
        cr, cg, cb = toward(cr, 150, lift), toward(cg, 150, lift), toward(cb, 160, lift)
    end
    cr, cg, cb = math.clamp(cr, 0, 255), math.clamp(cg, 0, 255), math.clamp(cb, 0, 255)
    local accentBright = Color3.fromRGB(cr, cg, cb)
    local accent2 = Color3.fromRGB(math.floor(cr * 0.72), math.floor(cg * 0.72), math.floor(cb * 0.72))
    local function tint(f) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(ERROR_HANDLING(false))
return Color3.fromRGB(
        math.clamp(math.floor(r * f) + 6, 0, 255),
        math.clamp(math.floor(g * f) + 4, 0, 255),
        math.clamp(math.floor(b * f) + 10, 0, 255)) end
    THEMES.custom = {
        Background       = tint(0.06),
        Surface          = tint(0.10),
        SurfaceHighlight = tint(0.20),
        Accent1          = accentBright,
        Accent2          = accent2,
        TextPrimary      = Color3.fromRGB(240, 240, 240),
        TextSecondary    = Color3.fromRGB(
            math.clamp(math.floor(170 + r * 0.28), 0, 255),
            math.clamp(math.floor(170 + g * 0.28), 0, 255),
            math.clamp(math.floor(180 + b * 0.24), 0, 255)),
        Success          = accentBright,
        Error            = Color3.fromRGB(210, 90, 90),
    }
    return true
end
function buildCustomThemeFromHex(hex) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE), ERROR_HANDLING(false))
    if type(hex) ~= "string" then return false end
    hex = hex:gsub("#", ""):gsub("%s", "")
    if #hex ~= 6 then return false end
    local r = tonumber(hex:sub(1, 2), 16)
    local g = tonumber(hex:sub(3, 4), 16)
    local b = tonumber(hex:sub(5, 6), 16)
    if not (r and g and b) then return false end
    return buildCustomThemeFromColor(Color3.fromRGB(r, g, b))
end
pcall(buildCustomThemeFromHex, Config.CustomThemeHex)

jafJpegAverageColor = function(data) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE), ERROR_HANDLING(false))
    if type(data) ~= "string" or #data < 4 then return nil, "not image data" end
    local byte = string.byte
    if byte(data, 1) ~= 0xFF or byte(data, 2) ~= 0xD8 then return nil, "not a JPEG" end
    local _dlen = #data
    local function u16(p) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(ERROR_HANDLING(false))
return byte(data, p) * 256 + byte(data, p + 1) end
    local _jrsh, _jband = bit32.rshift, bit32.band
    local quant = {}
    local huffDC, huffAC = {}, {}
    local comps = {}
    local restartInterval = 0
    local W, H = 0, 0
    local pos = 3
    local progressive = false
    local function buildHuff(counts, vals) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE), ERROR_HANDLING(false))
        local t, code, k = {}, 0, 1
        for L = 1, 16 do t[L] = {} for _ = 1, counts[L] do t[L][code] = vals[k]; k = k + 1; code = code + 1 end code = code * 2 end
        return t
    end
    while pos < _dlen do
        if byte(data, pos) ~= 0xFF then pos = pos + 1
        else
            while byte(data, pos) == 0xFF do pos = pos + 1 end
            local marker = byte(data, pos); pos = pos + 1
            if marker == 0xD9 then break
            elseif marker == 0xC0 or marker == 0xC1 or marker == 0xC2 then
                progressive = (marker == 0xC2)
                local len = u16(pos)
                H = u16(pos + 3); W = u16(pos + 5)
                local nf = byte(data, pos + 7)
                local p = pos + 8
                for i = 1, nf do
                    local samp = byte(data, p + 1)
                    comps[i] = { id = byte(data, p), h = _jrsh(samp, 4), v = _jband(samp, 15), tq = byte(data, p + 2) }
                    p = p + 3
                end
                pos = pos + len
            elseif marker == 0xC3 or (marker >= 0xC5 and marker <= 0xCF and marker ~= 0xC8) then
                return nil, "unsupported JPEG (marker " .. string.format("%02X", marker) .. ")"

                while p < endp do
                    local tcth = byte(data, p); p = p + 1
                    local counts, total = {}, 0
                    for i = 1, 16 do counts[i] = byte(data, p); total = total + counts[i]; p = p + 1 end
                    local vals = {}
                    for i = 1, total do vals[i] = byte(data, p); p = p + 1 end
                    local built = buildHuff(counts, vals)
                    if _jrsh(tcth, 4) == 0 then huffDC[_jband(tcth, 15)] = built else huffAC[_jband(tcth, 15)] = built end
                end
                pos = endp
            elseif marker == 0xDB then
                local endp = pos + u16(pos); local p = pos + 2
                while p < endp do
                    local pqtq = byte(data, p); p = p + 1
                    local pq, tbl = _jrsh(pqtq, 4), {}
                    for i = 1, 64 do if pq == 0 then tbl[i] = byte(data, p); p = p + 1 else tbl[i] = u16(p); p = p + 2 end end

            elseif marker == 0xDA then
                local ns = byte(data, pos + 2)
                local p = pos + 3
                local scan = {}
                for i = 1, ns do
                    local cs = byte(data, p); local tdta = byte(data, p + 1); p = p + 2
                    local td, ta = _jrsh(tdta, 4), _jband(tdta, 15)
                    for _, c in ipairs(comps) do
                        if c.id == cs then
                            c.dc = huffDC[td]; c.ac = huffAC[ta]
                            c.pred, c.sum, c.cnt = 0, 0, 0
                            scan[i] = c
                        end end end
                local Ss = byte(data, p); local Ah_Al = byte(data, p + 2)
                local Ah, Al = _jrsh(Ah_Al, 4), _jband(Ah_Al, 15)
                pos = p + 3
                if progressive and not (Ss == 0 and Ah == 0) then return nil, "progressive JPEG (DC scan not first)" end
                local alScale = 2 ^ Al
                local bitBuf, bitCnt = 0, 0
                local function nextBit() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE), ERROR_HANDLING(false))
                    if bitCnt == 0 then
                        if pos > _dlen then return 0 end
                        local b = byte(data, pos); pos = pos + 1
                        if b == 0xFF then local nb = byte(data, pos) if nb == 0x00 then pos = pos + 1 else pos = pos - 1; return 0 end end
                        bitBuf = b; bitCnt = 8
                    end
                    bitCnt = bitCnt - 1
                    return _jband(_jrsh(bitBuf, bitCnt), 1)
                end
                local function receive(s) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE), ERROR_HANDLING(false))
                    local v = 0
                    for _ = 1, s do v = v * 2 + nextBit() end
                    return v
                end
                local function extend(v, s) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE), ERROR_HANDLING(false))
                    if s == 0 then return 0 end
                    if v < 2 ^ (s - 1) then return v - 2 ^ s + 1 end
                    return v
                end
                local function huffDecode(tbl) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE), ERROR_HANDLING(false))
                    local code = 0
                    for L = 1, 16 do
                        code = code * 2 + nextBit()
                        local row = tbl[L]
                        if row then local val = row[code]; if val ~= nil then return val end end
                    end
                    return nil
                end
                local function decodeBlock(c) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE), ERROR_HANDLING(false))
                    local t = huffDecode(c.dc); if t == nil then return false end
                    c.pred = c.pred + extend(receive(t), t)

                    if progressive then return true end

                        local r, s = _jrsh(rs, 4), _jband(rs, 15)

                end
                local hmax, vmax = 1, 1
                for _, c in ipairs(comps) do hmax = math.max(hmax, c.h); vmax = math.max(vmax, c.v) end
                local total = math.ceil(W / (8 * hmax)) * math.ceil(H / (8 * vmax))
                local since = 0
                for m = 1, total do
                    for _, c in ipairs(scan) do for _ = 1, c.v do for _ = 1, c.h do decodeBlock(c) end end end
                    since = since + 1
                    if restartInterval > 0 and since == restartInterval and m < total then
                        since = 0; bitCnt = 0

    local function avgVal(c) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE), ERROR_HANDLING(false))
        if not c or c.cnt == 0 then return 128 end
        local qdc = (quant[c.tq] and quant[c.tq][1]) or 1
        return (c.sum / c.cnt) * qdc / 8 + 128
    end
    local function clamp(x) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(ERROR_HANDLING(false))
return math.max(0, math.min(255, math.floor(x + 0.5))) end
    if #comps == 0 then return nil, "no frame" end
    local Y = avgVal(comps[1])
    if #comps == 1 then local gg = clamp(Y); return gg, gg, gg end
    local Cb, Cr = avgVal(comps[2]), avgVal(comps[3])
    return clamp(Y + 1.402 * (Cr - 128)), clamp(Y - 0.344136 * (Cb - 128) - 0.714136 * (Cr - 128)), clamp(Y + 1.772 * (Cb - 128))
end
jafDownloadWebImage = function(url) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE), ERROR_HANDLING(false))
    if type(url) ~= "string" then return nil, "no image input" end
    _G.JAF_LastImageBytes = nil
    _G.JAF_GifUrl = nil
    local idNum = url:match("^%s*(%d+)%s*$") or url:match("rbxassetid://(%d+)") or url:match("rbxasset://(%d+)")
    if idNum then return "rbxassetid://" .. idNum end
    if isfile and isfile(url) then
        local asset = jafGetCustomAsset(url)
        if asset then if readfile then local okR, b = pcall(readfile, url); if okR then _G.JAF_LastImageBytes = b end end return asset end
        return nil, "found the file but executor has no getcustomasset"
    end
    if not writefile then return nil, "executor has no writefile" end
    local b64 = url:match("^data:image/[%w%+%.%-]*;base64,(.+)$")
    if b64 then
        b64 = b64:gsub("%s", "")
        local dec = (crypt and crypt.base64decode)
                 or (crypt and crypt.base64 and crypt.base64.decode)
                 or (syn and syn.crypt and syn.crypt.base64decode)
        if not dec then return nil, "executor has no base64 decoder" end
        local okD, bin = pcall(dec, b64)
        if not okD or type(bin) ~= "string" or #bin < 64 then return nil, "base64 decode failed/empty" end
        _G.JAF_LastImageBytes = bin
        local ext = (url:match("^data:image/([%w]+)") or "png"):lower()
        if ext == "jpeg" then ext = "jpg" end
        if ext ~= "png" and ext ~= "jpg" and ext ~= "tga" and ext ~= "bmp" then ext = "png" end
        local fname = jafEnsureMediaDir() .. "/SneizzyThemeBG." .. ext
        if not pcall(writefile, fname, bin) then return nil, "writefile failed" end
        local asset = jafGetCustomAsset(fname)
        if asset then return asset end
        return nil, "executor has no getcustomasset"
    end
    if not url:match("^https?://") then return nil, "paste a direct http(s) image link, a data:image base64 string, or an asset id" end
    local mediaUrl = url
    local host = url:match("^https?://([^/]+)") or ""
    if host:find("tenor%.com") then
        local page = jafHttpRequest(url)
        if page then
            local og = page:match('property="og:image"[^>]-content="([^"]+)"') or page:match('content="([^"]+)"[^>]-property="og:image"')
            if og then mediaUrl = (og:gsub("\\u002[fF]", "/")) end
        end end
    local hostPath = mediaUrl:gsub("^https?://", "")
    if mediaUrl:lower():find("%.gif") then _G.JAF_GifUrl = mediaUrl end
    local function urlEnc(s) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(ERROR_HANDLING(false))
return (s:gsub("[^%w%-%._~/]", function(ch) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(ERROR_HANDLING(false))
return string.format("%%%02X", string.byte(ch)) end)) end
    local function imgExt(b) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE), ERROR_HANDLING(false))
        if type(b) ~= "string" or #b < 64 then return nil end
        local a, c = b:byte(1), b:byte(2)
        if a == 0x89 and c == 0x50 then return "png" end
        if a == 0xFF and c == 0xD8 then return "jpg" end
        return nil
    end
    local candidates = {
        "https://images.weserv.nl/?url=" .. urlEnc(hostPath) .. "&w=512&output=png",
        "https://i0.wp.com/" .. hostPath .. "?w=512",
        mediaUrl,
    }
    local lastReason = "couldn't fetch/convert that image link"
    for _, u in ipairs(candidates) do
        local body = jafHttpRequest(u)
        local ext = imgExt(body)
        if ext then
            _G.JAF_LastImageBytes = body
            local fname = jafEnsureMediaDir() .. "/SneizzyThemeBG." .. ext
            if not pcall(writefile, fname, body) then return nil, "writefile failed" end
            local asset = jafGetCustomAsset(fname)
            if asset then return asset end
            return nil, "executor has no getcustomasset"
        elseif body and #body > 0 then
            lastReason = "image host/proxy didn't return a usable image (it may be blocked)"
        end end
    return nil, lastReason
end
jafImageAverageColor = function(assetUri) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE), ERROR_HANDLING(false))
    local ok, col = pcall(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE), ERROR_HANDLING(false))
        local img
        local okA = pcall(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(ERROR_HANDLING(false))
img = AssetService:CreateEditableImageAsync(Content.fromUri(assetUri)) end)
        if not okA or not img then img = AssetService:CreateEditableImageAsync(assetUri) end
        if not img then return nil end
        local size = img.Size
        local getPix
        local pixels = 0
        local okBuf, buf = pcall(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(ERROR_HANDLING(false))
return img:ReadPixelsBuffer(Vector2.new(0, 0), size) end)
        if okBuf and buf and buffer and buffer.len and buffer.len(buf) >= 4 then
            pixels = math.floor(buffer.len(buf) / 4)
            getPix = function(idx0) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE), ERROR_HANDLING(false))
                local o = idx0 * 4
                return buffer.readu8(buf, o) / 255, buffer.readu8(buf, o + 1) / 255,
                       buffer.readu8(buf, o + 2) / 255, buffer.readu8(buf, o + 3) / 255
            end
        else
            local okPx, px = pcall(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(ERROR_HANDLING(false))
return img:ReadPixels(Vector2.new(0, 0), size) end)
            if not okPx or type(px) ~= "table" or #px < 4 then return nil end
            pixels = math.floor(#px / 4)
            getPix = function(idx0) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE), ERROR_HANDLING(false))
                local i = idx0 * 4 + 1
                return px[i], px[i + 1], px[i + 2], px[i + 3]
            end end
        if pixels <= 0 then return nil end
        local stride = math.max(1, math.floor(pixels / 1500))
        local r, g, b, n = 0, 0, 0, 0
        local rf, gf, bf, nf = 0, 0, 0, 0
        for p = 0, pixels - 1, stride do
            local pr, pg, pb, pa = getPix(p)
            pr = pr or 0; pg = pg or 0; pb = pb or 0
            rf = rf + pr; gf = gf + pg; bf = bf + pb; nf = nf + 1
            local sum = pr + pg + pb
            if (pa == nil or pa > 0.5) and sum > 0.15 and sum < 2.85 then
                r = r + pr; g = g + pg; b = b + pb; n = n + 1
            end end
        if n >= 8 then return Color3.new(r / n, g / n, b / n) end
        if nf > 0 then return Color3.new(rf / nf, gf / nf, bf / nf) end
        return nil
    end)
    if ok and col then return col end
    return nil
end

function _G.JAF_WaitHeavy() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE), ERROR_HANDLING(false))

function jafStopGifAnimation() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE), ERROR_HANDLING(false))

jafParseGifFrames = function(data) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE), ERROR_HANDLING(false))
    if type(data) ~= "string" or data:sub(1, 3) ~= "GIF" then return 0, {} end
    local byte = string.byte
    local p = 7
    local packed = byte(data, p + 4)
    p = p + 7
    if packed and packed >= 128 then p = p + 3 * (2 ^ ((packed % 8) + 1)) end
    local frames, delays, lastDelay = 0, {}, 0
    while p <= #data do
        local b = byte(data, p)
        if not b or b == 0x3B then break
        elseif b == 0x21 then
            local label = byte(data, p + 1); p = p + 2
            if label == 0xF9 then lastDelay = (byte(data, p + 2) or 0) + (byte(data, p + 3) or 0) * 256 end
            while true do local bs = byte(data, p); if not bs then break end; p = p + 1 + bs; if bs == 0 then break end end
        elseif b == 0x2C then
            frames = frames + 1
            delays[frames] = (lastDelay >= 2 and lastDelay or 10) / 100
            lastDelay = 0
            local lp = byte(data, p + 9); p = p + 10
            if lp and lp >= 128 then p = p + 3 * (2 ^ ((lp % 8) + 1)) end
            p = p + 1
            while true do local bs = byte(data, p); if not bs then break end; p = p + 1 + bs; if bs == 0 then break end end
        else break end
    end
    return frames, delays
end
local function jafStartGifLoop() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE), ERROR_HANDLING(false))

    conn = game:GetService("RunService").Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE), ERROR_HANDLING(false))
        if _G.JAF_GifToken ~= myToken then conn:Disconnect(); return end
        if _G.JAF_TpActive then return end

        local delays = _G.JAF_GifDelays
        if not frames or #frames < 1 then return end
        acc = acc + dt
        local need = (delays and delays[i]) or 0.08
        if acc < need then return end
        acc = acc - need
        if acc > 0.4 then acc = 0 end
        i = (i % #frames) + 1
        local asset = frames[i]
        _G.JAF_ThemeImageAsset = asset
        for _, gn in ipairs(JAF_GIF_ANIM_PANELS) do
            local sg = hubFind(gn)
            if sg then
                for _, fr in ipairs(sg:GetChildren()) do
                    if fr:IsA("Frame") then local bg = fr:FindFirstChild("JAFThemeBG") if bg then bg.Image = asset end end
                end end end end) end
jafSetupGifAnimation = function(gifUrl) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE), ERROR_HANDLING(false))
    if type(gifUrl) ~= "string" then return false end
    do local g = tick() while tick() - g < 16 do if game:IsLoaded() and _G.JAF_FirstLoadTpDone then break end task.wait(0.25) end end
    local req = (syn and syn.request) or (http and http.request) or http_request or request
    if not req then return false end
    local function get(u) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(ERROR_HANDLING(false))
local ok, r = pcall(req, { Url = u, Method = "GET" }); if ok and r then return r.Body or r.body end end
    local gif = get(gifUrl)
    if not gif or gif:sub(1, 3) ~= "GIF" then return false end
    local fcount, delays = jafParseGifFrames(gif)
    if fcount < 2 then return false end
    local CAP = 90
    local idxs = {}
    if fcount <= CAP then for i = 0, fcount - 1 do idxs[#idxs + 1] = i end
    else local step = fcount / CAP; for i = 0, CAP - 1 do idxs[#idxs + 1] = math.floor(i * step) end end
    local frameDelays = {}
    for j = 1, #idxs do
        local upper = idxs[j + 1] or fcount
        local d = 0
        for di = idxs[j] + 1, upper do d = d + (delays[di] or 0.1) end
        frameDelays[j] = math.max(d, 0.03)
    end
    local host = gifUrl:gsub("^https?://", "")
    local enc = (host:gsub("[^%w%-%._~/]", function(ch) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(ERROR_HANDLING(false))
return string.format("%%%02X", string.byte(ch)) end))
    jafEnsureMediaDir()
    local frames, done, nextK, active = {}, 0, 0, 0
    local CONC = 8
    local function pump() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(ERROR_HANDLING(false))
        while active < CONC and nextK < #idxs do
            nextK = nextK + 1; active = active + 1
            local k = nextK
            local pageIdx = idxs[k]
            task.spawn(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(ERROR_HANDLING(false))
                local body = get("https://images.weserv.nl/?url=" .. enc .. "&w=130&output=png&page=" .. pageIdx)
                if body and body:byte(1) == 0x89 then
                    local fn = JAF_MEDIA_DIR .. "/JAFgiff_" .. k .. ".png"
                    if pcall(writefile, fn, body) then frames[k] = jafGetCustomAsset(fn) end
                end
                active = active - 1; done = done + 1
                pump()
            end) end end
    pump()
    local function rebuild() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE), ERROR_HANDLING(false))
        local s, sd = {}, {}
        for k = 1, #idxs do if frames[k] then s[#s + 1] = frames[k]; sd[#sd + 1] = frameDelays[k] end end
        return s, sd
    end
    local t0 = tick()
    local timeout = math.max(20, #idxs * 0.7)
    while done < #idxs and tick() - t0 < timeout do task.wait(0.1) end
    local seq, seqD = rebuild()
    if #seq < 2 then return false end
    pcall(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(ERROR_HANDLING(false))
game:GetService("ContentProvider"):PreloadAsync(seq) end)
    _G.JAF_GifFrames = seq; _G.JAF_GifDelays = seqD
    jafStartGifLoop()
    return true
end
function jafApplyImageTheme(url) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE), ERROR_HANDLING(false))

    _G.JAF_ThemeImageAsset = asset
    local avg = jafImageAverageColor(asset)

    if not avg and _G.JAF_LastImageBytes and jafJpegAverageColor then
        local r, g, b = jafJpegAverageColor(_G.JAF_LastImageBytes)
        if r then avg = Color3.fromRGB(r, g, b) end
    end

        task.defer(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(ERROR_HANDLING(false))
pcall(jafApplyThemeImageToPanels, asset) end)
    else
        _G.JAF_ThemeImageAsset = nil
        task.defer(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(ERROR_HANDLING(false))
pcall(jafApplyThemeImageToPanels, nil) end)
    end
    if not avg then return false, "loaded the image but couldn't read its colour (try a smaller / non-corrupt image)" end
    buildCustomThemeFromColor(avg)
    if applyTheme then applyTheme("custom") end
    if displayable and _G.JAF_GifUrl and jafSetupGifAnimation and Config.GifAnimate ~= false then
        task.spawn(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(ERROR_HANDLING(false))
pcall(jafSetupGifAnimation, _G.JAF_GifUrl) end)
    end
    return true
end

applyTheme = function(themeName) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE), ERROR_HANDLING(false))
    local t = THEMES[themeName]
    if not t then return end
    local colorMap = {}
    for k, oldColor in pairs(Theme) do if t[k] then colorMap[oldColor] = t[k] end end
    for k, v in pairs(t) do Theme[k] = v end
    Config.CurrentTheme = themeName
    SaveConfig()
    local function matchColor(c1, c2) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE), ERROR_HANDLING(false))
        if not c1 or not c2 then return false end
        local dr = math.abs(c1.R - c2.R)
        local dg = math.abs(c1.G - c2.G)
        local db = math.abs(c1.B - c2.B)
        return (dr + dg + db) < 0.04
    end
    local function remapColor(c) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE), ERROR_HANDLING(false))
        if not c then return c end
        for oldC, newC in pairs(colorMap) do if matchColor(c, oldC) then return newC end end
        return c
    end
    local function remapSeq(obj) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE), ERROR_HANDLING(false))
        local changed = false
        local newKps = {}
        for _, kp in ipairs(obj.Color.Keypoints) do
            local nc = remapColor(kp.Value)
            if nc ~= kp.Value then changed = true end
            table.insert(newKps, ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(kp.Time, nc))
        end
        if changed then obj.Color = ColorSequence.new(newKps) end
    end
    local function remapObj(obj) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE), ERROR_HANDLING(false))
        local isBtn, isBox, isScroll = obj:IsA("TextButton"), obj:IsA("TextBox"), obj:IsA("ScrollingFrame")
        if isBtn or isBox or isScroll or obj:IsA("Frame") or obj:IsA("ImageLabel") then
            if obj.BackgroundTransparency < 1 then obj.BackgroundColor3 = remapColor(obj.BackgroundColor3) end
        end
        if isBtn or isBox or obj:IsA("TextLabel") then
            obj.TextColor3 = remapColor(obj.TextColor3)
            if obj.BackgroundTransparency < 1 and matchColor(obj.BackgroundColor3, Theme.Accent1) then
                obj.TextColor3 = _G.JAF_OnAccent(Theme.Accent1)
            end end
        if isScroll then obj.ScrollBarImageColor3 = remapColor(obj.ScrollBarImageColor3) end
        if obj:IsA("UIStroke") then obj.Color = remapColor(obj.Color) end
        if obj:IsA("UIGradient") or obj:IsA("Beam") then remapSeq(obj) end
    end
    local guiNames = {
        "AutoStealUI", "XiAdminPanel", "SneizzyStatusHUD", "PriorityListGUI",
        "SneizzySettings", "SneizzyGrabKick", "XiStealingHUD", "SneizzyWalkingBestBar", "SneizzyMiniActions"
    }
    for _, guiName in ipairs(guiNames) do
        local sg = hubFind(guiName)
        if sg then
            for _, obj in ipairs(sg:GetDescendants()) do pcall(remapObj, obj) end
            pcall(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE), ERROR_HANDLING(false))
                local root = sg:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Frame")
                if root and root.BackgroundTransparency < 1 then root.BackgroundColor3 = remapColor(root.BackgroundColor3) end
            end) end end
    task.spawn(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE), ERROR_HANDLING(false))
        local savedTab  = (_G.SneizzySettingsUI and _G.SneizzySettingsUI.currentTab) or "cfg"
        local wasVis    = _G.SneizzySettingsUI and _G.SneizzySettingsUI.panel and _G.SneizzySettingsUI.panel.Visible
        if buildSneizzySettingsUI then buildSneizzySettingsUI() end
        task.wait()
        if _G.SneizzySettingsUI then
            if _G.SneizzySettingsUI.switchTab then _G.SneizzySettingsUI.switchTab(savedTab) end
            if wasVis and _G.SneizzySettingsUI.panel then _G.SneizzySettingsUI.panel.Visible = true end
        end
        if _G.jafRebuildStatusHUD then _G.jafRebuildStatusHUD() end
        if jafUnifyPanelStyle then task.defer(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(ERROR_HANDLING(false))
pcall(jafUnifyPanelStyle) end) end
        if themeName == "dawg" then
            _G.JAF_DawgActive = true
            if jafApplyThemeImageToPanels then
                task.defer(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE), ERROR_HANDLING(false))
                    local asset = resolveDawgImage()
                    if asset and asset ~= "" then _G.JAF_ThemeImageAsset = asset pcall(jafApplyThemeImageToPanels, asset) end
                end) end
        elseif _G.JAF_DawgActive and not (Config.ThemeImageUrl and Config.ThemeImageUrl ~= "") then
            _G.JAF_DawgActive = false

            if jafApplyThemeImageToPanels then task.defer(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(ERROR_HANDLING(false))
pcall(jafApplyThemeImageToPanels, nil) end) end
        end
        if buildSneizzyMiniActionsUI and (_G.JAF_HeavyReady or (_G.SneizzyMiniActionsUI and _G.SneizzyMiniActionsUI.panel)) then
            local miniWasVis = _G.SneizzyMiniActionsUI and _G.SneizzyMiniActionsUI.panel and _G.SneizzyMiniActionsUI.panel.Visible

        end
        if _G.JAF_ThemeImageAsset and jafApplyThemeImageToPanels then
            task.defer(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(ERROR_HANDLING(false))
pcall(jafApplyThemeImageToPanels, _G.JAF_ThemeImageAsset) end)

do local saved = Config and Config.PriorityList if saved and type(saved) == "table" and #saved > 0 then PRIORITY_LIST = saved end end
local MUTATION_LIST = {}
local saveMutationPriorityToConfig
do
    local saved = Config and Config.MutationPriorityList
    if type(saved) == "table" then
        for _, v in ipairs(saved) do if type(v) == "string" and v ~= "" then MUTATION_LIST[#MUTATION_LIST + 1] = v end end
    end
    local MUT_ROSTER = {}
    do
        local okM, MD = pcall(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE), ERROR_HANDLING(false))
            return require(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):WaitForChild("Datas"):WaitForChild("Mutations"))
        end)
        if okM and type(MD) == "table" then
            for mName, d in pairs(MD) do
                if type(mName) == "string" and mName ~= "" then
                    MUT_ROSTER[#MUT_ROSTER + 1] = { name = mName, mod = (type(d) == "table" and tonumber(d.Modifier)) or 0 }
                end end end
        local hasNone = false
        for _, m in ipairs(MUT_ROSTER) do if m.name == "None" then hasNone = true break end end
        if not hasNone then MUT_ROSTER[#MUT_ROSTER + 1] = { name = "None", mod = 0 } end
        table.sort(MUT_ROSTER, function(a, b) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE), ERROR_HANDLING(false))
            if a.mod ~= b.mod then return a.mod > b.mod end
            return a.name < b.name
        end)
        _G.JAF_MutRoster = MUT_ROSTER
        if #MUT_ROSTER > 0 then
            local inRoster, seen, merged = {}, {}, {}
            for _, m in ipairs(MUT_ROSTER) do inRoster[m.name] = true end
            for _, v in ipairs(MUTATION_LIST) do if inRoster[v] and not seen[v] then seen[v] = true; merged[#merged + 1] = v end end
            for _, m in ipairs(MUT_ROSTER) do if not seen[m.name] then seen[m.name] = true; merged[#merged + 1] = m.name end end
            table.clear(MUTATION_LIST)
            for i, v in ipairs(merged) do MUTATION_LIST[i] = v end
        end end
    _G.JAF_NormMut = (function(m) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE), ERROR_HANDLING(false))
        if m == nil then return nil end
        m = tostring(m)
        if m == "" then return nil end
        return (m:gsub("%s+", "")):lower()
    end)
    local UNRANKED, RANK_MUL = 999, 1000
    local _nameRank, _mutRank = {}, {}
    local _dirty, _haveMut = true, false
    local _lastN, _lastM = -1, -1
    local _rebuild; _rebuild = function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE), ERROR_HANDLING(false))
        table.clear(_nameRank); table.clear(_mutRank)
        for i, v in ipairs(PRIORITY_LIST) do
            if i >= UNRANKED then break end
            local k = tostring(v):lower()
            if _nameRank[k] == nil then _nameRank[k] = i end
        end
        for i, v in ipairs(MUTATION_LIST) do
            if i >= UNRANKED then break end
            local k = _G.JAF_NormMut(v)
            if k and _mutRank[k] == nil then _mutRank[k] = i end
        end
        _haveMut = (next(_mutRank) ~= nil) and (Config.MutationPriorityEnabled ~= false)
        _dirty = false
        _lastN, _lastM = #PRIORITY_LIST, #MUTATION_LIST
    end
    _G.JAF_PrioDirty = function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(ERROR_HANDLING(false))
_dirty = true end
    _G.JAF_PrioScore = (function(entryOrName, mutation) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE), ERROR_HANDLING(false))
        if _dirty or _lastN ~= #PRIORITY_LIST or _lastM ~= #MUTATION_LIST then _rebuild() end
        local nm, mu
        if type(entryOrName) == "table" then
            nm = entryOrName.nameLower or (entryOrName.name and tostring(entryOrName.name):lower())
            if not entryOrName.isWalking then mu = entryOrName.mutLower or entryOrName.mutation end
        else
            nm = entryOrName and tostring(entryOrName):lower()
            mu = mutation
        end
        local nr = (nm and _nameRank[nm]) or UNRANKED
        if nr == UNRANKED then return UNRANKED * RANK_MUL + UNRANKED end
        local mr = UNRANKED
        if _haveMut and mu ~= nil then
            mr = _mutRank[mu]
            if mr == nil then local k = _G.JAF_NormMut(mu) mr = (k and _mutRank[k]) or UNRANKED end
        end
        return nr * RANK_MUL + mr
    end)
    saveMutationPriorityToConfig = function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE), ERROR_HANDLING(false))
        Config.MutationPriorityList = {}
        for i, v in ipairs(MUTATION_LIST) do Config.MutationPriorityList[i] = v end
        _G.JAF_PrioDirty()
        SaveConfig()
    end
    _G.JAF_MutList = MUTATION_LIST
end

function _isLockExempt(inst) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE), ERROR_HANDLING(false))

function _dragLocked(target) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE), ERROR_HANDLING(false)) return Config.UILocked and not _isLockExempt(target) end
function _G.JAF_OnInputEnd(io, fn) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE), ERROR_HANDLING(false))
    if not io then return end
    local conn, done
    conn = io.Changed:Connect(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE), ERROR_HANDLING(false))
        if done or io.UserInputState ~= Enum.UserInputState.End then return end
        done = true
        if conn then conn:Disconnect(); conn = nil end
        fn()
    end)

end
local MakeDraggable; MakeDraggable = function(handle, target, saveKey) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE), ERROR_HANDLING(false))
    if saveKey then _G.JAF_DragTargets = _G.JAF_DragTargets or {} _G.JAF_DragTargets[saveKey] = target end
    local dragging, dragInput, dragStart, startPos
    handle.InputBegan:Connect(function(input) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE), ERROR_HANDLING(false))
        if _dragLocked(target) then return end
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            dragging = true
            dragStart = input.Position
            startPos = target.Position
            _G.JAF_OnInputEnd(input, function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE), ERROR_HANDLING(false))
                dragging = false
                if saveKey then
                    if not target or not target.Parent then return end
                    local parentSize = target.Parent.AbsoluteSize
                    Config.Positions[saveKey] = {
                        X = (target.AbsolutePosition.X + target.AbsoluteSize.X * target.AnchorPoint.X) / parentSize.X,
                        Y = (target.AbsolutePosition.Y + target.AbsoluteSize.Y * target.AnchorPoint.Y) / parentSize.Y,
                    }
                    _G.JAF_SaveConfigSoon()
                end end) end end)
    handle.InputChanged:Connect((function(input) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE), ERROR_HANDLING(false))
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            dragInput = input
        end end))
    local _uisDragConn
    _uisDragConn = UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect((function(input) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE), ERROR_HANDLING(false))
        if not target or not target.Parent then if _uisDragConn then _uisDragConn:Disconnect(); _uisDragConn = nil end return end
        if input == dragInput and dragging then
            _G.JAF_DragBusy = tick()
            local delta = input.Position - dragStart
            target.Position = UDim2.new( startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + delta.X, startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y )
        end end)) end
local attachResizeGrip; attachResizeGrip = function(panelFrame, guiName, minFrac) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE), ERROR_HANDLING(false))
    if not panelFrame or not guiName then return end
    local baseW = panelFrame.Size.X.Offset
    local baseH = panelFrame.Size.Y.Offset
    local MINF = math.clamp(tonumber(minFrac) or 0.55, 0.3, 1)
    local function clampW(w) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(ERROR_HANDLING(false))
return math.clamp(math.floor(w + 0.5), math.floor(baseW * MINF), math.floor(baseW * 2.2)) end
    local function clampH(h) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(ERROR_HANDLING(false))
return math.clamp(math.floor(h + 0.5), math.floor(baseH * MINF), math.floor(baseH * 2.2)) end
    do
        local sv = Config.PanelSizes and Config.PanelSizes[guiName]
        if baseW > 40 and baseH > 40 and type(sv) == "table" and tonumber(sv.w) and tonumber(sv.h) then
            panelFrame.Size = UDim2.new(panelFrame.Size.X.Scale, clampW(tonumber(sv.w)), panelFrame.Size.Y.Scale, clampH(tonumber(sv.h)))
        end end
    if _G.JAF_ApplyUIScale and ((Config.UIScale or 1) ~= 1 or next(Config.PanelScales or {}) ~= nil) then
        task.defer(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(ERROR_HANDLING(false))
pcall(_G.JAF_ApplyUIScale, Config.UIScale or 1) end)
    end end

            Name="SneizzySilverShimmer",Rotation=15,Offset=Vector2.new(-0.18,0),
            Color=ColorSequence.new({
                ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0,Color3.fromRGB(153,164,181)),
                ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.35,Color3.fromRGB(193,201,214)),
                ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5,Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255)),
                ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.65,Color3.fromRGB(193,201,214)),
                ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1,Color3.fromRGB(153,164,181)),
            }),
        })
        -- Keep the highlight within the centered lettering; reverse without a fade or reset.
        local animation=TweenService:Create(gradient,TweenInfo.new(3.5,Enum.EasingStyle.Sine,Enum.EasingDirection.InOut,-1,true,0),{Offset=Vector2.new(0.18,0)})
        text.Destroying:Connect(function() animation:Cancel() end)
        animation:Play()
    end
    function R.rows(sf)
        for _,row in ipairs(sf:GetChildren()) do
            if row:IsA("GuiObject") then
                row.Size=UDim2.new(1,-4,row.Size.Y.Scale,row.Size.Y.Offset)
                if row.BackgroundTransparency<1 then row.BackgroundTransparency=0; round(row,8) end
            end
        end
        for _,o in ipairs(sf:GetDescendants()) do
            if o:IsA("TextLabel") or o:IsA("TextButton") or o:IsA("TextBox") then
                if o.Font~=Enum.Font.GothamBlack then o.Font=Enum.Font.GothamMedium end
            end
        end
    end
    function R.main(panel,side,nav,content,area,topbar,tabs,buttons,search)
        R.panel(panel); panel.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(460,532)
        side.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(56,484); side.AnchorPoint=Vector2.new(0,0.5); side.Position=UDim2.new(0,-68,0.5,0)
        R.panel(side)
        for _,o in ipairs(side:GetChildren()) do if o:IsA("Frame") and o~=nav then o.Visible=false end end
        nav.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(6,6); nav.Size=UDim2.new(1,-12,1,-12)
        local layout=nav:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIListLayout")
        if layout then layout.FillDirection=Enum.FillDirection.Vertical; layout.Padding=UDim.new(0,4) end
        for id,b in pairs(buttons) do
            b.Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,43); round(b,10)
            local l=b:FindFirstChild("TabLbl"); if l then l.Visible=false end
            local icon=b:FindFirstChild("TabIcon")
            if icon then icon.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(22,22); icon.AnchorPoint=Vector2.new(0.5,0.5); icon.Position=UDim2.fromScale(0.5,0.5) end
            local rail=b:FindFirstChild("TabRail"); if rail then rail.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(2,18); rail.Position=UDim2.new(0,-5,0.5,-9) end
            if id=="grief" then
                if icon then icon.Visible=false end
                local ring=new("Frame",b,{Name="SneizzyGriefIcon",Size=UDim2.fromOffset(20,20),AnchorPoint=Vector2.new(0.5,0.5),Position=UDim2.fromScale(0.5,0.5),BackgroundTransparency=1,BorderSizePixel=0})
                round(ring,10)
                local outline=new("UIStroke",ring,{Color=Theme.TextPrimary,Thickness=1.7,ApplyStrokeMode=Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border})
                local marks={}
                for _,s in ipairs({{2,7,-2},{2,2,5}}) do marks[#marks+1]=new("Frame",ring,{Size=UDim2.fromOffset(s[1],s[2]),AnchorPoint=Vector2.new(0.5,0.5),Position=UDim2.new(0.5,0,0.5,s[3]),BackgroundColor3=Theme.TextPrimary,BorderSizePixel=0}) end
                local function syncIcon()
                    local c=icon and icon.ImageColor3 or Theme.TextPrimary
                    outline.Color=c
                    for _,mark in ipairs(marks) do mark.BackgroundColor3=c end
                end
                syncIcon()
                if icon then
                    local connection=icon:GetPropertyChangedSignal("ImageColor3"):Connect(syncIcon)
                    b.Destroying:Connect(function() connection:Disconnect() end)
                end
            end
            local hintText=l and l.Text or id
            local textWidth=#hintText*7
            pcall(function()
                textWidth=game:GetService("TextService"):GetTextSize(hintText,12,Enum.Font.GothamMedium,Vector2.new(1000,100)).X
            end)
            local hint=label(b,hintText,0,0,math.clamp(math.ceil(textWidth)+24,60,180),30,12)
            hint.Name="SneizzyTabHint"; hint.Visible=false; hint.ZIndex=50
            hint.AnchorPoint=Vector2.new(1,0.5); hint.Position=UDim2.new(0,-14,0.5,0)
            hint.BackgroundTransparency=0; hint.BackgroundColor3=Theme.Surface
            hint.BorderSizePixel=0; hint.TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
            hint.TextYAlignment=Enum.TextYAlignment.Center; hint.Font=Enum.Font.GothamMedium
            round(hint,8)
            new("UIStroke",hint,{Color=Theme.Stroke,Thickness=1,Transparency=0.35,ApplyStrokeMode=Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border})
            b.MouseEnter:Connect(function() b.ZIndex=40; hint.Visible=true end); b.MouseLeave:Connect(function() hint.Visible=false; b.ZIndex=1 end)
        end
        content.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(0,0); content.Size=UDim2.fromScale(1,1)
        -- Keep a slim drag strip without reserving a visible header row.
        topbar.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(12,0); topbar.Size=UDim2.new(1,-24,0,10)
        for _,control in ipairs(topbar:GetChildren()) do
            if control:IsA("TextButton") or control:IsA("ImageButton") then control.Visible=false end
        end
        area.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(14,54); area.Size=UDim2.new(1,-28,1,-68)
        search.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(14,12); search.Size=UDim2.new(1,-28,0,32)
        for _,sf in pairs(tabs) do R.rows(sf) end
        -- Keep the detached dock on-screen on first open, even with an old saved position.
        local ps=panel.Parent.AbsoluteSize
        local x=panel.Position.X.Scale*ps.X+panel.Position.X.Offset
        local y=panel.Position.Y.Scale*ps.Y+panel.Position.Y.Offset
        if ps.X>0 and ps.Y>0 then panel.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(math.clamp(x,188,math.max(188,ps.X-468)),math.clamp(y,8,math.max(8,ps.Y-540))) end
        -- Keep the existing menu keybind and saved drag position. No second input handler.
    end
    function R.admin(frame,header,prox,tabs,list,blacklist,title,refresh)
        R.panel(frame); frame.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(520,560)
        local side=new("Frame",frame,{Name="SneizzyAdminSidebar",Size=UDim2.new(0,104,1,0),BackgroundTransparency=1})
        title.Parent=side; title.Text="Sneizzy Admin"; title.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(12,8); title.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(88,28); title.TextSize=12; title.Font=Enum.Font.GothamBlack
        header.BackgroundTransparency=1; header.Size=UDim2.new(0,104,0,42)
        tabs.Parent=side; tabs.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(7,48); tabs.Size=UDim2.new(1,-14,0,120)
        local tl=tabs:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIListLayout"); if tl then tl.FillDirection=Enum.FillDirection.Vertical end
        for _,b in ipairs(tabs:GetChildren()) do if b:IsA("TextButton") then b.Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,30); b.TextSize=12; b.Text=b.Text=="PLAYERS" and "Players" or "Settings" end end
        prox.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(112,8); prox.Size=UDim2.new(1,-120,0,60); prox.BackgroundTransparency=1
        local n=0
        for _,b in ipairs(prox:GetChildren()) do if b:IsA("TextButton") then b.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(88,26); b.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(n*94,0); b.TextSize=11; n=n+1 end end
        refresh.Parent=prox; refresh.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(88,24); refresh.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(0,30); refresh.Text="Refresh"; refresh.TextSize=11
        list.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(112,76); list.Size=UDim2.new(1,-120,0,0)
        list.ScrollingEnabled=false; list.ScrollBarThickness=0; list.ClipsDescendants=true
        list.ScrollBarImageTransparency=1; list.TopImage=""; list.MidImage=""; list.BottomImage=""
        list.CanvasPosition=Vector2.zero
        blacklist.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(112,76); blacklist.Size=UDim2.new(1,-120,1,-88)
        local function fit()
            if not frame.Parent then return end
            local count=0
            for _,r in ipairs(list:GetChildren()) do if r:IsA("GuiObject") then count=count+1 end end
            local h=count*64+math.max(0,count-1)*6
            list.Size=UDim2.new(1,-120,0,h)
            frame.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(520,math.max(240,h+88))
            local camera=workspace.CurrentCamera
            if camera and h+88>camera.ViewportSize.Y then
                if not frame:GetAttribute("SneizzyHeightWarning") then warn("[Sneizzy UI] Full player roster is taller than this viewport; no players have been hidden."); frame:SetAttribute("SneizzyHeightWarning",true) end
            else frame:SetAttribute("SneizzyHeightWarning",nil) end
        end
        list.ChildAdded:Connect(function() task.defer(fit) end); list.ChildRemoved:Connect(function() task.defer(fit) end); fit()
    end
    function R.player(row,player,name,badge,status,actions)
        row.Size=UDim2.new(1,-4,0,64); row.BackgroundTransparency=0; round(row,9)
        name.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(48,5); name.Size=UDim2.new(1,-160,0,16); name.Text=player.DisplayName; name.Font=Enum.Font.GothamBold; name.TextSize=13
        label(row,"@"..player.Name,48,22,210,12,10).TextColor3=Theme.TextSecondary
        local avatar=new("Frame",row,{Name="SneizzyPlayerAvatar",Size=UDim2.fromOffset(32,32),Position=UDim2.fromOffset(8,7),BackgroundColor3=Theme.SurfaceHighlight,BorderSizePixel=0}); round(avatar,9)
        local initial=label(avatar,string.upper(player.DisplayName:sub(1,1)),0,0,32,32,13); initial.TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Center; initial.TextColor3=Theme.Accent1
        local userId=tonumber(player.UserId)
        if userId and userId>0 then
            -- Keep the image renderable while it loads; don't gate loading on visibility.
            local photo=new("ImageLabel",avatar,{Name="SneizzyHeadshot",Size=UDim2.fromScale(1,1),BackgroundTransparency=1,BorderSizePixel=0,Image="rbxthumb://type=AvatarHeadShot&id="..tostring(userId).."&w=150&h=150",ImageColor3=Color3.new(1,1,1),ImageTransparency=0,ScaleType=Enum.ScaleType.Fit,Visible=true,ZIndex=3})
            round(photo,9)
            local function loaded()
                if not avatar.Parent then return end
                local ready=photo.IsLoaded==true
                initial.Visible=not ready
            end
            local connection=photo:GetPropertyChangedSignal("IsLoaded"):Connect(loaded)
            avatar.Destroying:Connect(function() connection:Disconnect() end)
            loaded()
            task.defer(function()
                for attempt=1,3 do
                    if not row.Parent or not avatar.Parent then return end
                    local ok,content,ready=pcall(function()
                        return game:GetService("Players"):GetUserThumbnailAsync(userId,Enum.ThumbnailType.HeadShot,Enum.ThumbnailSize.Size150x150)
                    end)
                    if not row.Parent or not avatar.Parent then return end
                    if ok and ready and type(content)=="string" and content~="" then photo.Image=content end
                    pcall(function() game:GetService("ContentProvider"):PreloadAsync({photo}) end)
                    if not row.Parent or not avatar.Parent then return end
                    loaded()
                    if photo.IsLoaded then return end
                    if attempt<3 then task.wait(attempt) end
                end
                warn("[Sneizzy UI] Headshot did not load for user "..tostring(userId).."; showing initial.")
            end)
        end
        badge.Position=UDim2.new(1,-108,0,8); badge.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(100,14); badge.TextSize=10
        status.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(8,44); status.Size=UDim2.new(1,-255,0,14); status.TextSize=10
        actions.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(240,26); actions.Position=UDim2.new(1,-248,0,35)
        local i=0
        for _,b in ipairs(actions:GetChildren()) do if b:IsA("TextButton") then b.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(i*40,0); b.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(36,26); b.TextSize=12; i=i+1 end end
    end
    function R.target(row,rank,name,income)

        rank.BackgroundTransparency=0; rank.BackgroundColor3=Theme.Background; round(rank,11)
        name.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(40,0); name.Size=UDim2.new(1,-122,1,0)

    function R.mini(panel,content)
        R.panel(panel); panel.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(248,360)
        content.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(10,34); content.Size=UDim2.new(1,-20,1,-44)
        local group=new("Frame",content,{Name="SneizzyQuickToggles",BackgroundTransparency=1,Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,64),LayoutOrder=31})
        new("UIGridLayout",group,{CellSize=UDim2.new(0.5,-4,0,30),CellPadding=UDim2.fromOffset(8,4),SortOrder=Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder})
        for _,r in ipairs(content:GetChildren()) do
            if r:IsA("GuiObject") and r~=group then
                local ord=r.LayoutOrder
                if ord>=32 and ord<=35 then
                    r.Parent=group
                    for _,o in ipairs(r:GetChildren()) do
                        if o:IsA("TextLabel") then
                            if o.BackgroundTransparency<1 then
                                o:SetAttribute("SneizzyStatusDot",true)
                                o.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(10,10); o.Position=UDim2.new(1,-18,0.5,-5); o.Text=""; o.TextTransparency=1
                            else o.Size=UDim2.new(1,-28,1,0); o.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(8,0); o.TextSize=11 end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        local h=0; local count=0
        for _,r in ipairs(content:GetChildren()) do if r:IsA("GuiObject") then h=h+r.Size.Y.Offset; count=count+1 end end
        panel.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(248,h+math.max(0,count-1)*4+46)
    end
    -- Live colors are saved separately; old gameplay/config keys are not renamed.
    local defaults={S="000000",E="0C0C0C",A="C8C8C8",solid=true,rotation=90}
    local function copy(t) local n={} for k,v in pairs(t) do n[k]=v end return n end
    local function color(s) if type(s)~="string" or not s:match("^%x%x%x%x%x%x$") then return nil end return Color3.fromRGB(tonumber(s:sub(1,2),16),tonumber(s:sub(3,4),16),tonumber(s:sub(5,6),16)) end
    local function hex(c) return string.format("%02X%02X%02X",math.floor(c.R*255+.5),math.floor(c.G*255+.5),math.floor(c.B*255+.5)) end
    local saved=copy(defaults)
    local migrateAppearance=Config.SneizzyAppearanceRevision~=2
    if not migrateAppearance and type(Config.SneizzyAppearance)=="table" then for k in pairs(defaults) do local v=Config.SneizzyAppearance[k]; if (k=="S" or k=="E" or k=="A") and color(v) then saved[k]=v elseif k=="solid" and type(v)=="boolean" then saved[k]=v elseif k=="rotation" and type(v)=="number" then saved[k]=v%360 end end end
    local current=copy(saved)
    function R.applyGradient(p)
        local g=p:FindFirstChild("SneizzyAppearanceGradient") or new("UIGradient",p,{Name="SneizzyAppearanceGradient"})
        g.Enabled=not current.solid; g.Rotation=current.rotation
        g.Color=ColorSequence.new(Color3.new(1,1,1),color(current.E):Lerp(Color3.new(1,1,1),.72))
    end
    function R.colors(state)
        current=copy(state)
        local s,e,a=color(state.S),color(state.E),color(state.A)
        local nextTheme={Background=s,Surface=e,SurfaceHighlight=e:Lerp(Color3.new(1,1,1),0.07),Accent1=a,Accent2=e:Lerp(a,0.2),TextPrimary=Color3.fromRGB(208,208,208),TextSecondary=Color3.fromRGB(160,160,160),Success=Color3.fromRGB(72,199,142),Error=Color3.fromRGB(226,72,82),Stroke=Color3.fromRGB(44,44,44)}
        if s.R*.299+s.G*.587+s.B*.114>0.55 or e.R*.299+e.G*.587+e.B*.114>0.55 then nextTheme.TextPrimary=Color3.fromRGB(20,24,32); nextTheme.TextSecondary=Color3.fromRGB(60,68,82) end
        local map={}; for k,v in pairs(nextTheme) do map[Theme[k]]=v end
        -- Only Sneizzy-owned GUIs; never recolor Roblox's gameplay UI.
        for _,gui in ipairs(HubGui:GetChildren()) do
            if gui:IsA("ScreenGui") and ({XiAdminPanel=true,AutoStealUI=true,SneizzySettings=true,SneizzyMiniActions=true,PriorityListGUI=true,JAFAdvTpSpeed=true,SneizzyStatusHUD=true})[gui.Name] then
                for _,o in ipairs(gui:GetDescendants()) do
                    if o:IsA("GuiObject") and map[o.BackgroundColor3] then o.BackgroundColor3=map[o.BackgroundColor3] end
                    if (o:IsA("TextLabel") or o:IsA("TextButton") or o:IsA("TextBox")) and map[o.TextColor3] then o.TextColor3=map[o.TextColor3] end
                    if o:IsA("ImageLabel") and map[o.ImageColor3] then o.ImageColor3=map[o.ImageColor3] end
                    if o:IsA("UIStroke") and map[o.Color] then o.Color=map[o.Color] end
                end
            end
        end
        for k,v in pairs(nextTheme) do Theme[k]=v end
        for p in pairs(roots) do if p.Parent then
            p.BackgroundColor3=s
            R.applyGradient(p)
        end end
    end
    function R.appearance(parent,slider)
        local draft=copy(current)
        local function preview() R.colors(draft) end
        local body=new("Frame",parent,{Size=UDim2.new(1,-4,0,0),AutomaticSize=Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,BackgroundTransparency=1,LayoutOrder=101})
        new("UIListLayout",body,{Padding=UDim.new(0,6),SortOrder=Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder})
        local editors={}
        local function refresh()
            for key,entry in pairs(editors) do entry.sw.BackgroundColor3=color(draft[key]); entry.caption.Text=entry.name.."   #"..draft[key] end
        end
        for i,item in ipairs({{"Background","S"},{"Surface","E"},{"Accent","A"}}) do
            local name,key=item[1],item[2]
            local row=new("Frame",body,{Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,36),BackgroundColor3=Theme.Surface,BorderSizePixel=0,LayoutOrder=i*10}); round(row)
            local caption=label(row,name.."   #"..draft[key],12,0,270,36,12)
            local picker=new("Frame",body,{Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,0),AutomaticSize=Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,BackgroundTransparency=1,Visible=false,LayoutOrder=i*10+1})
            new("UIListLayout",picker,{Padding=UDim.new(0,4),SortOrder=Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder})
            local sw=button(row,"",0,5,26,26,function()
                if not picker:GetAttribute("Built") then
                    picker:SetAttribute("Built",true)
                    local h,s,v=color(draft[key]):ToHSV()
                    local function changed() draft[key]=hex(Color3.fromHSV(h,s,v)); preview(); refresh() end
                    slider(picker,1,"Hue",0,360,1,false,h*360,function(n) h=n/360; changed() end,function(n) return tostring(math.floor(n)) end)
                    slider(picker,2,"Saturation",0,100,1,false,s*100,function(n) s=n/100; changed() end,function(n) return tostring(math.floor(n)).."%" end)
                    slider(picker,3,"Brightness",0,100,1,false,v*100,function(n) v=n/100; changed() end,function(n) return tostring(math.floor(n)).."%" end)
                end
                picker.Visible=not picker.Visible
            end)
            sw.Position=UDim2.new(1,-36,0,5); sw.BackgroundColor3=color(draft[key]); editors[key]={sw=sw,caption=caption,name=name,picker=picker}
        end
        local actions=new("Frame",body,{Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,72),BackgroundTransparency=1,LayoutOrder=50})
        local solid,direction
        local function labels() solid.Text=draft.solid and "Solid" or "Gradient"; direction.Text="Direction: "..draft.rotation end
        solid=button(actions,"",0,0,105,28,function() draft.solid=not draft.solid; preview(); labels() end)
        direction=button(actions,"",113,0,130,28,function() draft.rotation=(draft.rotation+45)%360; preview(); labels() end)
        local function resetEditors() for _,entry in pairs(editors) do for _,o in ipairs(entry.picker:GetChildren()) do if o:IsA("GuiObject") then o:Destroy() end end entry.picker:SetAttribute("Built",nil); entry.picker.Visible=false end refresh(); labels() end
        button(actions,"Apply",0,38,90,28,function() saved=copy(draft); Config.SneizzyAppearance=copy(saved); SaveConfig() end)
        button(actions,"Cancel",98,38,90,28,function() draft=copy(saved); preview(); resetEditors() end)
        button(actions,"Reset",196,38,90,28,function() draft=copy(defaults); preview(); resetEditors() end)
        labels()
    end
    -- Presentation-only listener: the embedded engine still owns visibility and progress.
    function R.watchNearest(playerGui)
        if _G.SneizzyUIPresentationCleanup then _G.SneizzyUIPresentationCleanup() end
        local connections={}
        local function connect(signal,fn) connections[#connections+1]=signal:Connect(fn) end
        local function hook(gui)
            if gui.Name~="bRXgmsaEVfze" then return end
            local function style(o)
                if o:IsA("Frame") and o.Name=="CurrentTargetHUD" then task.defer(function() if o.Parent then R.panel(o) end end) end
            end
            for _,o in ipairs(gui:GetDescendants()) do style(o) end
            connect(gui.DescendantAdded,style)
        end
        for _,gui in ipairs(playerGui:GetChildren()) do hook(gui) end
        connect(playerGui.ChildAdded,hook)
        _G.SneizzyUIPresentationCleanup=function() for _,c in ipairs(connections) do c:Disconnect() end; table.clear(connections) end
    end
    R.colors(saved)
    if migrateAppearance then
        -- One-time requested palette change; later color-picker choices remain persistent.
        Config.SneizzyAppearance=copy(saved)
        Config.SneizzyAppearanceRevision=2
        SaveConfig()
    end
    return R
end)()

function JUI.new(class, parent, ...) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE), ERROR_HANDLING(false))
    local o = Instance.new(class)
    if select("#", ...) > 0 then _P(o, ...) end
    if parent ~= nil then o.Parent = parent end
    local fontRoot = _G.JAF_SleekFontRoot
    local adminFontRoot = _G.JAF_AdminFontRoot
    if (class == "TextLabel" or class == "TextButton" or class == "TextBox")
        and fontRoot and fontRoot.Parent and o:IsDescendantOf(fontRoot) then
        o.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
        -- Preserve compact explicit text sizes.
    elseif (class == "TextLabel" or class == "TextButton" or class == "TextBox")
        and adminFontRoot and adminFontRoot.Parent and o:IsDescendantOf(adminFontRoot) then
        o.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium
        -- Preserve compact explicit text sizes.
    end
    return o
end
function JUI.corner(inst, r) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE), ERROR_HANDLING(false))
    local c = Instance.new("UICorner"); c.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, r or 8); c.Parent = inst
    return c
end
function JUI.round(inst) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE), ERROR_HANDLING(false))
    local c = Instance.new("UICorner"); c.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0); c.Parent = inst
    return c
end
function JUI.stroke(inst, color, thickness, transparency) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE), ERROR_HANDLING(false))
    return JUI.new("UIStroke", inst, "Color", color or Theme.Stroke, "Thickness", thickness or 1, "Transparency", transparency or 0)
end
function JUI.section(parent, lbl, order) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE), ERROR_HANDLING(false))
    local row = JUI.new("Frame", parent, "Size", UDim2.new(1,0,0,24), "BackgroundTransparency", 1, "LayoutOrder", order)
    local bar = JUI.new("Frame", row, "Size", UDim2.new(0,2,0,11), "Position", UDim2.new(0,2,0.5,-5), "BackgroundColor3", Theme.Accent1, "BorderSizePixel", 0)
    JUI.corner(bar, 2)

local function _jafPhoneClass(p) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE), ERROR_HANDLING(false))

local function _jafAutoMobile() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE), ERROR_HANDLING(false))
    local ok, v = pcall(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE), ERROR_HANDLING(false))
        if GuiService and GuiService.IsTenFootInterface and GuiService:IsTenFootInterface() then return false end
        if UserInputService.VREnabled then return false end
        if not UserInputService.TouchEnabled then return false end
        local kb, mouse = UserInputService.KeyboardEnabled, UserInputService.MouseEnabled
        if not kb and not mouse then return true end

function _G.JAF_LockScrolls(inst) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE), ERROR_HANDLING(false))
    local locked, conn = {}, nil
    local n = inst and inst.Parent
    while n and n ~= game do
        if n:IsA("ScrollingFrame") and n.ScrollingEnabled then
            locked[#locked+1] = { sf = n, cp = n.CanvasPosition }
            n.ScrollingEnabled = false
        end
        n = n.Parent
    end
    if #locked > 0 then
        conn = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE), ERROR_HANDLING(false))
            for _, e in ipairs(locked) do if e.sf.Parent then e.sf.CanvasPosition = e.cp end end
        end) end
    return function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE), ERROR_HANDLING(false))
        if conn then conn:Disconnect(); conn = nil end
        for _, e in ipairs(locked) do if e.sf.Parent then e.sf.ScrollingEnabled = true; e.sf.CanvasPosition = e.cp end end
        table.clear(locked)
    end end
_G.JAF_SliderMinH  = 28
_G.JAF_SliderMinUse = 18
_G.JAF_MobileSlider = function(track) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE), ERROR_HANDLING(false))
    if not track or not track.Parent then return end
    local want = _G.JAF_MobileOn()
    local vis  = track:FindFirstChild("JAFTrackVisual")
    if want == (vis ~= nil) then return end
    local row  = track.Parent
    if want then
        local origH = track.Size.Y.Offset
        if origH <= 0 or origH >= _G.JAF_SliderMinH then return end
        local origY = track.Position.Y.Offset
        local rowH = row.Size.Y.Offset
        if rowH <= 0 then rowH = math.floor(row.AbsoluteSize.Y + 0.5) end
        local bandTop, bandBot = 0, rowH
        for _, sib in ipairs(row:GetChildren()) do
            if sib ~= track and sib:IsA("GuiObject") and sib.Visible
               and sib.Size.Y.Scale == 0 and sib.Size.Y.Offset > 0 then
                local sTop = sib.Position.Y.Offset
                local sBot = sTop + sib.Size.Y.Offset
                if sBot <= origY   and sBot > bandTop then bandTop = sBot end
                if sTop >= origY + origH and sTop < bandBot then bandBot = sTop end
            end end
        local band  = math.max(origH, bandBot - bandTop)
        local newH  = math.min(_G.JAF_SliderMinH, band)
        local grow  = math.max(0, math.min(_G.JAF_SliderMinH, _G.JAF_SliderMinUse) - newH)
        if grow > 0 then newH = newH + grow; bandBot = bandBot + grow end
        local centre = origY + origH / 2
        local newY   = math.floor(centre - newH / 2 + 0.5)
        if newY < bandTop then newY = bandTop end
        if newY + newH > bandBot then newY = bandBot - newH end
        vis = Instance.new("Frame")
        vis.Name = "JAFTrackVisual"
        vis.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
        _P(vis, "Position", UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, (origY - newY) + math.floor(origH / 2 + 0.5)), "Size", UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, origH), "BackgroundColor3", track.BackgroundColor3, "BackgroundTransparency", track.BackgroundTransparency, "BorderSizePixel", 0, "ZIndex", track.ZIndex)
        vis:SetAttribute("JAFOrigH", origH)
        vis:SetAttribute("JAFOrigY", origY)
        for _, ch in ipairs(track:GetChildren()) do ch.Parent = vis end
        vis.Parent = track
        track:SetAttribute("JAFOrigTrans", track.BackgroundTransparency)
        track.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        track.Active = true
        track.Size = UDim2.new(track.Size.X.Scale, track.Size.X.Offset, 0, newH)
        track.Position = UDim2.new(track.Position.X.Scale, track.Position.X.Offset, track.Position.Y.Scale, newY)
        if grow > 0 and row:IsA("Frame") and row.Size.Y.Scale == 0 and row.Size.Y.Offset > 0 then
            row:SetAttribute("JAFRowGrow", grow)
            row.Size = UDim2.new(row.Size.X.Scale, row.Size.X.Offset, 0, row.Size.Y.Offset + grow)
        end
        if not track:GetAttribute("JAFScrollLock") then
            track:SetAttribute("JAFScrollLock", true)
            local unlock
            track.InputBegan:Connect(function(i) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE), ERROR_HANDLING(false))
                if i.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch and i.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then return end
                if unlock then unlock() end
                unlock = _G.JAF_LockScrolls(track)
                _G.JAF_OnInputEnd(i, function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE), ERROR_HANDLING(false))
                    if unlock then unlock(); unlock = nil end
                end) end) end
    else
        local origH = vis:GetAttribute("JAFOrigH") or track.Size.Y.Offset
        local origY = vis:GetAttribute("JAFOrigY")
        for _, ch in ipairs(vis:GetChildren()) do ch.Parent = track end
        track.BackgroundTransparency = track:GetAttribute("JAFOrigTrans") or 0
        track.Size = UDim2.new(track.Size.X.Scale, track.Size.X.Offset, 0, origH)
        track.Position = UDim2.new(track.Position.X.Scale, track.Position.X.Offset,
                                   track.Position.Y.Scale, origY or track.Position.Y.Offset)
        local grow = row:GetAttribute("JAFRowGrow")
        if grow then
            row.Size = UDim2.new(row.Size.X.Scale, row.Size.X.Offset, 0, math.max(1, row.Size.Y.Offset - grow))
            row:SetAttribute("JAFRowGrow", nil)
        end
        vis:Destroy()
    end end
function _G.JAF_MobileSliderPass(root) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE), ERROR_HANDLING(false))
    if not root then return end
    for _, d in ipairs(root:GetDescendants()) do
        if d:IsA("Frame") and d.Name ~= "JAFTrackVisual"
           and d.Size.Y.Scale == 0 and d.Size.Y.Offset > 0 and d.Size.Y.Offset <= 10 then
            local fill, knob
            for _, k in ipairs(d:GetChildren()) do
                if k:IsA("Frame") then
                    if k.Size.Y.Scale == 1 then fill = k end
                    if k.AnchorPoint.X == 0.5 and k.AnchorPoint.Y == 0.5 then knob = k end
                end end
            if fill and knob then pcall(_G.JAF_MobileSlider, d) end
        end end end
_G.JAF_BindSlider = function(track, onSet, onDone) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE), ERROR_HANDLING(false))
    if not track then return end
    local active, unlock
    local function stop() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE), ERROR_HANDLING(false))
        if not active then return end
        active = nil
        if unlock then unlock(); unlock = nil end
        if onDone then pcall(onDone) end
    end
    track.Active = true
    track.InputBegan:Connect(function(i) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE), ERROR_HANDLING(false))
        if active then return end
        if i.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 and i.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch then return end
        active = i
        unlock = _G.JAF_LockScrolls(track)
        pcall(onSet, i.Position.X)
        _G.JAF_OnInputEnd(i, function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE), ERROR_HANDLING(false)) if active == i then stop() end end)
    end)
    local moveConn, endConn
    moveConn = UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect((function(i) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE), ERROR_HANDLING(false))
        if not track.Parent then
            if moveConn then moveConn:Disconnect(); moveConn = nil end
            if unlock then unlock(); unlock = nil end
            return
        end
        if not active then return end
        if active.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            if i ~= active then return end
        elseif i.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then
            return
        end
        pcall(onSet, i.Position.X)
    end))
    endConn = UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(i) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE), ERROR_HANDLING(false))
        if not track.Parent then if endConn then endConn:Disconnect(); endConn = nil end return end
        if not active then return end
        if i == active
        or (active.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch and i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1) then
            stop()
        end end) end
function _G.JAF_OnTap(btn, fn) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE), ERROR_HANDLING(false))
    if not btn then return end
    local pendingTouch = false
    btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE), ERROR_HANDLING(false))
        if pendingTouch then pendingTouch = false; return end
        fn()
    end)
    btn.InputBegan:Connect(function(i) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE), ERROR_HANDLING(false))
        if i.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch then return end
        pendingTouch = true
        task.delay(1.5, function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(ERROR_HANDLING(false))
pendingTouch = false end)
        fn()
    end) end

local function _killDarkOverlay() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE), ERROR_HANDLING(false))
    local host = (gethui and gethui()) or HubGui
    local ov = host and host:FindFirstChild("SneizzyDarkOverlay")
    if ov then pcall(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(ERROR_HANDLING(false))
ov:Destroy() end) end

local function applyDarkBrightness(darkness) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE), ERROR_HANDLING(false))
    local d = math.clamp(darkness or 0.4, 0, 1)
    Config.DarkBrightness = d
    _killDarkOverlay()
    if not Config.DarkMode then local cc0 = Lighting:FindFirstChild("SneizzyDarkModeCC"); if cc0 then cc0:Destroy() end return end
    local de = d ^ (_G.JAF_DarkGamma or 1.6)
    local cc = Lighting:FindFirstChild("SneizzyDarkModeCC")
    if not cc then
        cc = Instance.new("ColorCorrectionEffect"); cc.Name = "SneizzyDarkModeCC"
        cc.TintColor = Color3.new(1, 1, 1); cc.Parent = Lighting
    end
    cc.Enabled    = true
    cc.Brightness = -de
    cc.Contrast   = -0.05 * de
    cc.Saturation = -0.35 * de
end
local _darkMaintainTok = 0
local _darkRSConn = nil
local function startDarkMaintain() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE), ERROR_HANDLING(false))
    _darkMaintainTok = _darkMaintainTok + 1
    local tok = _darkMaintainTok
    if _darkRSConn then pcall(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(ERROR_HANDLING(false))
_darkRSConn:Disconnect() end); _darkRSConn = nil end
    local acc = 0
    _darkRSConn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE), ERROR_HANDLING(false))
        if tok ~= _darkMaintainTok or not Config.DarkMode then
            if _darkRSConn then _darkRSConn:Disconnect(); _darkRSConn = nil end
            return
        end
        acc = acc + (dt or 0)
        if acc < 0.5 then return end
        acc = 0
        local cc = Lighting:FindFirstChild("SneizzyDarkModeCC")
        local de = math.clamp(Config.DarkBrightness or 0.4, 0, 1) ^ (_G.JAF_DarkGamma or 1.6)
        if (not cc) or cc.Enabled ~= true or math.abs(cc.Brightness + de) > 0.001 then applyDarkBrightness(Config.DarkBrightness or 0.4) end
    end) end
local function setDarkMode(enabled) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE), ERROR_HANDLING(false))
    local on = not not enabled
    Config.DarkMode = on
    SaveConfig()
    _killDarkOverlay()
    if on then
        applyDarkBrightness(Config.DarkBrightness or 0.4)
        startDarkMaintain()
    else
        _darkMaintainTok = _darkMaintainTok + 1
        local cc = Lighting:FindFirstChild("SneizzyDarkModeCC"); if cc then cc:Destroy() end
    end end
_G.JAF_ReassertDark = function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE), ERROR_HANDLING(false))
    if not Config.DarkMode then return end
    pcall(applyDarkBrightness, Config.DarkBrightness or 0.4)
    if not _darkRSConn then pcall(startDarkMaintain) end
end
if Config.DarkMode then task.spawn(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE), ERROR_HANDLING(false))
    task.wait(1)
    pcall(setDarkMode, true)
    task.wait(0.5)
    if Config.DarkMode and not _darkRSConn then pcall(startDarkMaintain) end
end) end
local State = { carpetSpeedEnabled = false, infiniteJumpEnabled = Config.TpSettings.InfiniteJump, }
local ProximityAPActive = false
local Connections = { carpetSpeedConnection = nil, infiniteJumpConnection = nil, _ijInputBegan = nil, _ijInputEnded = nil, }
local UI = { }
local carpetSpeedEnabled = State.carpetSpeedEnabled
local function setCarpetSpeed(enabled) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(ERROR_HANDLING(false))
    if not SAB_LIVE() then return end
    if enabled and (LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("Stealing") or _G.JAF_TpActive) then enabled = false end
    State.carpetSpeedEnabled = enabled
    carpetSpeedEnabled = State.carpetSpeedEnabled
    _G.JAF_CarpetSpeedActive = enabled
    if Connections.carpetSpeedConnection then Connections.carpetSpeedConnection:Disconnect(); Connections.carpetSpeedConnection = nil end
    if not enabled then return end
    if SharedState.DisableStealSpeed then SharedState.DisableStealSpeed() end
    Connections.carpetSpeedConnection = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE), ERROR_HANDLING(false))
        if not SAB_LIVE() then return end
        if _G.JAF_TpActive or LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("Stealing") then setCarpetSpeed(false) return end
        local c = LocalPlayer.Character
        if not c then return end
        local hum = c:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
        local hrp = c:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not hum or not hrp then return end
        local toolName = Config.TpSettings.Tool
        local hasTool = c:FindFirstChild(toolName)
        if not hasTool then
            local bp = LocalPlayer:FindFirstChild("Backpack")
            local tb = bp and bp:FindFirstChild(toolName)
            if tb and not _G.JAF_ResetStowActive then hum:EquipTool(tb); hasTool = tb end
        end
        if hasTool then

        if not Config.LineToBase then return end
        local myPlot = findMyPlot()
        if not myPlot or not myPlot.Parent then return end
        local character = LocalPlayer.Character
        if not character or not character.Parent then return end
        local hrp = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not hrp or not hrp.Parent then return end
        if plotBeam then pcall(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(ERROR_HANDLING(false))
plotBeam:Destroy() end) end
        if plotBeamAttachment0 then pcall(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(ERROR_HANDLING(false))
plotBeamAttachment0:Destroy() end) end
        plotBeamAttachment0 = hrp:FindFirstChild("PlotBeamAttach_Player") or Instance.new("Attachment")
        _P(plotBeamAttachment0, "Name", "PlotBeamAttach_Player", "Position", Vector3.new(0, 0, 0), "Parent", hrp)
        local plotPart = myPlot:FindFirstChild("MainRootPart") or myPlot:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart")
        if not plotPart or not plotPart.Parent then return end
        plotBeamAttachment1 = plotPart:FindFirstChild("PlotBeamAttach_Plot") or Instance.new("Attachment")
        _P(plotBeamAttachment1, "Name", "PlotBeamAttach_Plot", "Position", Vector3.new(0, 5, 0), "Parent", plotPart)
        plotBeam = hrp:FindFirstChild("PlotBeam") or Instance.new("Beam")
        plotBeam.Name = "PlotBeam"
        plotBeam.Attachment0 = plotBeamAttachment0
        plotBeam.Attachment1 = plotBeamAttachment1
        plotBeam.FaceCamera = true
        plotBeam.LightEmission = 1
        plotBeam.Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255))
        plotBeam.Transparency = NumberSequence.new(0)
        plotBeam.Width0 = 0.7
        plotBeam.Width1 = 0.7
        plotBeam.TextureMode = Enum.TextureMode.Wrap
        plotBeam.TextureSpeed = 0
        plotBeam.Parent = hrp
    end

        if plotBeam then pcall(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(ERROR_HANDLING(false))
plotBeam:Destroy() end) end
        if plotBeamAttachment0 then pcall(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(ERROR_HANDLING(false))
plotBeamAttachment0:Destroy() end) end
        if plotBeamAttachment1 then pcall(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(ERROR_HANDLING(false))
plotBeamAttachment1:Destroy() end) end
        plotBeam = nil

        plotBeamAttachment1 = nil

    local function _mergedOrder() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE), ERROR_HANDLING(false))

        if not randomize or #order < 2 then return order end
        local pinned = (type(Config.AdminCmdPinned) == "table") and Config.AdminCmdPinned or nil
        local seq, freeIdx, pool = {}, {}, {}
        for i, cmd in ipairs(order) do
            if pinned and pinned[cmd] then seq[i] = cmd
            else seq[i] = false; freeIdx[#freeIdx + 1] = i; pool[#pool + 1] = cmd end
        end
        local rng = Random.new()
        for i = #pool, 2, -1 do local j = rng:NextInteger(1, i); pool[i], pool[j] = pool[j], pool[i] end
        for k, idx in ipairs(freeIdx) do seq[idx] = pool[k] end
        return seq
    end
