        local R = {names = {}, ids = {}, nN = 0, nI = 0, nD = 0, src = "none", ms = 0, err = nil}
        local function addName(c) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE), ERROR_HANDLING(false))
            c = tostring(c):lower()
            if #c < 3 or #c > 20 or not c:match("^[%w_]+$") or c:match("^%d+$") then return false end
            if not R.names[c] then R.names[c] = true; R.nN = R.nN + 1 end
            return true
        end
        local function addId(d) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE), ERROR_HANDLING(false))
            local n = tonumber(d)
            if not n or n <= 0 or n >= 1e11 then return false end
            if not R.ids[n] then R.ids[n] = true; R.nI = R.nI + 1 end
            return true
        end
        local function apply(arr, src) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE), ERROR_HANDLING(false))
            R.names, R.ids, R.nN, R.nI, R.nD = {}, {}, 0, 0, 0
            for _, raw in ipairs(arr) do
                local s = tostring(raw):gsub("\\", ""):gsub("%*", ""):gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", ""):gsub("^[^%w_]+", ""):gsub("[^%w_]+$", "")
                local hit, rid = nil, s:match("^roblox_user_(%d+)$")
                if rid then hit = addId(rid)
                elseif s:match("^%d+$") then hit = addId(s)
                else
                    hit = addName((s:gsub("%s+", "")))
                    local best = ""
                    for tok in s:gmatch("[%w_]+") do if #tok > #best then best = tok end end
                    if best ~= "" and addName(best) then hit = true end
                end
                if not hit then R.nD = R.nD + 1 end
            end
            R.src = src
        end

            pcall(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE), ERROR_HANDLING(false))
                if not isfile(o.cache) then return end
                local lines = {}
                for ln in tostring(readfile(o.cache)):gmatch("[^\r\n]+") do lines[#lines + 1] = ln end
                if #lines > 0 then apply(lines, "cache") end
            end) end
        R.refresh = function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE), ERROR_HANDLING(false))
            local ok, err = pcall(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE), ERROR_HANDLING(false))
                local t0, body = os.clock()
                if not o.headers and game.HttpGet then body = game:HttpGet(o.url, true) end
                if not body or body == "" then
                    local req = (syn and syn.request) or (http and http.request) or http_request or request or (fluxus and fluxus.request)
                    if not req then error("no http") end
                    local res = req({Url = o.url, Method = "GET", Headers = o.headers})
                    body = res and (res.Body or res.body)
                end
                if not body or body == "" then error("empty body") end
                local _, lb = body:find('"' .. o.field .. '"%s*:%s*%[')
                if not lb then error("no " .. o.field .. " array") end
                local rb = body:find("]", lb, true)
                if not rb then error("unterminated " .. o.field .. " array") end
                local arr = HttpService:JSONDecode(body:sub(lb, rb))
                if type(arr) ~= "table" or #arr == 0 then error("empty " .. o.field .. " array") end
                apply(arr, "live")
                R.ms = (os.clock() - t0) * 1000
                if writefile then
                    local out = {}
                    for n in pairs(R.names) do out[#out + 1] = n end
                    for i in pairs(R.ids) do out[#out + 1] = "#" .. tostring(i) end
                    writefile(o.cache, table.concat(out, "\n"))
                end end)
            R.err = (not ok) and tostring(err) or nil
            return ok
        end
        R.has = function(username) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE), ERROR_HANDLING(false))

        end
        return R
    end

    local function nearestBaseOwner() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(ERROR_HANDLING(false))
        local char = LocalPlayer.Character
        local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not hrp then return nil end
        local nearestPlot = nil
        local nearestDist = math.huge
        local Plots = Workspace:FindFirstChild("Plots")
        if Plots then
            for _, plot in ipairs(Plots:GetChildren()) do
                local sign = plot:FindFirstChild("PlotSign")
                if sign then
                    local yourBase = sign:FindFirstChild("YourBase")
                    if not yourBase or not yourBase.Enabled then
                        local signPos = sign:IsA("BasePart") and sign.Position or (sign.PrimaryPart and sign.PrimaryPart.Position)
                        if not signPos then local part = sign:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true) signPos = part and part.Position end
                        if signPos then
                            local dist = (hrp.Position - signPos).Magnitude
                            if dist < nearestDist then nearestDist = dist nearestPlot = plot end
                        end end end end end
        if not nearestPlot then return nil end
        local targetPlayer = nil
        local ok, ch = pcall(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(ERROR_HANDLING(false))
local S = adminGetSync(); return S and S:Get(nearestPlot.Name) end)
        if ok and ch then local owner = ch:Get("Owner") if owner then targetPlayer = _G.JAF_OwnerPlayer(owner) end end
        if not targetPlayer then
            local sign = nearestPlot:FindFirstChild("PlotSign")
            local textLabel = sign and sign:FindFirstChild("SurfaceGui") and sign.SurfaceGui:FindFirstChild("Frame") and sign.SurfaceGui.Frame:FindFirstChild("TextLabel")
            if textLabel then
                local baseText = textLabel.Text
                local nickname = baseText and baseText:match("^(.-)'") or baseText
                if nickname then
                    for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
                        if p.DisplayName == nickname or p.Name == nickname then targetPlayer = p break end
                    end end end end
        if not targetPlayer or targetPlayer == LocalPlayer then return nil end
        if isBlacklisted(targetPlayer.Name) then return nil end
        if getAutojoinerName(targetPlayer.Name) then return nil end
        return targetPlayer
    end

        if not plr or not plr.Parent then return 3, 9999, "" end
        local stealing = plr:GetAttribute("Stealing")

    local function sortAdminPanelList() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE), ERROR_HANDLING(false))
        if not (listFrame.Visible and adminGui.Enabled and frame.Visible) then return end
        local rows = {}
        for _, child in ipairs(listFrame:GetChildren()) do
            if child:IsA("TextButton") and child.Name ~= "" then
                local plr = Players:FindFirstChild(child.Name)
                if plr then
                    local t, p, n = getAdminPanelSortKey(plr)
                    rows[#rows + 1] = {row = child, plr = plr, t = t, p = p, n = n or ""}
                end end end
        table.sort(rows, (function(a, b) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE), ERROR_HANDLING(false))
            if a.t ~= b.t then return a.t < b.t end
            if a.p ~= b.p then return a.p < b.p end
            return a.n < b.n
        end))
        for i, entry in ipairs(rows) do if entry.row.LayoutOrder ~= i then entry.row.LayoutOrder = i end end
    end
    local function fireClick(button) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(ERROR_HANDLING(false))
        if not SAB_LIVE() then return end
        if button then
            if firesignal then
                firesignal(button.MouseButton1Click); firesignal(button.MouseButton1Down); firesignal(button.Activated)
            else
                local x = button.AbsolutePosition.X + (button.AbsoluteSize.X / 2)
                local y = button.AbsolutePosition.Y + (button.AbsoluteSize.Y / 2) + 58
                VirtualInputManager:SendMouseButtonEvent(x, y, 0, true, game, 0)
                VirtualInputManager:SendMouseButtonEvent(x, y, 0, false, game, 0)
            end end end
    local function runAdminCommand(targetPlayer, commandName, selfAction) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE), ERROR_HANDLING(false))
        local _isSelf = (selfAction == true) and targetPlayer == LocalPlayer
        if not _isSelf then
            if targetPlayer and isBlacklisted(targetPlayer.Name) then return false end
            if targetPlayer then local aj = getAutojoinerName(targetPlayer.Name) if aj then return false end end
        end
        local realAdminGui = PlayerGui:WaitForChild("AdminPanel", 5)
        if not realAdminGui then return false end
        local profilesScroll = realAdminGui:WaitForChild("AdminPanel"):WaitForChild("Profiles"):WaitForChild("ScrollingFrame")
        local playerBtn = profilesScroll:FindFirstChild(targetPlayer.Name)
        if not playerBtn then return false end
        fireClick(playerBtn)
        task.wait(0.05)
        local contentScroll = realAdminGui.AdminPanel:WaitForChild("Content"):WaitForChild("ScrollingFrame")
        local cmdBtn = contentScroll:FindFirstChild(commandName)
        if not cmdBtn then return false end
        fireClick(cmdBtn)
        return true
    end
    _G.runAdminCommand = runAdminCommand
    local isOnCooldown
    local function getNextAvailableCommand() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE), ERROR_HANDLING(false))
        for _, cmd in ipairs(getOrderedCommands()) do if not isOnCooldown(cmd) then return cmd end end
        return nil
    end
    isOnCooldown = (function(cmd) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE), ERROR_HANDLING(false))
        local t = hubFind("AdminPanel")
        t = t and t:FindFirstChild("AdminPanel"); t = t and t:FindFirstChild("Content")
        t = t and t:FindFirstChild("ScrollingFrame"); t = t and t:FindFirstChild(cmd)
        t = t and t:FindFirstChild("Timer")
        if t then return t.Visible end
        if not activeCooldowns[cmd] then return false end
        return (tick() - activeCooldowns[cmd]) < (COOLDOWNS[cmd] or 0)
    end)
    _G.isOnCooldown = isOnCooldown
    local function setGlobalVisualCooldown(cmd) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE), ERROR_HANDLING(false))
        if SharedState.AdminButtonCache[cmd] then
            for _, b in ipairs(SharedState.AdminButtonCache[cmd]) do
                if b and b.Parent then
                    b.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Error
                    task.delay(COOLDOWNS[cmd] or 5, function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE), ERROR_HANDLING(false))
                        if b and b.Parent then
                            local hasBallooned = (cmd == "balloon" and SharedState.BalloonedPlayers and next(SharedState.BalloonedPlayers) ~= nil)
                            b.BackgroundColor3 = hasBallooned and Theme.Error or Theme.SurfaceHighlight
                        end end) end end end end
    _G.setGlobalVisualCooldown = setGlobalVisualCooldown
    _G.activeCooldowns = activeCooldowns

    local function triggerAll(plr) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE), ERROR_HANDLING(false))
        if not canUseAdminAction(plr) then return end
        local count = 0
        for _, cmd in ipairs(buildCmdSequence(Config.AdminRandomCmd == true)) do
            if not isOnCooldown(cmd) then
                task.delay(count * 0.1, function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE), ERROR_HANDLING(false))
                    if runAdminCommand(plr, cmd) then noteCmdFired(plr, cmd) end
                end)
                count = count + 1
            end end end
    _G.triggerAll = triggerAll
    local _cycle = {}
    local function nextCycleCmd() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE), ERROR_HANDLING(false))
        for _ = 1, 2 do
            while #_cycle > 0 do local cmd = table.remove(_cycle, 1) if not isOnCooldown(cmd) then return cmd end end
            _cycle = buildCmdSequence(Config.AdminRandomCmd == true)
            if #_cycle == 0 then return nil end
        end
        return nil
    end
    local function fireRandomCmd(plr) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE), ERROR_HANDLING(false))
        if not canUseAdminAction(plr) then return end

    local rayToCubeIntersect; rayToCubeIntersect = (function(rayOrigin, rayDirection, cubeCenter, cubeSize) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE), ERROR_HANDLING(false))

        local dy = rayDirection.Y ~= 0 and rayDirection.Y or 0.0001
        local dz = rayDirection.Z ~= 0 and rayDirection.Z or 0.0001
        local tmin, tmax = _slab(minBounds.X, maxBounds.X, rayOrigin.X, dx)
        local tymin, tymax = _slab(minBounds.Y, maxBounds.Y, rayOrigin.Y, dy)
        if tmin > tymax or tymin > tmax then return false end
        if tymin > tmin then tmin = tymin end
        if tymax < tmax then tmax = tymax end
        local tzmin, tzmax = _slab(minBounds.Z, maxBounds.Z, rayOrigin.Z, dz)
        if tmin > tzmax or tzmin > tmax then return false end
        return true
    end)

                    local distance = (ray.Origin - cubeCenter).Magnitude
                    if distance < bestDistance then bestDistance = distance; bestPlayer = p end
                end end end
        return bestPlayer
    end)

    local function addPlayer(plr) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE), ERROR_HANDLING(false))

        local row = createPlayerRow(plr)
        playerRows[plr] = row
        playerRowsByUserId[plr.UserId] = {player = plr, row = row}

        sortAdminPanelList()
    end

        if row then
            if row.Parent then _dropRow(row) end
            if plr then playerRows[plr] = nil end
            if userId then playerRowsByUserId[userId] = nil end
            if SharedState.BalloonedPlayers and userId then SharedState.BalloonedPlayers[userId] = nil end
            listFrame.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0,0,0, layout.AbsoluteContentSize.Y + 30)
        end end

        for _, child in ipairs(listFrame:GetChildren()) do if child:IsA("TextButton") then child:Destroy() end end
        task.wait(0.1)

return ch:Get("AnimalList") end)

    local e, why = _animalSlotEntry(a, memo)

local _signCache, _signCacheAt = nil, 0
local function _rebuildSignCache() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE), ERROR_HANDLING(false))
    local out = {}
    for _, label in ipairs(Workspace:GetDescendants()) do
        if label.ClassName == "TextLabel" then
            local txt = label.Text
            if type(txt) == "string" and #txt >= 4
               and (txt:find("base", 1, true) or txt:find("Base", 1, true) or txt:lower():find("base", 1, true)) then
                local gui = label:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA("SurfaceGui")
                if gui then local part = gui.Adornee or gui.Parent if part and part:IsA("BasePart") then out[#out + 1] = part end end
            end end end
    _signCache, _signCacheAt = out, tick()
    return out
end
local function getClosestBaseSign(brainrotPart) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(ERROR_HANDLING(false))
    if not brainrotPart or not brainrotPart:IsA("BasePart") then return nil end
    local list
    if _G.JAF_NoSignCache == true then
        list = _rebuildSignCache()
    else
        list = _signCache
        local _want, _have = 0, 0
        if _G.JAF_SignCachePartialGuard ~= false then
            local _pf0 = Workspace:FindFirstChild("Plots")
            if _pf0 then
                _want = #_pf0:GetChildren()
                if list then
                    local _seen = {}
                    for i = 1, #list do
                        local _s = list[i]
                        if _s.Parent then
                            local _n = _s
                            while _n and _n.Parent do
                                if _n.Parent == _pf0 then if not _seen[_n] then _seen[_n] = true; _have = _have + 1 end break end
                                _n = _n.Parent
                            end end end end end end
        local _age = tick() - _signCacheAt
        if not list or #list == 0
           or (_have < _want and _age > (tonumber(_G.JAF_SignCachePartialTTL) or 0.5))
           or _age > (tonumber(_G.JAF_SignCacheTTL) or 15) then
            list = _rebuildSignCache()
        end end
    local _pf = Workspace:FindFirstChild("Plots")
    local _myPlot
    if _pf then
        local node = brainrotPart
        while node and node.Parent do if node.Parent == _pf then _myPlot = node; break end node = node.Parent end
    end
    local closestPart, closestDist = nil, math.huge
    local ownPart, ownDist = nil, math.huge
    for i = 1, #list do
        local part = list[i]
        if part.Parent then
            local dist = (part.Position - brainrotPart.Position).Magnitude
            if dist < closestDist then closestDist = dist closestPart = part end
            if _myPlot and dist < ownDist then
                local n2 = part
                while n2 and n2.Parent do
                    if n2.Parent == _pf then if n2 == _myPlot then ownDist = dist; ownPart = part end break end
                    n2 = n2.Parent
                end end end end
    if not ownPart and _myPlot and _G.JAF_SignOwnPlot ~= false then
        local _ps = _myPlot:FindFirstChild("PlotSign")
        if _ps then
            local _cand
            if _ps:IsA("BasePart") then _cand = _ps end
            for _, d in ipairs(_ps:GetDescendants()) do
                if d:IsA("SurfaceGui") then local _a = d.Adornee or d.Parent if _a and _a:IsA("BasePart") then _cand = _a; break end end
            end
            if _cand then ownPart = _cand end
        end end
    if ownPart and _G.JAF_SignOwnPlot ~= false then return ownPart end
    return closestPart
end
local function getSignInwardDir(signPart) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(ERROR_HANDLING(false))
    if not (signPart and signPart:IsA("BasePart")) then return Vector3.new(1, 0, 0) end
    local outward
    local gui = signPart:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("SurfaceGui", true)
    if gui then
        outward = signPart.CFrame:VectorToWorldSpace(Vector3.FromNormalId(gui.Face))
    else
        local s, cf = signPart.Size, signPart.CFrame
        if s.Z <= s.X and s.Z <= s.Y then outward = cf.LookVector
        elseif s.X <= s.Y then outward = cf.RightVector
        else outward = cf.UpVector end
    end
    outward = Vector3.new(outward.X, 0, outward.Z)
    if outward.Magnitude < 0.01 then return Vector3.new(1, 0, 0) end
    local intoBase = -outward.Unit
    if _G.JAF_FlipInto then intoBase = -intoBase end
    return intoBase
end

        end

                    if d:IsA("TextLabel") and d.Name == "Locked" and d.Visible then return false, "gui" end

end

_G.JAF_BrainrotCFrameMove = function(hrp, dst, rotCF) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE), ERROR_HANDLING(false))

_SABCAP.JAF_TweenHrpBrainrot = function(hrp, dst, rotCF) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(PRESET(FAST), ERROR_HANDLING(false))
    if not (hrp and hrp.Parent and dst) then return end
    if _G.JAF_BrainrotSimpleSnap(hrp, dst, rotCF) then return end
    if _G.JAF_BrainrotVelMove == false then return _G.JAF_BrainrotCFrameMove(hrp, dst, rotCF) end
    local _t0     = tick()
    local _budget = math.clamp((dst - hrp.Position).Magnitude / math.max(_G.JAF_BrainrotApproachSpeed(), 50) + 1.5, 1, 6)
    local _bestD, _stuckAt = (dst - hrp.Position).Magnitude, tick()
    local _dt = 1/60
    local _char0 = LocalPlayer.Character
    while tick() - _t0 < _budget do
        if not (hrp and hrp.Parent) then return end
        if _G.JAF_CancelTp or not SAB_LIVE() or LocalPlayer.Character ~= _char0 then
            hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity  = Vector3.zero
            hrp.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
            return
        end
        local _pos  = hrp.Position
        local _diff = dst - _pos
        local _dist = _diff.Magnitude
        if _dist <= 1 then break end
        local _speed = _G.JAF_BrainrotApproachSpeed()
        if _G.JAF_BrainrotLikeFlight ~= false and Config.TpSettings.TpMode == "grapple"

                hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero

                hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = _stepVec / math.max(_dt, 1/240)
            end
            hrp.CFrame = CFrame.new(_pos + _stepVec) * (rotCF or CFrame.new())
        end
        if _dist < _bestD - 0.5 then
            _bestD, _stuckAt = _dist, tick()
        elseif tick() - _stuckAt > (tonumber(_G.JAF_BrainrotStallSecs) or 0.35) then
            _G.JAF_BrainrotCFrameMove(hrp, dst, rotCF)
            break
        end
        _dt = RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
    end
    if hrp and hrp.Parent then
        hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity  = Vector3.zero
        hrp.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
        if (dst - hrp.Position).Magnitude <= 8 then hrp.CFrame = CFrame.new(dst) * (rotCF or CFrame.new()) end
    end end

return require(ReplicatedStorage.Packages.Net:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("ModuleScript", true)) end)

local getRemote
do
    local RS  = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
    local RUN = game:GetService("RunService")

    local _netFolder
    local function _netDir()
        if _netFolder then return _netFolder end
        local pk = RS:FindFirstChild("Packages") or RS:WaitForChild("Packages", 10)
        if not pk then return nil end
        _netFolder = pk:FindFirstChild("Net") or pk:WaitForChild("Net", 10)
        return _netFolder
    end
    local _net
    local function _getNet()
        if _net then return _net end
        local dir = _netDir()
        if not dir then return nil end
        local ok, m = pcall(require, dir)
        if ok and type(m) == "table" then _net = m end
        return _net
    end
    local _queue, _hooked, _original = {}, false, nil
    local function _host()
        for _, sig in ipairs({ RUN.Heartbeat, RUN.RenderStepped, RUN.PostSimulation }) do
            local ok, conns = pcall(getconnections, sig)
            if ok then
                for _, c in ipairs(conns) do
                    local f = c.Function
                    if f and f ~= _G.__lefaSyncHost and islclosure(f) and not isexecutorclosure(f) then
                        local s = select(2, pcall(debug.info, f, "s"))
                        if type(s) == "string" and s:find("^ReplicatedStorage%.") and not s:find("ReplicatedFirst") then
                            return f
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    local function _install()
        if _hooked then return true end
        if not _getNet() then return false end
        local h = _host()
        if not h then return false end
        _G.__lefaNetHost = h
        local w = function(...)
            local job = table.remove(_queue, 1)
            if job then
                local ok, r = pcall(_net[job.kind], _net, job.name)
                job.result = (ok and typeof(r) == "Instance") and r or nil
                job.done = true
            end
            return _original(...)
        end
        local ok, env = pcall(getfenv, h)
        if ok and type(env) == "table" then pcall(setfenv, w, env) end
        _original = hookfunction(h, w)
        _hooked = true
        return true
    end
    local _cache = {}
    local function _get(name, kind)
        kind = (kind == "RemoteFunction" and "RemoteFunction")
            or (kind == "UnreliableRemoteEvent" and "UnreliableRemoteEvent")
            or "RemoteEvent"
        if type(name) ~= "string" or name == "" then return nil end
        local logical = name:match("^R[EF]/(.+)$") or name:match("^URE/(.+)$") or name
        local ck = kind .. "|" .. logical
        local hit = _cache[ck]
        if hit and hit.Parent then return hit end
        _cache[ck] = nil
        if not _getNet() then return nil end
        if not _install() then return nil end
        local job = { kind = kind, name = logical }
        table.insert(_queue, job)
        local t = os.clock() + (tonumber(_G.LefaNetTimeout) or 5)
        while not job.done and os.clock() < t do RUN.Heartbeat:Wait() end
        if job.result and job.result.Parent then
            _cache[ck] = job.result

        end

end

_G.JAF_StolenSwap = function(cur, curY) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(PRESET(FAST), ERROR_HANDLING(false))

    local function _sweepHitsWheel(px, py, pz, dx, dy, dz) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(PRESET(FAST), ERROR_HANDLING(false))

            local oy = w.flat and 0 or (py + dy * t - w.center.Y)

        end

    local function wheelDetour(dst, cruiseY) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(ERROR_HANDLING(false))

        local origin = Vector3.new(fromPos.X, cruiseY, fromPos.Z)
        local d = Vector3.new(dst.X - origin.X, 0, dst.Z - origin.Z)
        local segLen2 = d.X * d.X + d.Z * d.Z
        if segLen2 < 4 then return nil end
        local _best, _bestT
        for _, w in ipairs(_cyberWheels) do
            local t = ((w.center.X - origin.X) * d.X + (w.center.Z - origin.Z) * d.Z) / segLen2
            if t > 0.02 and t < 0.98 then
                local ox = (origin.X + d.X * t) - w.center.X
                local oz = (origin.Z + d.Z * t) - w.center.Z
                local distXZ = math.sqrt(ox * ox + oz * oz)
                if distXZ < w.radius and (not _bestT or t < _bestT) then _bestT = t; _best = { w = w, ox = ox, oz = oz, dist = distXZ } end
            end end
        if not _best then return nil end

            sx, sz = _best.ox / _best.dist, _best.oz / _best.dist

local _grabCB; _grabCB = function(p) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(ERROR_HANDLING(false))
    local d = { hold = {}, trigger = {} }
    local ok, cs = pcall(getconnections, p.PromptButtonHoldBegan)
    if ok and type(cs) == "table" then

    end
    ok, cs = pcall(getconnections, p.Triggered)
    if ok and type(cs) == "table" then

local _fireTrigger; _fireTrigger = function(p, d) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(ERROR_HANDLING(false))

        if #d.trigger == 0 and fireproximityprompt then pcall(fireproximityprompt, p) end end

local _apCache = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})
local _apFromHold; _apFromHold = function(p, d) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(ERROR_HANDLING(false))
    local ap = _apCache[p]
    if ap ~= nil then return ap or nil end
    if debug and debug.getupvalues and d then
        for _, f in ipairs(d.hold) do
            local ok, ups = pcall(debug.getupvalues, f)
            if ok then for _, v in pairs(ups) do
                if type(v) == "table" and rawget(v, "State") ~= nil and rawget(v, "ProximityPrompt") ~= nil then
                    _apCache[p] = v
                    return v
                end
            end end
        end
    end
    _apCache[p] = false
    return nil
end
local _fireHoldForced; _fireHoldForced = function(p, d) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(ERROR_HANDLING(false))
    if not d or #d.hold == 0 then return false end
    local ap = _apFromHold(p, d)
    if ap and ap.State ~= "Steal" then
        local _os = ap.State
        ap.State = "Steal"
        for _, f in ipairs(d.hold) do pcall(f) end
        ap.State = _os
        return true
    end
    if not ap and p and p.Enabled == false then return false end
    for _, f in ipairs(d.hold) do task.spawn(f) end
    return true
end
-- Proven one-shot steal on a single prompt, using the SAME primitive the normal
-- autosteal uses (hold-began callbacks with the anti-cheat State forced to "Steal",
-- then the trigger). fireproximityprompt alone does NOT complete a steal here.
_G.JAF_ForceSteal = function(p) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(ERROR_HANDLING(false))
    if not (p and p.Parent and p.Enabled) then return false end
    local d = _grabCB(p)
    _fireHoldForced(p, d)
    _fireTrigger(p, d)
    return true
end
local isMyPlot; isMyPlot = function(plotName) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(PRESET(FAST), ERROR_HANDLING(false))

local function findPrompt(a) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(PRESET(FAST), ERROR_HANDLING(false))
    if not a then return nil end
    if a.isWalking then if a.prompt and a.prompt.Parent and a.prompt.Enabled then return a.prompt end return nil end
    local cp = PromptCache[a.uid]
    if cp and cp.Parent and cp.Enabled and cp.ActionText == "Steal" then return cp end
    local plots = Workspace:FindFirstChild("Plots"); if not plots then return nil end
    local plot  = plots:FindFirstChild(a.plot);     if not plot  then return nil end
    local pods  = plot:FindFirstChild("AnimalPodiums"); if not pods then return nil end
    local pod   = pods:FindFirstChild(a.slot);      if not pod   then return nil end
    local base  = pod:FindFirstChild("Base");        if not base  then return nil end
    local sp    = base:FindFirstChild("Spawn");      if not sp    then return nil end
    local att   = sp:FindFirstChild("PromptAttachment")
    if att then
        for _, p in ipairs(att:GetChildren()) do
            if p:IsA("ProximityPrompt") and p.Enabled and p.ActionText == "Steal" then PromptCache[a.uid] = p; return p end
        end end
    local startPos = sp.Position
    local best, bd = nil, math.huge
    local _pl = PromptIdx[plot]
    if not _pl or PromptIdxDirty[plot] then
        _pl = {}
        for _, d in ipairs(plot:GetDescendants()) do if d:IsA("ProximityPrompt") then _pl[#_pl + 1] = d end end
        PromptIdx[plot], PromptIdxDirty[plot] = _pl, nil
        if not PromptIdxConn[plot] then
            local function _mark(d) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(ERROR_HANDLING(false))
if d:IsA("ProximityPrompt") then PromptIdxDirty[plot] = true end end
            PromptIdxConn[plot] = { plot.DescendantAdded:Connect(_mark), plot.DescendantRemoving:Connect(_mark), }
        end end
    for _, d in ipairs(_pl) do
        if d.Parent and d.Enabled and d.ActionText == "Steal" then
            local part = d.Parent
            local pp
            if part:IsA("BasePart") then pp = part.Position
            elseif part:IsA("Attachment") and part.Parent:IsA("BasePart") then pp = part.Parent.Position end
            if pp then
                local dx, dz = pp.X - startPos.X, pp.Z - startPos.Z
                if (dx * dx + dz * dz) < 25 and pp.Y > startPos.Y then
                    local yd = pp.Y - startPos.Y
                    if yd < bd then bd = yd; best = d end
                end end end end
    if best then PromptCache[a.uid] = best end
    return best
end
local _ownerPresent = {}
do

    Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(pl) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(ERROR_HANDLING(false))
_ownerPresent[pl.Name] = true end)
    Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(pl) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(ERROR_HANDLING(false))
_ownerPresent[pl.Name] = nil end)
end

local findNearestPrompt; findNearestPrompt = function(priorityTarget) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(PRESET(FAST), ERROR_HANDLING(false))

local promptDistXZ; promptDistXZ = function(prompt) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE), ERROR_HANDLING(false))

    if not hrp then return nil end

    local pos
    if par then

        end end

local function parseGenShort(s) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE), ERROR_HANDLING(false))
    if type(s) ~= "string" then return 0 end
    s = s:gsub("[%s%+]", ""):lower()
    if s == "" then return 0 end
    local num, suf = s:match("^([%d%.]+)([kmb]?)$")
    num = tonumber(num)
    if not num or num < 0 then return 0 end
    if suf == "k" then return num * 1e3
    elseif suf == "m" then return num * 1e6
    elseif suf == "b" then return num * 1e9 end
    return num
end
_G.JAF_ParseGen = parseGenShort
local function animalGen(a) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE), ERROR_HANDLING(false))
    if type(a.genValue) == "number" then return a.genValue end
    local t = tostring(a.genText or ""):lower():gsub("[%$,%s]", "")
    local num = tonumber(t:match("([%d%.]+)"))
    if not num then return 0 end
    if t:find("b") then return num * 1e9 elseif t:find("m") then return num * 1e6 elseif t:find("k") then return num * 1e3 end
    return num
end

local playerESPToggleRef = {setFn=nil}
local espToggleRef = {enabled=true, setFn=nil}
local executeReset = nil
-- ============================================================
-- X-RAY BASE state (ported from Extras.txt)
-- Extras renders base walls/decor semi-transparent by scaling each object's
-- REAL transparency toward 1 by an alpha (default 0.60) instead of forcing a
-- flat 0.5, tracks a fixed folder set, and covers GUI elements too. Here it is
-- driven by the existing "X-Ray Base" toggle (Config.XrayEnabled) instead of
-- Extras' always-on nowSpawn block, and the footprint helper _baseBoxFromXray
-- below is left untouched (it is base geometry, not the see-through effect).
-- ============================================================
local xrayEnabled = Config.XrayEnabled or false
if _G.XRayAlpha == nil then
    _G.XRayAlpha = math.clamp(tonumber(Config.XrayAlpha) or 0.60, 0, 1)
end
local xrayOrigT   = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })   -- real transparency of each touched object, for restore
local _xrayConns  = {}                                     -- live DescendantAdded/ChildAdded connections
local _xrayLoopId = 0                                      -- bumps on each enable/disable to cancel stale passes
local _baseFootprints = {}
_G.JAF_InBase = false
local _inPlotFolder; _inPlotFolder = function(p, fname, plot) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(ERROR_HANDLING(false))
    local x = p.Parent
    while x and x ~= plot do if x.Name == fname then return true end x = x.Parent end
    return false
end
local _fallbackBox; _fallbackBox = function(plot) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE), ERROR_HANDLING(false))
    if _G.JAF_FootprintFallbackBox == false then return nil end
    local ok, cf, sz = pcall(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(ERROR_HANDLING(false))
return plot:GetBoundingBox() end)
    if not ok or not cf or not sz then return nil end
    if math.abs(cf.Position.X) > 50000 or math.abs(cf.Position.Z) > 50000 then return nil end
    local hx, hz = sz.X * 0.5, sz.Z * 0.5
    local cap = tonumber(_G.JAF_FallbackMaxHalf) or 70
    if hx > cap or hz > cap then return nil end
    local _u = _G.JAF_UnfootedPlots or {}; _u[plot.Name] = true; _G.JAF_UnfootedPlots = _u
    return cf.Position.X - hx, cf.Position.X + hx, cf.Position.Z - hz, cf.Position.Z + hz,
           cf.Position.Y - (_G.JAF_BaseFloorDrop or 4), cf.Position.Y + (_G.JAF_BaseFloorWallH or 16)
end
local _baseBoxFromXray; _baseBoxFromXray = function(plot) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE), ERROR_HANDLING(false))
    if _G.JAF_XrayFootprint == false then return nil end
    local function _inF(o, name) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(ERROR_HANDLING(false))
local a = o.Parent; while a and a ~= plot do if a.Name == name then return true end; a = a.Parent end; return false end
    local pods = plot:FindFirstChild("AnimalPodiums")
    local mnF, mxF = math.huge, -math.huge
    if pods then for _, pod in ipairs(pods:GetChildren()) do local b = pod:FindFirstChild("Base"); local sp = b and b:FindFirstChild("Spawn"); if sp and sp:IsA("BasePart") then if sp.Position.Y < mnF then mnF = sp.Position.Y end; if sp.Position.Y > mxF then mxF = sp.Position.Y end end end end
    local haveFloor = mnF ~= math.huge
    local floorY = haveFloor and (mnF - (_G.JAF_BaseFloorDrop or 4)) or nil
    local roofY  = haveFloor and (mxF + (_G.JAF_BaseFloorWallH or 16)) or nil
    local mnx, mxx, mnz, mxz, ny, ymn, ymx = math.huge, -math.huge, math.huge, -math.huge, 0, math.huge, -math.huge
    for _, d in ipairs(plot:GetDescendants()) do
        if d:IsA("BasePart") and d.Anchored and d.CanCollide
           and math.abs(d.Position.X) < 50000 and math.abs(d.Position.Z) < 50000
           and not _inF(d, "AnimalPodiums")
           and not _inF(d, "CashPad") and not _inF(d, "Cash")
           and not _inF(d, "Laser") and d.Name ~= "LaserHitbox" then
            local q, s, cf = d.Position, d.Size, d.CFrame
            local hx = (math.abs(cf.RightVector.X)*s.X + math.abs(cf.UpVector.X)*s.Y + math.abs(cf.LookVector.X)*s.Z) * 0.5
            local hy = (math.abs(cf.RightVector.Y)*s.X + math.abs(cf.UpVector.Y)*s.Y + math.abs(cf.LookVector.Y)*s.Z) * 0.5
            local hz = (math.abs(cf.RightVector.Z)*s.X + math.abs(cf.UpVector.Z)*s.Y + math.abs(cf.LookVector.Z)*s.Z) * 0.5
            if (not haveFloor) or ((q.Y + hy >= floorY - 3) and (q.Y - hy <= roofY + 5)) then
                if q.X-hx < mnx then mnx = q.X-hx end
                if q.X+hx > mxx then mxx = q.X+hx end
                if q.Z-hz < mnz then mnz = q.Z-hz end
                if q.Z+hz > mxz then mxz = q.Z+hz end
                if q.Y-hy < ymn then ymn = q.Y-hy end
                if q.Y+hy > ymx then ymx = q.Y+hy end
                ny = ny + 1
            end end end
    if ny < 3 then return nil end
    return mnx, mxx, mnz, mxz, (floorY or ymn), (roofY or ymx)
end
local _baseBox; _baseBox = function(plot) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE), ERROR_HANDLING(false))
    local pods = plot:FindFirstChild("AnimalPodiums")
    local mnF, mxF = math.huge, -math.huge
    if pods then
        for _, pod in ipairs(pods:GetChildren()) do
            local b  = pod:FindFirstChild("Base")
            local sp = b and b:FindFirstChild("Spawn")
            if sp and sp:IsA("BasePart") then
                if sp.Position.Y < mnF then mnF = sp.Position.Y end
                if sp.Position.Y > mxF then mxF = sp.Position.Y end
            end end end
    if mnF == math.huge then return _fallbackBox(plot) end
    local floorY = mnF - (_G.JAF_BaseFloorDrop or 4)
    local roofY  = mxF + (_G.JAF_BaseFloorWallH or 16)
    local lx0,lx1,lz0,lz1,ln = math.huge,-math.huge, math.huge,-math.huge, 0
    for _, p in ipairs(plot:GetDescendants()) do
        if p:IsA("BasePart") and _inPlotFolder(p, "Laser", plot) then
            local q,s = p.Position, p.Size
            if math.abs(q.X) < 50000 and math.abs(q.Z) < 50000 then
                if q.X-s.X*0.5 < lx0 then lx0 = q.X-s.X*0.5 end
                if q.X+s.X*0.5 > lx1 then lx1 = q.X+s.X*0.5 end
                if q.Z-s.Z*0.5 < lz0 then lz0 = q.Z-s.Z*0.5 end
                if q.Z+s.Z*0.5 > lz1 then lz1 = q.Z+s.Z*0.5 end
                ln = ln + 1
            end end end
    if ln == 0 then return _fallbackBox(plot) end
    local sx0,sx1,sn = math.huge,-math.huge, 0
    local zbins = {}
    local zEdge = {}
    for _, p in ipairs(plot:GetDescendants()) do
        if p:IsA("BasePart") and p.Name:lower():find("structure base", 1, true)
           and not (_inPlotFolder(p, "CashPad", plot) or _inPlotFolder(p, "Cash", plot)) then
            local q,s = p.Position, p.Size
            local _yOK
            if _G.JAF_TallWallOverlap ~= false then
                _yOK = (q.Y + s.Y*0.5 >= floorY-3) and (q.Y - s.Y*0.5 <= roofY+5)
            else
                _yOK = (q.Y >= floorY-3 and q.Y <= roofY+5)
            end
            if _yOK and math.abs(q.X) < 50000 and math.abs(q.Z) < 50000 then
                if q.X-s.X*0.5 < sx0 then sx0 = q.X-s.X*0.5 end
                if q.X+s.X*0.5 > sx1 then sx1 = q.X+s.X*0.5 end
                local zb = math.floor(q.Z/4 + 0.5)
                zbins[zb] = (zbins[zb] or 0) + 1
                local _pmn, _pmx = q.Z - s.Z*0.5, q.Z + s.Z*0.5
                local _e = zEdge[zb]
                if not _e then zEdge[zb] = { _pmn, _pmx } else if _pmn < _e[1] then _e[1]=_pmn end; if _pmx > _e[2] then _e[2]=_pmx end end
                sn = sn + 1
            end end end
    if sn < 3 then return _fallbackBox(plot) end
    local maxc = 0
    for _, c in pairs(zbins) do if c > maxc then maxc = c end end
    local zmin, zmax = math.huge, -math.huge
    local thr = maxc * (_G.JAF_BaseSideBandFrac or 0.25)
    for zb, c in pairs(zbins) do
        if c >= thr then
            local _e = zEdge[zb]
            local _emn = (_G.JAF_ZExtentRealEdges ~= false and _e) and _e[1] or (zb*4 - 2)
            local _emx = (_G.JAF_ZExtentRealEdges ~= false and _e) and _e[2] or (zb*4 + 2)
            if _emn < zmin then zmin = _emn end
            if _emx > zmax then zmax = _emx end
        end end
    if zmin == math.huge then zmin, zmax = lz0, lz1 end
    local xmin, xmax
    if (lx0+lx1)*0.5 >= (sx0+sx1)*0.5 then xmin, xmax = sx0, lx1 else xmin, xmax = lx0, sx1 end
    return xmin, xmax, zmin, zmax, floorY, roofY
end
_G.JAF_CurrentBase = function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE), ERROR_HANDLING(false))
    local c = LocalPlayer.Character
    local hrp = c and c:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not hrp then return nil end
    local q = hrp.Position
    for _, b in ipairs(_baseFootprints) do
        if q.X >= b.minX and q.X <= b.maxX and q.Z >= b.minZ and q.Z <= b.maxZ
           and q.Y >= b.minY - 5 and q.Y <= b.maxY + 8 then
            return b.plot
        end end
    return nil
end
task.spawn(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE), ERROR_HANDLING(false))
    local _fpCache = {}

    local function _publishFootprints() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE), ERROR_HANDLING(false))
        local fps = {}

    while true do
        local plots = Workspace:FindFirstChild("Plots")

            local now = tick()

            for _, plot in ipairs(plots:GetChildren()) do
                local pn = plot.Name

                if (not c) or c.plotRef ~= plot or (now - c.t) > backup then
                    local mnx,mxx,mnz,mxz,floorY,roofY = _baseBoxFromXray(plot)
                    if not mnx then mnx,mxx,mnz,mxz,floorY,roofY = _baseBox(plot) end
                    if mnx then
                        _fpCache[pn] = { plotRef = plot, t = now, fp = { plot=pn, minX=mnx, maxX=mxx, minZ=mnz, maxZ=mxz, minY=floorY, maxY=roofY } }
                        if _G.JAF_FootprintIncremental ~= false then _publishFootprints() end
                    else
                        _fpCache[pn] = nil

            for pn, c in pairs(_fpCache) do if not (c.plotRef and c.plotRef.Parent) then _fpCache[pn] = nil end end
        end
        local fps = _publishFootprints()
        if not _mbDone and not _G.JAF_MapBoundsUserSet and #fps > 0 then
            local mb
            local bbMinX, bbMaxX, bbMinZ, bbMaxZ = math.huge, -math.huge, math.huge, -math.huge
            for _, f in ipairs(fps) do
                if f.minX then
                    bbMinX = math.min(bbMinX, f.minX); bbMaxX = math.max(bbMaxX, f.maxX)
                    bbMinZ = math.min(bbMinZ, f.minZ); bbMaxZ = math.max(bbMaxZ, f.maxZ)
                end end
            pcall(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE), ERROR_HANDLING(false))
                local map = Workspace:FindFirstChild("Map")
                if map then
                    local mnx, mxx, mnz, mxz = math.huge, -math.huge, math.huge, -math.huge
                    local found = false
                    for _, p in ipairs(map:GetDescendants()) do
                        if p:IsA("BasePart") then
                            local s = p.Size
                            if math.max(s.X, s.Z) > (_G.JAF_MapWallMinLen or 90) and math.min(s.X, s.Z) < 12 and s.Y > 6 then
                                local cf = p.CFrame
                                local wx = math.abs(cf.RightVector.X) * s.X + math.abs(cf.UpVector.X) * s.Y + math.abs(cf.LookVector.X) * s.Z
                                local wz = math.abs(cf.RightVector.Z) * s.X + math.abs(cf.UpVector.Z) * s.Y + math.abs(cf.LookVector.Z) * s.Z
                                local c = p.Position
                                mnx = math.min(mnx, c.X - wx / 2); mxx = math.max(mxx, c.X + wx / 2)
                                mnz = math.min(mnz, c.Z - wz / 2); mxz = math.max(mxz, c.Z + wz / 2)

               and mb.minX <= bbMinX and mb.maxX >= bbMaxX and mb.minZ <= bbMinZ and mb.maxZ >= bbMaxZ then

-- ============================================================
-- X-RAY BASE core (ported from Extras.txt "X-RAY (portage de mynxx)")
-- Scales each touched object's real transparency toward 1 by _G.XRayAlpha,
-- tracks a fixed folder set per plot via DescendantAdded, and restores the
-- exact originals on disable. Laser / FPS-Boost hooks from mynxx are kept but
-- guarded (absent here -> no-op), exactly as in Extras.
-- ============================================================
local XRAY_FOLDERS = { "Base", "PlotSign", "FriendPanel", "Cash",
                       "Decorations", "Skin", "Unlock", "Purchases" }

local function _xraySetTransparency(instance, alpha, id)
    if not instance then return end
    if id and id ~= _xrayLoopId then return end

    local function apply(obj)
        local laser = _G.__laser
        if laser and laser.IsLaserObject and laser.IsLaserObject(obj) then
            local plot = laser.GetPlotFromObject and laser.GetPlotFromObject(obj)
            if plot and laser.IsPlotBaseOpen and laser.IsPlotBaseOpen(plot) then
                if laser.SaveLaserOriginal then laser.SaveLaserOriginal(obj) end
                if laser.HideLaserObject then laser.HideLaserObject(obj) end
            end
            return
        end
        if obj:IsA("BasePart") or obj:IsA("Decal") or obj:IsA("Texture") then
            if xrayOrigT[obj] == nil then xrayOrigT[obj] = obj.Transparency end
            local o = xrayOrigT[obj]
            if o < 1 then
                local target = alpha
                if math.abs(obj.Transparency - target) > 0.01 then obj.Transparency = target end
            end
        elseif obj:IsA("TextLabel") or obj:IsA("TextButton") then
            if xrayOrigT[obj] == nil then
                local t, b = obj.TextTransparency, obj.BackgroundTransparency
                if t == alpha then t = 0 end
                if b == alpha then b = 0 end
                xrayOrigT[obj] = { text = t, bg = b }
            end
            local o = xrayOrigT[obj]
            if o.text < 1 then
                local tt = o.text + (1 - o.text) * alpha
                if math.abs(obj.TextTransparency - tt) > 0.01 then obj.TextTransparency = tt end
            end
            if o.bg < 1 then
                local tb = o.bg + (1 - o.bg) * alpha
                if math.abs(obj.BackgroundTransparency - tb) > 0.01 then obj.BackgroundTransparency = tb end
            end
        elseif obj:IsA("Frame") or obj:IsA("ScrollingFrame") then
            if xrayOrigT[obj] == nil then
                if obj.BackgroundTransparency == alpha then xrayOrigT[obj] = 0
                else xrayOrigT[obj] = obj.BackgroundTransparency end
            end
            local o = xrayOrigT[obj]
            if o < 1 then
                local target = o + (1 - o) * alpha
                if math.abs(obj.BackgroundTransparency - target) > 0.01 then obj.BackgroundTransparency = target end
            end
        elseif obj:IsA("ImageLabel") or obj:IsA("ImageButton") then
            if xrayOrigT[obj] == nil then
                local i, b = obj.ImageTransparency, obj.BackgroundTransparency
                if i == alpha then i = 0 end
                if b == alpha then b = 0 end
                xrayOrigT[obj] = { img = i, bg = b }
            end
            local o = xrayOrigT[obj]
            if o.img < 1 then
                local ti = o.img + (1 - o.img) * alpha
                if math.abs(obj.ImageTransparency - ti) > 0.01 then obj.ImageTransparency = ti end
            end
            if o.bg < 1 then
                local tb = o.bg + (1 - o.bg) * alpha
                if math.abs(obj.BackgroundTransparency - tb) > 0.01 then obj.BackgroundTransparency = tb end
            end
        end
    end

    apply(instance)
    local desc = instance:GetDescendants()
    for i, child in ipairs(desc) do
        apply(child)
        if i % 300 == 0 then
            task.wait()
            if id and id ~= _xrayLoopId then return end
        end
    end
end

local function _xrayTrackSubtree(root, alpha, id)
    if not root then return end
    if id ~= _xrayLoopId then return end
    _xraySetTransparency(root, alpha, id)
    if id ~= _xrayLoopId then return end
    _xrayConns[#_xrayConns + 1] = root.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(obj)
        if id ~= _xrayLoopId then return end
        _xraySetTransparency(obj, alpha, id)
    end)
end

local function _xrayProcessPlot(plot, alpha, id)
    if not plot then return end
    if id ~= _xrayLoopId then return end
    for _, fname in ipairs(XRAY_FOLDERS) do
        if id ~= _xrayLoopId then return end
        _xrayTrackSubtree(plot:FindFirstChild(fname), alpha, id)
    end
    if id ~= _xrayLoopId then return end
    _xrayConns[#_xrayConns + 1] = plot.ChildAdded:Connect(function(child)
        if id ~= _xrayLoopId then return end
        for _, fname in ipairs(XRAY_FOLDERS) do
            if child.Name == fname then _xrayTrackSubtree(child, alpha, id); break end
        end
    end)

    local podiums = plot:FindFirstChild("AnimalPodiums")
    if podiums then
        local function processPodium(podium)
            for _, child in ipairs(podium:GetChildren()) do
                if child.Name == "Claim" then
                    _xrayTrackSubtree(child, alpha, id)
                elseif child.Name == "Base" then
                    _xrayTrackSubtree(child:FindFirstChild("Decorations"), alpha, id)
                elseif child:IsA("Model") and child.Name ~= "Decorations" then
                    _xrayTrackSubtree(child, alpha, id)
                end
            end
        end
        for _, podium in ipairs(podiums:GetChildren()) do processPodium(podium) end
        _xrayConns[#_xrayConns + 1] = podiums.ChildAdded:Connect(function(podium)
            if id ~= _xrayLoopId then return end
            task.wait(0.1)
            if id ~= _xrayLoopId then return end
            processPodium(podium)
        end)
    end
end

local function _xrayApplyAllPlots(alpha, id)
    local plots = Workspace:FindFirstChild("Plots")
    if not plots then return end
    for _, plot in ipairs(plots:GetChildren()) do
        if id ~= _xrayLoopId then return end
        _xrayProcessPlot(plot, alpha, id)
    end
    _xrayConns[#_xrayConns + 1] = plots.ChildAdded:Connect(function(plot)
        if id ~= _xrayLoopId then return end
        task.wait(0.2)
        _xrayProcessPlot(plot, alpha, id)
    end)
end

local _xrayReapplyPending = false
local _xrayPlayerConn = nil
local function _xraySet(enabled)
    xrayEnabled = enabled

    for _, c in ipairs(_xrayConns) do
        if typeof(c) == "RBXScriptConnection" then c:Disconnect() end
    end
    _xrayConns = {}

    _xrayLoopId = _xrayLoopId + 1
    local id = _xrayLoopId

    if enabled then
        local alpha = math.clamp(tonumber(_G.XRayAlpha) or 0.60, 0, 1)
        task.spawn(function()
            while id == _xrayLoopId and not Workspace:FindFirstChild("Plots") do
                task.wait()
            end
            if id ~= _xrayLoopId then return end
            pcall(_xrayApplyAllPlots, alpha, id)
        end)
        -- Re-apply when a player joins after us: their base streams in late and
        -- may not fire a clean Plots ChildAdded. Debounced.
        if not _xrayPlayerConn then
            _xrayPlayerConn = game:GetService("Players").PlayerAdded:Connect(function()
                if not xrayEnabled then return end
                if _xrayReapplyPending then return end
                _xrayReapplyPending = true
                task.spawn(function()
                    task.wait(0.5)
                    _xrayReapplyPending = false
                    if xrayEnabled then pcall(_xraySet, true) end
                end)
            end)
        end
    else
        -- OFF: swap the snapshot then restore everything in one synchronous pass
        -- so a quick re-enable can't overlap and leave walls transparent.
        local snap = xrayOrigT
        xrayOrigT = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
        for obj, o in pairs(snap) do
            pcall(function()
                if obj:IsA("BasePart") or obj:IsA("Decal") or obj:IsA("Texture") then
                    obj.Transparency = o
                elseif obj:IsA("TextLabel") or obj:IsA("TextButton") then
                    obj.TextTransparency = o.text
                    obj.BackgroundTransparency = o.bg
                elseif obj:IsA("Frame") or obj:IsA("ScrollingFrame") then
                    obj.BackgroundTransparency = o
                elseif obj:IsA("ImageLabel") or obj:IsA("ImageButton") then
                    obj.ImageTransparency = o.img
                    obj.BackgroundTransparency = o.bg
                end
            end)
        end
        local fps = _G.OriginalTransparency
        if type(fps) == "table" then
            for part, data in pairs(fps) do
                if part and part.Parent and typeof(data) == "table" and data.trans then
                    pcall(function() part.Transparency = data.trans end)
                end
            end
        end
        local laser = _G.__laser
        if laser and laser.RefreshAllPlotLasers then
            pcall(laser.RefreshAllPlotLasers)
        end
    end
end

local function enableXray()  _xraySet(true)  end
local function disableXray() _xraySet(false) end
_G.setXRay = _xraySet
_G.toggleXRay = function() _xraySet(not xrayEnabled) end

ch.Parent = LocalPlayer.Backpack end) end end

-- Manual reset adapted from the user's message (24).txt.
-- No standalone window, extra keybind, menu override or automatic damage reset.
-- Retains its upward velocity hold, camera hold and queued respawn press.
local SneizzyInstantReset = (function()
    if _G.SneizzyResetCleanup then pcall(_G.SneizzyResetCleanup) end
    local connections = {}
    local active, busy, queuedUntil = true, false, 0
    local releaseHold
    local reset
    local function track(connection)
        connections[#connections+1] = connection
        return connection
    end
    local function restoreCamera(character)
        local camera = Workspace.CurrentCamera
        if not camera then return end
        camera.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Custom
        local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if humanoid then camera.CameraSubject = humanoid end
    end
    local function holdCamera(character)
        if releaseHold then releaseHold() end
        local camera = Workspace.CurrentCamera
        if not camera then return end
        local cf, focus = camera.CFrame, camera.Focus
        camera.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Scriptable
        local connection = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
            if Workspace.CurrentCamera ~= camera then return end
            camera.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Scriptable
            camera.CFrame, camera.Focus = cf, focus
        end)
        local released = false
        local function release()
            if released then return end
            released = true
            connection:Disconnect()
            restoreCamera(LocalPlayer.Character)
            releaseHold = nil
        end
        releaseHold = release
        task.delay(3, release)
    end
    local function flingBody(character)
        local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not root or not root:IsA("BasePart") then return false end
        local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        local previousStand = humanoid and humanoid.PlatformStand
        if humanoid then pcall(function()
            humanoid.PlatformStand = true
            humanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Freefall)
        end) end
        local function pulse()
            if not active or not root.Parent or LocalPlayer.Character ~= character then return false end
            return pcall(function()
                root.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
                root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(0,1000000,0)
            end)
        end
        -- First pulse is synchronous, then reinforce every physics step for 1.5s.
        local ok = pulse()
        if ok then task.spawn(function()
            local elapsed = 0
            while active and elapsed < 1.5 do
                elapsed += RunService.PreSimulation:Wait()
                if not pulse() then break end
            end
        end) end
        -- If the server rejects the reset, don't leave the same living body limp.
        task.delay(2, function()
            if active and LocalPlayer.Character == character and humanoid and humanoid.Parent and humanoid.Health > 0 then
                humanoid.PlatformStand = previousStand
            end
        end)
        return ok
    end
    reset = function()
        if not active then return false end
        if busy then return true end
        local character = LocalPlayer.Character
        local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not character or not humanoid or not root or not root:IsA("BasePart") then
            queuedUntil = os.clock()+15
            return true
        end
        if humanoid.Health <= 0 then
            flingBody(character)
            queuedUntil = os.clock()+15
            return true
        end
        busy = true
        holdCamera(character)
        local ok = flingBody(character)
        if not ok and releaseHold then releaseHold() end
        task.delay(3, function() if LocalPlayer.Character == character then busy = false end end)
        return ok
    end
    track(LocalPlayer.CharacterRemoving:Connect(function()
        if releaseHold then releaseHold() end
    end))
    track(LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(character)
        busy = false
        if releaseHold then releaseHold() end
        task.spawn(function()
            local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") or character:WaitForChild("Humanoid",5)
            if not active or LocalPlayer.Character ~= character then return end
            restoreCamera(character)
            if queuedUntil == 0 then return end
            local root = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart",5)
            local pending = os.clock() <= queuedUntil
            queuedUntil = 0
            if active and pending and LocalPlayer.Character == character and humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 and root then reset() end
        end)
    end))
    _G.SneizzyResetCleanup = function()
        active = false
        queuedUntil = 0
        for _,connection in ipairs(connections) do connection:Disconnect() end
        if releaseHold then releaseHold() end
    end
    return reset
end)()

executeReset = function()
    if not SAB_LIVE() then return end
    return SneizzyInstantReset()
end

    local myPlot
    for _, plot in ipairs(plots:GetChildren()) do
        local sign = plot:FindFirstChild("PlotSign")
        if sign then
            local yb = sign:FindFirstChild("YourBase")
            if yb and yb:IsA("BillboardGui") and yb.Enabled then myPlot = plot; break end
        end end
    if not myPlot then return false end
    local sh = myPlot:FindFirstChild("StealHitbox")
    if not sh or not sh:IsA("BasePart") then return false end
    local rel = sh.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(hrp.Position)
    local half = sh.Size * 0.5
    local m = 5
    return math.abs(rel.X) <= half.X + m and math.abs(rel.Y) <= half.Y + m and math.abs(rel.Z) <= half.Z + m

            if grace > 0 then

            elseif not stuck and lastTarget then

                            local ok = pcall(start)

    local armed, autoOn = false, false

        if _G.NeegyDropActive or _G.NeegyDropInvisBlocked then armed = false; autoOn = false; return end

-- On-screen diagnostic: shows a Roblox toast when invis engages/fails, so you can

-- _G.SneizzyInvisDebug guard (set it false) to silence.

-- Bridge: point sneizzy's invis API at the neegy engine. task.defer guarantees this

task.defer(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(ERROR_HANDLING(false))

        else
            local ok, started = pcall(_G.TacoInvisStart)
            if _G.__SneizzyInvisNotify then
                _G.__SneizzyInvisNotify(ok and (started and "ON" or "start returned false") or ("error: " .. tostring(started)))
            end
        end
        _G.invisibleStealEnabled = _G.TacoInvisActive == true
    end
    -- keep sneizzy's readers in sync with neegy's real active state (covers internal
    -- restarts / respawn stops that bypass the toggle)
    task.spawn(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(ERROR_HANDLING(false))
        while true do
            _G.invisibleStealEnabled = _G.TacoInvisActive == true
            task.wait(0.1)
        end
    end)
end)

function SharedState.ANTI_BEE_DISCO.protectControls() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE), ERROR_HANDLING(false))

    pcall(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE), ERROR_HANDLING(false))

            if not ab.running or not Config.AntiBeeDisco then return end
            if Controls.moveFunction ~= protectedMoveFunction then Controls.moveFunction = protectedMoveFunction end
        end))
        Controls.moveFunction = protectedMoveFunction
        ab.controlsProtected = true
    end) end
function SharedState.ANTI_BEE_DISCO.restoreControls() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE), ERROR_HANDLING(false))
    if not SharedState.ANTI_BEE_DISCO.controlsProtected then return end
    pcall(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE), ERROR_HANDLING(false))
        local PlayerModule = LocalPlayer.PlayerScripts:FindFirstChild("PlayerModule")
        if not PlayerModule then return end
        local Controls = require(PlayerModule):GetControls()

        if Controls and ab.originalMoveFunction then Controls.moveFunction = ab.originalMoveFunction ab.controlsProtected = false end
    end) end
function SharedState.ANTI_BEE_DISCO.blockBuzzingSound() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE), ERROR_HANDLING(false))
    pcall(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE), ERROR_HANDLING(false))
        local beeScript = LocalPlayer.PlayerScripts:FindFirstChild("Bee", true)

        end end) end

function SharedState.ANTI_BEE_DISCO.Enable() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE), ERROR_HANDLING(false))
    local ab = SharedState.ANTI_BEE_DISCO
    if ab.running then return end
    ab.running = true
    for _, inst in ipairs(Lighting:GetDescendants()) do ab.nuke(inst) end
    table.insert(ab.connections, Lighting.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(obj) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE), ERROR_HANDLING(false))
        if not ab.running or not Config.AntiBeeDisco then return end
        ab.nuke(obj)
    end))
    ab.protectControls()
    ab.normalizeControls()
    ab._nextBuzzCheck = 0
    table.insert(ab.connections, RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE), ERROR_HANDLING(false))
        if not ab.running or not Config.AntiBeeDisco then return end
        ab.normalizeControls()

    end)) end
function SharedState.ANTI_BEE_DISCO.Disable() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE), ERROR_HANDLING(false))
    local ab = SharedState.ANTI_BEE_DISCO
    if not ab.running then return end
    ab.running = false
    ab.restoreControls()

end

task.spawn(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE), ERROR_HANDLING(false))
    _G.JAF_WaitHeavy()
    local playerESPEnabled = Config.PlayerESP
    local playerBillboards = {}
    -- Persistent ESP folder. The BillboardGui MUST NOT be parented to the
    -- player's HumanoidRootPart: with StreamingEnabled the character model
    -- gets streamed out at distance, which destroys/orphans the HRP and yanks
    -- the billboard with it. The 0.5s refresh loop then sees `bb.Parent == nil`,
    -- destroys+recreates the bb, and at the streaming-edge the cycle repeats
    -- every tick → the ESP flickers (detect → lose → detect → …).
    -- Parenting to a persistent folder + only pointing Adornee at the HRP
    -- keeps the bb alive across stream-out/respawn and removes the flicker.
    local espFolder = Workspace:FindFirstChild("JAF_PlayerESPFolder")
    if not espFolder then
        espFolder = Instance.new("Folder")
        espFolder.Name = "JAF_PlayerESPFolder"
        espFolder.Parent = Workspace
    end
    local makePlayerBillboard; makePlayerBillboard = (function(player) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE), ERROR_HANDLING(false))
        local bb = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
        _P(bb, "Name", "PlayerESP_"..tostring(player.UserId), "Size", UDim2.new(0, 100, 0, 20), "StudsOffsetWorldSpace", Vector3.new(0, 2.8, 0))
        bb.AlwaysOnTop = true; bb.LightInfluence = 0; bb.ResetOnSpawn = false
        bb.MaxDistance = 0
        local nameLbl = JUI.new("TextLabel", bb, "Size", UDim2.new(1,0,1,0), "BackgroundTransparency", 1, "Font", Enum.Font.GothamBlack, "TextSize", 13)

    local function getHRP(player) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(ERROR_HANDLING(false))

        if not char.Parent then return nil end
        return char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    end
    local createOrRefresh; createOrRefresh = (function(player) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE), ERROR_HANDLING(false))
        if player == LocalPlayer then return end
        local hrp = getHRP(player)
        local hum = player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
        if hum then hum.DisplayDistanceType = Enum.HumanoidDisplayDistanceType.None end
        local uid = player.UserId
        local entry = playerBillboards[uid]
        -- Character not loaded / streamed out: keep the bb alive but drop the
        -- adornee so it doesn't render at a stale position. The next loop tick
        -- picks it back up automatically when the HRP is back.
        if not hrp then
            if entry and entry.bb and entry.bb.Adornee then entry.bb.Adornee = nil end
            return
        end
        if not entry or not entry.bb or not entry.bb.Parent then
            if entry and entry.bb then pcall(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(ERROR_HANDLING(false))
entry.bb:Destroy() end) end
            local bb, nameLbl = makePlayerBillboard(player)
            bb.Adornee = hrp
            playerBillboards[uid] = {bb=bb, nameLbl=nameLbl, player=player, hrp=hrp}
        else
            -- Only touch the Adornee. NEVER re-parent to the HRP — that's the
            -- bug that caused the flicker (re-parenting to a streamed-out HRP
            -- yanks the bb out of the persistent folder and into the void).
            if entry.hrp ~= hrp or entry.bb.Adornee ~= hrp then
                entry.bb.Adornee = hrp
                entry.hrp = hrp
            end
        end end)
    local function clearAll() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE), ERROR_HANDLING(false))
        for uid, entry in pairs(playerBillboards) do
            if entry.bb and entry.bb.Parent then pcall(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(ERROR_HANDLING(false))
entry.bb:Destroy() end) end
            local p = Players:GetPlayerByUserId(uid)
            if p and p.Character then
                local h = p.Character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
                if h then h.DisplayDistanceType = Enum.HumanoidDisplayDistanceType.Viewer end
            end
            playerBillboards[uid] = nil
        end end

        playerESPEnabled = enabled
        if not enabled then clearAll() end
    end
    task.spawn(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE), ERROR_HANDLING(false))
        while true do
            -- Faster refresh (0.15s instead of 0.5s): when a streamed-out
            -- character comes back into range, the bb re-attaches within
            -- 150ms instead of up to 500ms → no visible flicker.
            task.wait(0.15)
            if playerESPEnabled then
            for uid, entry in pairs(playerBillboards) do
                if not Players:GetPlayerByUserId(uid) then
                    if entry.bb and entry.bb.Parent then pcall(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(ERROR_HANDLING(false))
entry.bb:Destroy() end) end
                    playerBillboards[uid] = nil
                end end
            for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do if player ~= LocalPlayer then pcall(createOrRefresh, player) end end
            end end end)
    -- Removed the _espWait() delay on CharacterAdded: with the persistent-
    -- folder fix the bb survives stream-out, so we can re-attach immediately
    -- when the character respawns instead of waiting 0.5-0.9s (which caused
    -- a visible flicker every respawn).
    Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(p) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE), ERROR_HANDLING(false))

            if playerESPEnabled then pcall(createOrRefresh, p) end
        end) end)
    for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if p ~= LocalPlayer then
            p.CharacterAdded:Connect(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE), ERROR_HANDLING(false))
                if playerESPEnabled then pcall(createOrRefresh, p) end
            end) end end end)

        local petList = {}
        for petName, data in pairs(AnimalsData) do
            if data.Rarity == rarityName and not petName:find("Lucky Block") then table.insert(petList, petName) end
        end
        table.sort(petList)
        return petList
    end
    local secretPets = {}

        end end
    table.sort(secretPets)
    local mutRoster = _G.JAF_MutRoster or {}
    local function _mutMod(nm) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE), ERROR_HANDLING(false))
        for _, m in ipairs(mutRoster) do if m.name == nm then return m.mod end end
        return 0
    end
    local function _mutModText(nm) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE), ERROR_HANDLING(false))
        local mod = _mutMod(nm)
        if mod == 0 then return "" end
        return string.format("x%g", 1 + mod)
    end

                local idx = data.Index or petName
                local okG, gv = pcall(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(ERROR_HANDLING(false))
return _G.JAF_SafeGen(idx, nil, nil, nil) end)
                local g = (okG and tonumber(gv)) or 0

    local priorityGenFilter = _G.JAF_ParseGen(Config.PriorityGenFilter or "")

    do

        local _changed = false
        for _, rar in ipairs({ "Secret", "OG" }) do
            if not Config.KnownSecretRarities[rar] then
                for _, nm in ipairs(getPetsByRarity(rar)) do Config.KnownSecrets[nm] = true end
                Config.KnownSecretRarities[rar] = true
                _changed = true
            end end
        if _changed then pcall(SaveConfig) end
    end
    if type(Config.NewSecretsBatch) ~= "table" then Config.NewSecretsBatch = {} end
    do

        for _, nm in ipairs(secretPets) do _rosterSet[nm] = true end
        for _, nm in ipairs(Config.NewSecretsBatch) do _batchSet[nm] = true end
        local _fresh = {}
        for _, nm in ipairs(secretPets) do if not Config.KnownSecrets[nm] and not _batchSet[nm] then _fresh[#_fresh + 1] = nm end end
        if #_fresh > 0 then
            for _, nm in ipairs(Config.NewSecretsBatch) do Config.KnownSecrets[nm] = true end
            Config.NewSecretsBatch = _fresh
            pcall(SaveConfig)
        else
            local _kept = {}
            for _, nm in ipairs(Config.NewSecretsBatch) do if _rosterSet[nm] then _kept[#_kept + 1] = nm end end
            if #_kept ~= #Config.NewSecretsBatch then Config.NewSecretsBatch = _kept; pcall(SaveConfig) end
        end end

        if (decoded.t == "mut") ~= isMut then return end
        local arr = decoded
        if isMut then arr = decoded.v end
        if type(arr) ~= "table" then return end
        local newList = {}
        for _, v in ipairs(arr) do if type(v) == "string" then newList[#newList + 1] = v end end
        if #newList == 0 then return end
        if isMut then
            local seen, merged, inRoster = {}, {}, {}
            for _, m in ipairs(mutRoster) do inRoster[m.name] = true end
            for _, v in ipairs(newList) do if inRoster[v] and not seen[v] then seen[v] = true; merged[#merged + 1] = v end end
            for _, m in ipairs(mutRoster) do if not seen[m.name] then seen[m.name] = true; merged[#merged + 1] = m.name end end
            newList = merged
        end
        local LIST = _curList()
        for idx = #LIST, 1, -1 do LIST[idx] = nil end
        for _, v in ipairs(newList) do LIST[#LIST + 1] = v end
        _curSave(); refreshPriorityList(); refreshAvailableList()
        if priImportBox then priImportBox.Text = "" end
    end)
    local function _paintSeg(btn, on) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE), ERROR_HANDLING(false))

        _paintSeg(tabBrainrotBtn, not isMut)

        local _mutOn = Config.MutationPriorityEnabled ~= false
        local _mutOff = isMut and not _mutOn
        availableLabel.Text = "AVAILABLE SECRET / OG BRAINROTS"

        resetOrderBtn.Visible, mutOnOffBtn.Visible = isMut, isMut
        priorityScroll.Size, priorityScroll.Position = isMut and UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, -30) or UDim2.new(0.45, 0, 1, -30), isMut and UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 30) or UDim2.new(0.55, 0, 0, 30)
        priorityLabel.Size, priorityLabel.Position = isMut and UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 25) or UDim2.new(0.45, 0, 0, 25), isMut and UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0) or UDim2.new(0.55, 0, 0, 0)
        priorityLabel.Text      = (not isMut) and "PRIORITY LIST"
            or (_mutOff and "MUTATIONS OFF  --  this order is saved but not used"
                        or  "TOP = PREFERRED  --  only decides between two of the SAME brainrot")
        priorityLabel.TextColor3 = _mutOff and Theme.Error or Theme.TextPrimary
        priorityScroll.BackgroundTransparency = _mutOff and 0.55 or 0
        if isMut and availableFilter ~= "" then availableFilter = ""; searchBox.Text = "" end
        mutOnOffBtn.Text             = "USE MUTATIONS: " .. (_mutOn and "ON" or "OFF")
        mutOnOffBtn.BackgroundColor3 = _mutOn and Theme.SurfaceHighlight or Theme.Error
        mutOnOffBtn.TextColor3       = _mutOn and Theme.TextSecondary or _G.JAF_OnAccent(Theme.Error)
        saveBtn.Text = isMut and "SAVE MUTATIONS" or "SAVE PRIORITY"
        priImportBox.PlaceholderText = isMut
            and "Paste a MUTATION list code here, then press IMPORT LIST ->"
            or  "Paste a priority list code here, then press IMPORT LIST ->"
        if not skipRefresh then refreshAvailableList(); refreshPriorityList() end
    end
    mutOnOffBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE), ERROR_HANDLING(false))

    local function _sliderRow(parent, order, label, lo, hi, step, saveOnDrag, init, apply, fmt, hint, valW, roundStep) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE), ERROR_HANDLING(false))
        local span = hi - lo
        local vw = valW or 60
        local cs = C()
        local r = JUI.new("Frame", parent, "Size", UDim2.new(1,0,0,46), "BackgroundColor3", cs.SURF, "BackgroundTransparency", 0.08, "BorderSizePixel", 0, "LayoutOrder", order)

        local val = JUI.new("TextLabel", r, "Size", UDim2.new(0,vw,0,17), "Position", UDim2.new(1,-(vw+8),0,3), "BackgroundTransparency", 1, "Font", Enum.Font.GothamMedium, "TextSize", 11, "TextColor3", Theme.Accent1, "TextXAlignment", Enum.TextXAlignment.Right)
        if hint then
            JUI.new("TextLabel", r, "Size", UDim2.new(0,130,0,14), "Position", UDim2.new(1,-140,0,20), "BackgroundTransparency", 1, "Text", hint, "Font", Enum.Font.GothamMedium, "TextSize", 10, "TextColor3", cs.TS, "TextXAlignment", Enum.TextXAlignment.Right, "TextTruncate", Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd)
        end
        local bg = JUI.new("Frame", r, "Size", UDim2.new(1,-20,0,4), "Position", UDim2.new(0,10,0,31), "BackgroundColor3", cs.SH, "BorderSizePixel", 0)
        JUI.round(bg)
        local fill = JUI.new("Frame", bg, "BackgroundColor3", Theme.Accent1, "BorderSizePixel", 0, "Size", UDim2.new(0,0,1,0))
        JUI.round(fill)
        local knob = JUI.new("Frame", bg, "Size", UDim2.new(0,11,0,11), "AnchorPoint", Vector2.new(0.5,0.5), "BackgroundColor3", cs.TP, "BorderSizePixel", 0)
        JUI.round(knob)
        local function upd(v) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE), ERROR_HANDLING(false))
            if roundStep and step and step > 0 then v = math.floor(v/step + 0.5) * step
            elseif step == 1 then v = math.floor(v)
            elseif step == 0.1 then v = math.floor(v*10)/10
            elseif step and step > 0 then v = math.floor(v/step + 0.5) * step end
            v = math.clamp(v, lo, hi)
            apply(v)
            val.Text = fmt and fmt(v) or tostring(v)
            local p2 = (v - lo) / span
            fill.Size = UDim2.new(p2,0,1,0)
            knob.Position = UDim2.new(p2,0,0.5,0)
            if saveOnDrag then SaveConfig() end
        end
        upd(init)
        local function _at(x) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(ERROR_HANDLING(false))
return lo + math.clamp((x - bg.AbsolutePosition.X) / bg.AbsoluteSize.X, 0, 1) * span end
        local drag = false
        bg.InputBegan:Connect(function(i) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE), ERROR_HANDLING(false))
            if i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                drag = true; upd(_at(i.Position.X))
            end end)
        _setUISConn(UserInputService.InputEnded, function(i) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE), ERROR_HANDLING(false))
            if drag and (i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
                drag = false
                if not saveOnDrag then SaveConfig() end
            end end)
        _setUISConn(UserInputService.InputChanged, function(i) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE), ERROR_HANDLING(false))
            if drag and (i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
                upd(_at(i.Position.X))
            end end)
        return r, upd
    end

                set(o.v); SaveConfig(); refresh()
            end) end
        refresh()

            local rail = tb:FindFirstChild("TabRail"); if rail then rail.BackgroundTransparency = on and 0 or 1 end
        end end

    end
    local function layoutTray() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE), ERROR_HANDLING(false))
        local s = guiSize()
        local bx, by = btnPx()
        local h = math.clamp(s.Y - by - 16, 140, 300)
        tray.Size = UDim2.new(0, TRAY_W, 0, h)
        local x = (bx + SZ + 8 + TRAY_W <= s.X) and (bx + SZ + 8) or math.max(4, bx - TRAY_W - 8)
        local y = math.clamp(by, 4, math.max(4, s.Y - h - 4))
        tray.Position = UDim2.new(0, math.floor(x), 0, math.floor(y))
