_G.JAF_SheetMaxW = 760
function _G.JAF_SheetPin(p) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE), ERROR_HANDLING(false))
    if p and p:GetAttribute("SneizzyLiveLayout") then return false end
    if not (p and p.Parent) then return false end
    local ps = p.Parent.AbsoluteSize
    if ps.X < 10 then return false end
    local M = 8
    local k = _G.JAF_PanelScale(p)
    local availW, availH = ps.X - M * 2, ps.Y - M * 2
    local wantW = math.min(availW, _G.JAF_SheetMaxW)
    p.Size = UDim2.new(0, math.max(280, wantW / k), 0, math.max(220, availH / k))
    p.Position = UDim2.new(0, math.floor(M + (availW - wantW) / 2), 0, M)
    p:SetAttribute("JAFSheetPinned", true)
    return true
end
_G.JAF_MobileApplySheet = function(panel, side, navBox, content, cArea, topbar, tScrolls) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE), ERROR_HANDLING(false))
    if panel and panel:GetAttribute("SneizzyLiveLayout") then return end
    if not panel or not panel.Parent then return end
    if not (_G.JAF_MobileOn() and Config.MobileSheet ~= false) then return end
    local ps = panel.Parent.AbsoluteSize
    if ps.X < 10 then return end
    local STRIP = 46
    if not _G.JAF_SheetPin(panel) then return end
    if side then
        side.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, STRIP)
        side.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
        for _, ch in ipairs(side:GetChildren()) do if ch:IsA("GuiObject") and ch ~= navBox then ch.Visible = false end end
        if navBox then
            local wrap = side:FindFirstChild("JAFMobileNavWrap")
            if not wrap then
                wrap = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame")
                _P(wrap, "Name", "JAFMobileNavWrap", "BackgroundTransparency", 1, "BorderSizePixel", 0, "ScrollBarThickness", 0, "ScrollingDirection", Enum.ScrollingDirection.X, "AutomaticCanvasSize", Enum.AutomaticSize.X, "CanvasSize", UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0), "Parent", side)
            end
            _P(wrap, "Visible", true, "Size", UDim2.new(1, -10, 1, -8), "Position", UDim2.new(0, 5, 0, 4))
            local ll = navBox:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIListLayout")
            if ll then ll.FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal ll.Padding = UDim.new(0, 5) end
            _P(navBox, "Parent", wrap, "Position", UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0), "Size", UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 0), "AutomaticSize", Enum.AutomaticSize.X, "Visible", true)
            for _, b in ipairs(navBox:GetChildren()) do if b:IsA("GuiObject") then b.Size = UDim2.new(0, 92, 1, 0) end end
        end end
    if content then content.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, -STRIP) content.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, STRIP) end
    local ROW_MIN = 40
    local function bumpText(o) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE), ERROR_HANDLING(false))
        if not (o:IsA("TextLabel") or o:IsA("TextButton") or o:IsA("TextBox")) then return end
        if o.TextScaled or o:GetAttribute("JAFTextBumped") then return end
        o:SetAttribute("JAFTextBumped", true)
        o.TextSize = math.min(o.TextSize + 2, 15)
    end
    _G.JAF_MobileApplyRows = function(sf) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE), ERROR_HANDLING(false))
        if typeof(sf) ~= "Instance" then return end
        for _, row in ipairs(sf:GetChildren()) do
            if row:IsA("GuiObject") and row.Size.Y.Scale == 0 and row.Size.Y.Offset > 0 then
                if row.Size.X.Scale == 0.5 then
                    row.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, math.max(row.Size.Y.Offset, ROW_MIN))
                elseif row.Size.X.Scale == 1 and row.Size.Y.Offset >= 30 and row.Size.Y.Offset < ROW_MIN then
                    row.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, ROW_MIN)
                end end
            bumpText(row)
            for _, d in ipairs(row:GetDescendants()) do bumpText(d) end
        end end
    if tScrolls then for _, sf in pairs(tScrolls) do _G.JAF_MobileApplyRows(sf) end end
    if navBox then
        for _, d in ipairs(navBox:GetDescendants()) do bumpText(d) end
        local okTS, TS = pcall(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(ERROR_HANDLING(false))
return game:GetService("TextService") end)
        for _, b in ipairs(navBox:GetChildren()) do
            if b:IsA("GuiObject") then
                local lb = b:FindFirstChild("TabLbl")
                local w = 92
                if okTS and TS and lb and lb:IsA("TextLabel") and lb.Text ~= "" then
                    local okM, sz = pcall(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE), ERROR_HANDLING(false))
                        return TS:GetTextSize(lb.Text, lb.TextSize, lb.Font, Vector2.new(1000, 100))
                    end)
                    if okM and sz then w = math.clamp(math.ceil(sz.X) + 42 + 14, 84, 190) end
                end
                b.Size = UDim2.new(0, w, 1, 0)
            end end end
    pcall(_G.JAF_MobileSliderPass, panel)
end
function _G.JAF_MobileFitPanel() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE), ERROR_HANDLING(false))
    local ui = _G.SneizzySettingsUI
    local p = ui and ui.panel
    if not (p and p.Parent and p.Parent.Parent) then return end
    local ps = p.Parent.AbsoluteSize
    if ps.X < 10 then return end
    if _G.JAF_MobileOn() and Config.MobileSheet ~= false then _G.JAF_SheetPin(p) return end
    if p:GetAttribute("JAFSheetPinned") then p:SetAttribute("JAFSheetPinned", nil) end
    local w, h = p.AbsoluteSize.X, p.AbsoluteSize.Y
    local curX = p.Position.X.Scale * ps.X + p.Position.X.Offset
    local curY = p.Position.Y.Scale * ps.Y + p.Position.Y.Offset
    local x = math.clamp(curX, 0, math.max(0, ps.X - w))
    local y = math.clamp(curY, 0, math.max(0, ps.Y - h))
    if math.abs(x - curX) > 0.5 or math.abs(y - curY) > 0.5 then p.Position = UDim2.new(0, math.floor(x), 0, math.floor(y)) end
end

if not _SABCAP.JAF_DropBrainrot then
    local _dropActive  = false
    local _DROP_MIN    = 0.15
    local _DROP_MAX    = 6.0
    local _INVIS_WAIT  = 2.0
    local _DROP_BASE_MAX = 200
    local _dropRestore, _dropRestoreRoot
    local _dropRoot; _dropRoot = function(char) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE), ERROR_HANDLING(false))
        if not char then return nil end
        local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        local r = hum and hum.RootPart
        if r and r.Parent then return r end
        r = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        return (r and r.Parent) and r or nil
    end
    local function _invisOrphan() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE), ERROR_HANDLING(false))
        local cam = Workspace.CurrentCamera
        if not cam then return false end
        for _, c in ipairs(cam:GetChildren()) do if c:IsA("BasePart") and c.Name == "HumanoidRootPart" then return true end end
        return false
    end
    local _stealing; _stealing = function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE), ERROR_HANDLING(false))
        return LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("Stealing") == true
    end
    local _flingLoop; _flingLoop = (function(char0) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(ERROR_HANDLING(false))
        local t0, movel = os.clock(), 0.1
        while _dropActive do
            RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
            if not SAB_LIVE() then break end
            local el = os.clock() - t0
            if el >= _DROP_MIN and not _stealing() then break end
            if el > _DROP_MAX then _G.JAF_DropRecToken = nil; break end
            if LocalPlayer.Character ~= char0 then _G.JAF_DropRecToken = nil; break end
            if _G.JAF_DropSuppressOnce == false then
                _G.JAF_HitRecCooldownUntil = tick() + 3
            else
                _G.JAF_DropRecToken = tick() + (tonumber(_G.JAF_DropRecTokenTail) or 2)
            end
            local root = _dropRoot(char0)
            if not (char0.Parent and root) then break end
            local vel = root.AssemblyLinearVelocity
            if vel.Magnitude > _DROP_BASE_MAX then vel = Vector3.zero end
            _dropRestore, _dropRestoreRoot = vel, root
            root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = vel * 10000 + Vector3.new(0, 10000, 0)
            RunService.RenderStepped:Wait()
            if char0.Parent and root.Parent then root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = vel end
            RunService.Stepped:Wait()
            if char0.Parent and root.Parent then root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = vel + Vector3.new(0, movel, 0) movel = -movel end
        end
        _dropRestoreRoot = nil
    end)
    _SABCAP.JAF_DropBrainrot = function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(ERROR_HANDLING(false))
        if _dropActive then return false end
        if _G.JAF_DropBrainrotEnabled == false then return false end
        if not SAB_LIVE() then return false end
        if _G.JAF_TpActive or _G.JAF_ResetStowActive then return false end
        _dropActive = true
        task.spawn(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE), ERROR_HANDLING(false))
            local diedConn, safetyConn
            pcall(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE), ERROR_HANDLING(false))
                if _G.invisibleStealEnabled == true and _G.toggleInvisibleSteal then
                    pcall(_G.toggleInvisibleSteal)
                    _G.invisAutoActive = false
                    local _iw = os.clock()
                    while os.clock() - _iw < _INVIS_WAIT do
                        if _G.invisibleStealEnabled ~= true and not _invisOrphan() and _dropRoot(LocalPlayer.Character) then break end
                        RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
                    end end
                if _G.invisibleStealEnabled == true or _invisOrphan() then return end
                local char0 = LocalPlayer.Character
                local hum0  = char0 and char0:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                if hum0 then diedConn = hum0.Died:Connect(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(ERROR_HANDLING(false))
_dropActive = false end) end
                if _G.JAF_DropSuppressOnce == false then
                    _G.JAF_HitRecCooldownUntil = tick() + 3
                else
                    _G.JAF_DropRecToken = tick() + (tonumber(_G.JAF_DropRecTokenTail) or 2)
                end
                _G.JAF_DropFlingActive = true
                safetyConn = RunService.PreSimulation:Connect(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE), ERROR_HANDLING(false))
                    local _r = _dropRestoreRoot
                    if not _r or not _r.Parent then return end
                    local v = _r.AssemblyLinearVelocity
                    local cap = tonumber(_G.JAF_DropFlingVelCap) or 500
                    if v.Magnitude > cap then _r.AssemblyLinearVelocity = _dropRestore or Vector3.zero end
                end)
                _flingLoop(char0)
            end)
            _G.JAF_DropFlingActive = false
            _dropActive = false
            if diedConn then pcall(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(ERROR_HANDLING(false))
diedConn:Disconnect() end) end
            if safetyConn then pcall(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(ERROR_HANDLING(false))
safetyConn:Disconnect() end) end
            _dropRestore, _dropRestoreRoot = nil, nil
            local _r = _dropRoot(LocalPlayer.Character)
            if _r then pcall(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(ERROR_HANDLING(false))
_r.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero end) end
        end)
        return true
    end
    _SABCAP.JAF_DropBrainrotActive = function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(ERROR_HANDLING(false))
return _dropActive end
end

task.spawn(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE), ERROR_HANDLING(false))

        task.wait(_G.JAF_BalloonScanInterval or 0.35)

            local pg = PlayerGui
            local hit = false
            if pg then
                local _scope = pg
                local _nf = pg:FindFirstChild("Notification")
                if _nf then _scope = _nf:FindFirstChild("Notification") or _nf end
                for _, gui in ipairs(_scope:GetDescendants()) do
                    local cn = gui.ClassName
                    if cn == "TextLabel" or cn == "TextButton" then
                        local txt = gui.ContentText
                        if txt == nil or txt == "" then txt = gui.Text end
                        if type(txt) == "string" and #txt >= 12 then
                            local low = txt:lower()
                            local _s, _e = low:find("balloon[^%a]-on you")
                            if _s then
                                local _nxt = low:sub(_e + 1, _e + 1)
                                if _nxt == "" or not _nxt:match("%w") then hit = true break end
                            end end end end end
            if hit then
                if armed and (tick() - lastAutoReset) > (tonumber(_G.JAF_AutoResetCooldown) or 4) then
                    armed = false
                    lastAutoReset = tick()

                end
            else
                armed = true
            end
        else
            armed = true
        end end end)
do
    local SCALED_GUIS = {
        "XiAdminPanel", "XiAdminToolsPanel", "XiStealingHUD", "AutoStealUI", "SneizzySettings",
        "SneizzyMiniActions",
        "SneizzyStatusHUD", "SneizzyWalkingBestBar",
        "SneizzyGrabKick", "PriorityListGUI", "AutoStealPriorityEditor", "JAFAdvTpSpeed",
    }
    if not Config.PanelScalesMigrated then
        Config.PanelScalesMigrated = true
        if type(Config.PanelScales) == "table" then
            for _, n in ipairs({ "XiAdminToolsPanel", "SneizzyWalkingBestBar", "PriorityListGUI",
                                 "AutoStealPriorityEditor", "JAFAdvTpSpeed" }) do
                Config.PanelScales[n] = nil
            end end
        pcall(SaveConfig)
    end
    local FIT_PAD = 14
    local FIT_MIN = 0.35
    local function fitScale(want, w, h, vp) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE), ERROR_HANDLING(false))
        if w <= 0 or h <= 0 then return want end
        local maxK = math.min((vp.X - FIT_PAD) / w, (vp.Y - FIT_PAD) / h)
        if maxK < want then return math.max(maxK, FIT_MIN) end
        return want
    end
    local MIN_VISIBLE = 0.6
    local function clampOnScreen(ch, vp) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE), ERROR_HANDLING(false))
        local w, h = ch.AbsoluteSize.X, ch.AbsoluteSize.Y
        if w < 8 or h < 8 then return end
        if w > vp.X or h > vp.Y then return end
        local px, py = ch.Position.X, ch.Position.Y
        local ax, ay = ch.AnchorPoint.X * w, ch.AnchorPoint.Y * h
        local curX = px.Scale * vp.X + px.Offset - ax
        local curY = py.Scale * vp.Y + py.Offset - ay
        local visW = math.max(0, math.min(curX + w, vp.X) - math.max(curX, 0))
        local visH = math.max(0, math.min(curY + h, vp.Y) - math.max(curY, 0))
        if visW >= w * MIN_VISIBLE and visH >= h * MIN_VISIBLE then return end
        local newX = math.clamp(curX, 0, vp.X - w)
        local newY = math.clamp(curY, 0, vp.Y - h)
        if math.abs(newX - curX) < 2 and math.abs(newY - curY) < 2 then return end
        local function put(u, want, span) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE), ERROR_HANDLING(false))
            if u.Scale ~= 0 and span > 0 then return UDim.new(want / span, 0) end
            return UDim.new(0, math.floor(want))
        end
        ch.Position = UDim2.new(put(px, newX + ax, vp.X), put(py, newY + ay, vp.Y))
    end
    local lastSize = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
    local function sizeSettled(ch) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE), ERROR_HANDLING(false))
        local now = ch.AbsoluteSize
        local was = lastSize[ch]
        lastSize[ch] = now
        return was ~= nil and math.abs(was.X - now.X) < 1 and math.abs(was.Y - now.Y) < 1
    end
    _G.JAF_ApplyUIScale = function(scale) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE), ERROR_HANDLING(false))
        scale = math.clamp(tonumber(scale) or 1, 0.5, 1.5)
        Config.UIScale = scale
        local panelScales = Config.PanelScales or {}
        local dragging = (tick() - (_G.JAF_DragBusy or 0)) < 0.6
        for _, name in ipairs(SCALED_GUIS) do
            local sg = hubFind(name)
            if sg then
                local per = math.clamp(tonumber(panelScales[name]) or 1, 0.5, 1.5)
                local vp = sg.AbsoluteSize
                if vp.X < 10 then vp = _G.JAF_Viewport() end
                for _, ch in ipairs(sg:GetChildren()) do
                    if ch:IsA("GuiObject") then
                        local fullBleed = ch.Size.X.Scale >= 0.99 and ch.Size.Y.Scale >= 0.99
                        local base = tonumber(ch:GetAttribute("JAFBaseScale")) or 1
                        if base <= 0.05 or base > 1 then base = 1 end
                        local eff = scale * per * base
                        if fullBleed then
                            eff = 1
                        elseif not ch:GetAttribute("JAFSheetPinned") then
                            eff = fitScale(eff, ch.Size.X.Offset, ch.Size.Y.Offset, vp)
                        end
                        local us = ch:FindFirstChild("JAFUIScale")
                        if not us then us = Instance.new("UIScale"); us.Name = "JAFUIScale"; us.Parent = ch end
                        for _, o in ipairs(ch:GetChildren()) do if o ~= us and o:IsA("UIScale") then o:Destroy() end end
                        if math.abs(us.Scale - eff) > 0.0005 then us.Scale = eff end
                        local settled = sizeSettled(ch)
                        if not fullBleed and not dragging and settled
                           and not ch:GetAttribute("JAFSheetPinned") then
                            clampOnScreen(ch, vp)
                        end end end end end
        if _G.JAF_MobileFitPanel then pcall(_G.JAF_MobileFitPanel) end
    end
    task.spawn(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE), ERROR_HANDLING(false))
        local t0 = tick()
        while true do pcall(_G.JAF_ApplyUIScale, Config.UIScale or 1) task.wait((tick() - t0 < 15) and 0.2 or 2) end
    end)

            local delta = inp.Position - dragStart

    local function OClearRigPose(model) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE), ERROR_HANDLING(false))
        if not model then return end
        -- Don't flatten the LOCAL player's pose WHILE invis-steal is active (keeps your
        -- animation visible during invis). Outside invis (incl. the TP flight) it clears
        -- normally so the TP doesn't lag back.
        if _G.JAF_AnimKillSelf ~= true and (_G.TacoInvisActive == true or _G.invisibleStealEnabled == true) then
            local _lp = OServices.OPlayers.LocalPlayer
            if _lp and model == _lp.Character then return end
        end

            local hum = model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

            end end) end

    local function OAnimSkip(animator) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE), ERROR_HANDLING(false))
        if _G.JAF_RemoveAnims == false or _G.JAF_FpsOptCharAnim == false then return true end
        if OAnimIsTool(animator) then return true end
        -- Keep the LOCAL player's own animations ONLY while invis-steal is active, so your
        -- steal/carry animation stays visible during invis. When NOT invis (idle, and the
        -- TP flight) your animations are stripped as normal so the TP doesn't get lagged
        -- back. Others are always stripped for FPS. _G.JAF_AnimKillSelf = true forces your
        -- own to always strip (even during invis).
        if _G.JAF_AnimKillSelf ~= true and (_G.TacoInvisActive == true or _G.invisibleStealEnabled == true) then
            local _lp = OServices.OPlayers.LocalPlayer
            if _lp and _lp.Character and animator:IsDescendantOf(_lp.Character) then return true end
        end
        local isPlayerRig = OAnimIsPlayerRig(animator)
        if _G.JAF_AnimKillPlayers == false and isPlayerRig then return true end
        if not isPlayerRig and tick() < _brainrotAnimReadyAt then return true end
        return false
    end
    local function OKillAnimsOn(animator) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE), ERROR_HANDLING(false))
        if not animator or not animator.Parent then return end

        if OAnimSkip(animator) then return end

            for _, tr in ipairs(animator:GetPlayingAnimationTracks()) do pcall(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(ERROR_HANDLING(false))
tr:Stop(0) end) end

OClearRigPose(_owner) end)

tr:Stop(0) end)

    local _ocPending, _ocScheduled = {}, false

    Workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(obj) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE), ERROR_HANDLING(false))

    local function OOnCharAdded(ch) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE), ERROR_HANDLING(false))

;(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(ERROR_HANDLING(false))
    local autoTurretOn = false
    local function adt_getChar() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE), ERROR_HANDLING(false))
        local c = LocalPlayer.Character
        return c, c and c:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart"), c and c:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    end
    local adt_pin = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
    local function adt_isDeploying(target) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(ERROR_HANDLING(false))
        local strict = _G.JAF_TurretDeployStrict ~= false
        local pinned, why = false, nil
        local fp = {}
        for _, d in ipairs(target:GetDescendants()) do
            if d:IsA("TextLabel") then
                local t = d.Text
                if t ~= "" then
                    local ev = false
                    if t:lower():find("ready", 1, true) then
                        ev = true
                        if not pinned then pinned, why = true, "ready-label" end
                    elseif not strict then
                        if t:find("!", 1, true) or t:match("^%s*%d+%.?%d*%s*[sS]?%s*$") then
                            ev = true
                            if not pinned then pinned, why = true, "loose" end
                        end
                    else
                        local num = t:match("^%s*(%d+%.?%d*)%s*[sS]?%s*!*%s*$")
                        if num and (tonumber(num) or 99) <= 10 then
                            ev = true
                            if not pinned then pinned, why = true, "countdown=" .. num end
                        end end
                    if ev then fp[#fp + 1] = t end
                end end end
        if not pinned then adt_pin[target] = nil return false, nil end
        local key = table.concat(fp, "\1")
        local now = tick()
        local p = adt_pin[target]
        if not p or p.key ~= key then adt_pin[target] = { key = key, at = now, why = why } return true, why end
        p.why = why
        if _G.JAF_TurretStaticRelease ~= false
          and now - p.at >= (tonumber(_G.JAF_TurretStaticPin) or 1.2) then
            return false, "static:" .. why
        end
        return true, why
    end
    local adt_seen = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
    local adt_armed = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
    local adt_tr   = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
    local adt_gate = { tp = 0, speed = 0, buykick = 0, steal = 0, join = 0, noweapon = 0 }
    local function adt_gateDump() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE), ERROR_HANDLING(false))
        local parts = {}
        for _, k in ipairs({ "tp", "speed", "buykick", "steal", "join", "noweapon" }) do
            if adt_gate[k] > 0.05 then parts[#parts + 1] = string.format("%s %.2fs", k, adt_gate[k]) end
        end
        return #parts > 0 and table.concat(parts, ", ") or "none"
    end
    local function adt_isPlayerRig(inst) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE), ERROR_HANDLING(false))
        if _G.JAF_TurretSkipPlayers == false then return false end
        local par = inst
        while par and par ~= workspace do
            if Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(par)
            or (par.ClassName == "Model" and par:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")) then return true end
            par = par.Parent
        end
        return false
    end
    local function adt_isTargetable(inst) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE), ERROR_HANDLING(false))
        if adt_isPlayerRig(inst) then return false end
        if _G.JAF_TurretWaitReady == false then return true end
        if adt_armed[inst] then return true end
        local now = tick()
        local seen = adt_seen[inst]
        if not seen then seen = now; adt_seen[inst] = now end
        local tr = adt_tr[inst]
        if not tr then tr = { seen = now }; adt_tr[inst] = tr end
        if now - seen >= (tonumber(_G.JAF_TurretDeploySpan) or 12) then
            adt_armed[inst] = true
            if tr.pinwhy and not tr.pinrel then tr.pinrel = "age-cap" end
            return true
        end
        local dep, why = adt_isDeploying(inst)
        if why and dep then tr.pinwhy = why end
        if dep then return false end
        if tr.pinwhy and not tr.pinrel then tr.pinrel = why and "static" or "deploy-done" end
        if _G.JAF_TurretArmLatch ~= false then adt_armed[inst] = true end
        return true
    end
    local adt_cool = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
    local function adt_applyVisuals(target) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE), ERROR_HANDLING(false))
        for _, d in ipairs(target:GetDescendants()) do
            if d:IsA("BasePart") and d ~= target then
                d.Transparency = 0.5; d.CanCollide = false
                d.CanTouch = false; d.CanQuery = false
            elseif d:IsA("BillboardGui") and d.Name == "SentryLabel" then
                d:Destroy()
            elseif d:IsA("Decal") or d:IsA("Texture") then d.Transparency = 0.5 end
        end
        if target:IsA("BasePart") and target.Name == "ProxyVisual" then target.Transparency = 1; target.CanCollide = false end
    end
    local function adt_getWeapon() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE), ERROR_HANDLING(false))
        local c = LocalPlayer.Character
        if not c then return nil end
        local bp = LocalPlayer.Backpack
        return (bp and bp:FindFirstChild("Bat")) or c:FindFirstChild("Bat")
            or (bp and bp:FindFirstChild("Gummy Bear")) or c:FindFirstChild("Gummy Bear")
    end
    local function adt_equipBat() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE), ERROR_HANDLING(false))
        if _G.JAF_ResetStowActive then return end
        local c, _, hum = adt_getChar()
        if not c or not hum then return end
        local w = adt_getWeapon()
        if w and w.Parent ~= c then hum:EquipTool(w) end
    end
    local adt_lastDeep = 0
    local adt_getClosestSentry; adt_getClosestSentry = function(includeCooled) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE), ERROR_HANDLING(false))
        local _, hrp = adt_getChar()
        if not hrp then return nil end
        local closest, shortest = nil, math.huge
        local sfind = string.find
        local now = tick()
        local hrpPos = hrp.Position
        local function _scan(list) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE), ERROR_HANDLING(false))
            for _i = 1, #list do
                local inst = list[_i]
                local nm = inst.Name
                if sfind(nm, "Sentry", 1, true) and nm ~= "SentryBullet"
                  and (inst.ClassName == "Model" or inst:IsA("BasePart"))
                  and (includeCooled or not (adt_cool[inst] and now < adt_cool[inst]))
                  and adt_isTargetable(inst) then
                    local root = inst:IsA("BasePart") and inst or inst:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
                    if root then
                        local dist = (hrpPos - root.Position).Magnitude
                        if dist < shortest then shortest = dist; closest = inst end
                    end end end end
        _scan(workspace:GetChildren())
        if not closest and (now - adt_lastDeep) > (tonumber(_G.JAF_TurretDeepEvery) or 3) then
            adt_lastDeep = now
            _scan(workspace:GetDescendants())
        end
        return closest
    end

task.spawn((function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE), ERROR_HANDLING(false))
    local NOCLIP_KW = _G.JAF_NoclipKW or { "truck", "fuse", "craft", "incubator", "cupid", "soccerball" }
    local AVOID_KW  = _G.JAF_NoclipAvoidKW or { "trade","portal","wheel","cyber","spin","roulette","summer","admin","plot","shop","board","sentry","laser","base" }
    local FORCE_KW  = _G.JAF_NoclipForceKW or { "summer base", "summerfuse" }
    local _clsMemo, _clsMemoN = {}, 0
    local classify; classify = function(name) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE), ERROR_HANDLING(false))
        local raw = name or ""
        local hit = _clsMemo[raw]
        if hit ~= nil then if hit == false then return nil end return hit end
        local n = raw:lower()
        local res = nil
        for _, k in ipairs(FORCE_KW)  do if n:find(k, 1, true) then res = "noclip" break end end
        if res == nil then for _, k in ipairs(AVOID_KW)  do if n:find(k, 1, true) then res = "avoid"  break end end end
        if res == nil then for _, k in ipairs(NOCLIP_KW) do if n:find(k, 1, true) then res = "noclip" break end end end
        if _clsMemoN >= (_G.JAF_ClsMemoMax or 8000) then _clsMemo, _clsMemoN = {}, 0 end
        _clsMemo[raw] = (res == nil) and false or res
        _clsMemoN = _clsMemoN + 1
        return res
    end
    local _targets, _lastDiscover = {}, 0
    local _chainClassify; _chainClassify = function(p) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE), ERROR_HANDLING(false))
        local chain, a = {}, p
        while a and a ~= Workspace do table.insert(chain, 1, a); a = a.Parent end
        if not a then return nil end
        for _, node in ipairs(chain) do
            if node:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") then return nil end
            local cls = classify(node.Name)
            if cls then return cls end
        end
        return nil
    end
    local _ncPending, _ncScheduled = {}, false
    local function _ncDrain() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(ERROR_HANDLING(false))
        _ncScheduled = false
        local batch = _ncPending
        _ncPending = {}
        local n = 0
        for p in pairs(batch) do
            if _G.JAF_NoclipMachines and SAB_LIVE() and p.Parent and p.Anchored and _chainClassify(p) == "noclip" then
                pcall(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(ERROR_HANDLING(false))
p.CanCollide = false; p.CanQuery = false end)
            end
            n = n + 1
            if n % (_G.JAF_NoclipDrainBatch or 150) == 0 then RunService.Heartbeat:Wait() end
        end end
    Workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(p) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE), ERROR_HANDLING(false))
        if not p:IsA("BasePart") then return end
        _ncPending[p] = true
        if not _ncScheduled then _ncScheduled = true; task.delay(0.15, _ncDrain) end
    end)
    local function discover() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE), ERROR_HANDLING(false))
        local out = {}
        local _wn = 0
        local function walk(container, depth) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE), ERROR_HANDLING(false))
            for _, c in ipairs(container:GetChildren()) do
                if c:IsA("Model") or c:IsA("Folder") or c:IsA("BasePart") then
                    if c:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") then
                    else
                        local cls = classify(c.Name)
                        if cls == "avoid" then
                        elseif cls == "noclip" then
                            out[#out + 1] = c
                        elseif depth < (_G.JAF_NoclipDepth or 5) then
                            walk(c, depth + 1)
                        end end end
                _wn = _wn + 1
                if _wn % (_G.JAF_NoclipWalkBatch or 200) == 0 then RunService.Heartbeat:Wait() end
            end end
        pcall(walk, Workspace, 0)
        _targets = out
    end
    local _noclipBoot = tick()
    while true do
        if _G.JAF_NoclipMachines and SAB_LIVE() then
            local _every = (tick() - _noclipBoot < 12) and 1 or (_G.JAF_NoclipDiscoverEvery or 3)
            if tick() - _lastDiscover > _every then _lastDiscover = tick(); discover() end
            for _, m in ipairs(_targets) do
                if m.Parent then
                    if m:IsA("BasePart") then
                        if m.CanCollide then pcall(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(ERROR_HANDLING(false))
m.CanCollide = false end) end
                        if m.CanQuery  then pcall(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(ERROR_HANDLING(false))
m.CanQuery  = false end) end
                    else
                        for _, p in ipairs(m:GetDescendants()) do
                            if p:IsA("BasePart") then
                                if p.CanCollide then pcall(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(ERROR_HANDLING(false))
p.CanCollide = false end) end
                                if p.CanQuery  then pcall(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(ERROR_HANDLING(false))
p.CanQuery  = false end) end
                            end end end end end end
        task.wait(_G.JAF_NoclipApplyEvery or 0.3)
    end end))

-- ============================================================
-- BASE CAMP (instant steal a target's base)
-- Self-contained: does nothing until _G.SneizzyCamp.start(name) is called from the
-- Admin tab. Finds the target's plot via its PlotSign, hops you to the next empty
-- slot, and continuously fires every "Steal" prompt in that plot so anything in
-- the base (or that the owner steals into it) is grabbed instantly.
-- ============================================================
do
    local Players    = game:GetService("Players")
    local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
    local LP = Players.LocalPlayer

    local RC = { active = false, target = nil, plotName = nil, status = "idle" }
    _G.SneizzyCamp = RC
    local lastFire   = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
    local stealConns = {}

    local function _plotOwnerName(plot)
        local sign = plot and plot:FindFirstChild("PlotSign")
        local gui  = sign and sign:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("SurfaceGui", true)
        local lbl  = gui and gui:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("TextLabel", true)
        if not (lbl and lbl.Text) then return nil end
        local nick = lbl.Text:match("^(.-)'") or lbl.Text
        nick = nick and nick:gsub("%s+$", "")
        if nick == "" then return nil end
        return nick
    end

    local function findPlotFor(plr)
        local plots = workspace:FindFirstChild("Plots")
        if not plots then return nil end
        local n = plr.Name:lower()
        local dn = (plr.DisplayName or ""):lower()
        for _, plot in ipairs(plots:GetChildren()) do
            local owner = _plotOwnerName(plot)
            if owner then
                local ol = owner:lower()
                if ol == n or ol == dn then return plot end
            end
        end
        return nil
    end

    local function resolvePlayer(q)
        q = tostring(q or ""):lower():gsub("%s+", "")
        if q == "" then return nil end
        local partial
        for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
            if p ~= LP then
                local n, d = p.Name:lower(), (p.DisplayName or ""):lower()
                if n == q or d == q then return p end
                if not partial and (n:find(q, 1, true) or d:find(q, 1, true)) then partial = p end
            end
        end
        return partial
    end

    -- A slot is occupied when its Base.Spawn has an enabled "Steal" prompt (that is
    -- exactly where the game puts the steal prompt for a brainrot on the podium).
    local function _slotOccupied(slot)
        local base  = slot:FindFirstChild("Base")
        local spawn = base and base:FindFirstChild("Spawn")
        local att   = spawn and spawn:FindFirstChild("PromptAttachment")
        if att then
            for _, p in ipairs(att:GetChildren()) do
                if p:IsA("ProximityPrompt") and p.Enabled and p.ActionText == "Steal" then return true end
            end
        end
        for _, d in ipairs(slot:GetDescendants()) do
            if d:IsA("ProximityPrompt") and d.Enabled and d.ActionText == "Steal" then return true end
        end
        return false
    end

    -- Returns (slotName, standPos, full). full = true when every slot is occupied.
    local function campSlot(plot)
        local pods = plot:FindFirstChild("AnimalPodiums")
        if not pods then return nil, nil, false end
        local slots = {}
        for _, s in ipairs(pods:GetChildren()) do
            local base  = s:FindFirstChild("Base")
            local spawn = base and base:FindFirstChild("Spawn")
            if spawn and spawn:IsA("BasePart") then slots[#slots + 1] = s end
        end
        -- Numeric order so slot "2" comes before "10" (podiums are named by number).
        table.sort(slots, function(a, b)
            local na, nb = tonumber(tostring(a.Name):match("%d+")), tonumber(tostring(b.Name):match("%d+"))
            if na and nb then return na < nb end
            return tostring(a.Name) < tostring(b.Name)
        end)
        local firstName, firstPos
        for _, slot in ipairs(slots) do
            local spawn = slot.Base.Spawn
            firstName = firstName or slot.Name
            firstPos  = firstPos  or (spawn.Position + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0))
            if not _slotOccupied(slot) then
                return slot.Name, spawn.Position + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0), false
            end
        end
        -- iterated every slot and found no empty one -> base is full
        return firstName, firstPos, true
    end

    -- Move to a position using the hub's normal tween mover (same as regular TP).
    local function tweenTo(pos)
        local char = LP.Character
        local hrp  = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not (hrp and pos) then return end
        if type(_G.JAF_TweenHrpBrainrot) == "function" then
            pcall(_G.JAF_TweenHrpBrainrot, hrp, pos, nil)
        else
            local TS = game:GetService("TweenService")
            local dist = (pos - hrp.Position).Magnitude
            local tw = TS:Create(hrp, TweenInfo.new(math.clamp(dist / 200, 0.1, 4), Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), { CFrame = CFrame.new(pos) })
            pcall(function() tw:Play(); tw.Completed:Wait() end)
        end
    end

    -- Find the NEAREST stealable brainrot sitting in the camped base (from the hub's
    -- own scan cache), measured from where we're standing. Stealing here is a sustained
    -- HOLD, not a single fire, so we can't grab prompts ourselves -- instead we hand the
    -- target to the hub's proven autosteal (which completes the hold) by pointing
    -- manualTarget at it. Nearest, not priority, so it grabs whatever's right here.
    local function campTarget()
        local cache = SharedState and SharedState.AllAnimalsCache
        if not cache then return nil end
        local me   = LP.Name
        local char = LP.Character
        local hrp  = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        local myPos = hrp and hrp.Position
        local best, bestD, firstAny = nil, math.huge, nil
        for _, a in ipairs(cache) do
            if a and a.plot == RC.plotName and not a.isWalking and a.owner ~= me then
                firstAny = firstAny or a
                if myPos and type(_G.findAdorneeGlobal) == "function" then
                    local ok, part = pcall(_G.findAdorneeGlobal, a)
                    local pos = ok and part and part.Position
                    if pos then
                        local d = (pos - myPos).Magnitude
                        if d < bestD then bestD = d; best = a end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        return best or firstAny
    end

    -- Point the autosteal at whatever is in the camped base (or release it when the
    -- base is empty). Only runs once we've arrived, so it never fights the TP.
    local function campSteer()
        if not RC.arrived then return end
        local tgt = campTarget()
        if tgt then
            if RC._mt ~= tgt then
                RC._mt = tgt
                pcall(function() if SharedState and SharedState.SetManualTarget then SharedState.SetManualTarget(tgt) end end)
            end
        elseif RC._mt ~= nil then
            RC._mt = nil
            pcall(function() if SharedState and SharedState.SetManualTarget then SharedState.SetManualTarget(nil) end end)
        end
    end

    local function _notify(title, text)
        pcall(function()
            game:GetService("StarterGui"):SetCore("SendNotification", { Title = title, Text = text, Duration = 4 })
        end)
    end

    RC.start = function(q)
        local plr = resolvePlayer(q)
        if not plr then RC.status = "player not found"; return false, "player not found" end
        local plot = findPlotFor(plr)
        if not plot then RC.status = "base not found"; return false, "base not found" end
        RC.target   = plr.Name
        RC.plotName = plot.Name
        RC.active   = true
        RC.arrived  = false
        RC._mt      = nil
        -- Camp on the ACTUAL floor of the slot. F2StealBelow (on by default) would
        -- drop us on the first floor to steal a 2nd-floor podium from underneath.
        RC._prevF2Below = _G.JAF_F2StealBelow
        _G.JAF_F2StealBelow = false
        local slotName, pos, full = campSlot(plot)
        if full then
            RC.status = plr.Name .. "'s base is FULL"
            _notify("Base Camp", plr.Name .. "'s base is FULL (no open slots)")
        else
            RC.status = "camping " .. plr.Name
        end
        if slotName then
            -- Use the hub's REAL teleport to the open podium: same pathfinding route,
            -- grapple fire, wings/carpet, and clone-in as a normal brainrot TP. The
            -- entry resolves to the slot's Base.Spawn via findAdorneeGlobal even when
            -- empty, so the whole TP pipeline drives us straight there.
            local entry = { plot = plot.Name, slot = slotName,
                            uid = plot.Name .. "::camp::" .. slotName,
                            name = "Camp", genValue = 0, mps = 0 }
            RC.entry = entry
            task.spawn(function()
                if type(_G.JAF_Retarget) == "function" then
                    pcall(_G.JAF_Retarget, entry)               -- pathfinding + grapple + wings + clone
                elseif type(_G.tpToBestBrainrot) == "function" then
                    pcall(function() if SharedState and SharedState.SetManualTarget then SharedState.SetManualTarget(entry) end end)
                    pcall(_G.tpToBestBrainrot)
                elseif pos then
                    pcall(tweenTo, pos)
                end
                -- Wait for the TP to actually begin, then run to completion.
                local _t0 = tick()
                while RC.active and _G.JAF_TpActive ~= true and tick() - _t0 < 3  do task.wait(0.05) end
                local _t1 = tick()
                while RC.active and _G.JAF_TpActive == true and tick() - _t1 < 15 do task.wait(0.1)  end
                -- Release the empty-slot TP target, then let the steer loop take over:
                -- it points the autosteal at whatever brainrot is in this base.
                if RC.entry == entry then
                    pcall(function() if SharedState and SharedState.SetManualTarget then SharedState.SetManualTarget(nil) end end)
                end
                RC.entry   = nil
                RC.arrived = true
            end)
        end
        return true, RC.status
    end

    RC.stop = function()
        RC.active  = false
        RC.status  = "stopped"
        RC.entry   = nil
        RC.arrived = false
        RC._mt     = nil
        _G.SneizzyCampSpeedCap = nil
        _G.JAF_F2StealBelow = RC._prevF2Below   -- restore the user's normal setting
        pcall(function() if SharedState and SharedState.SetManualTarget then SharedState.SetManualTarget(nil) end end)
    end

    -- If the target leaves the game, turn the camp off automatically.
    Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(p)
        if RC.active and RC.target and p.Name == RC.target then
            _notify("Base Camp", (RC.target or "target") .. " left the game — camp off")
            RC.stop()
        end
    end)

    task.spawn(function()
        while true do
            task.wait(0.1)
            if RC.active then
                if RC.target and not Players:FindFirstChild(RC.target) then
                    _notify("Base Camp", (RC.target or "target") .. " left the game — camp off")
                    RC.stop()
                else
                    pcall(campSteer)   -- keep the autosteal pointed at the camped base
                end
            end
        end
    end)
end

-- ============================================================
-- GROUP ESP  (SON / FMLY good+bad, Kawaifu / Braintopia)
-- Puts a tag above other players' heads based on the admin-panel scanner
-- (_G.JAF_ESP_SonStatus / FmlyStatus / KB). Toggled from Visuals > ESP.
-- Atlas is intentionally excluded. Nothing shows for the local player.
-- ============================================================
do
    local Players = game:GetService("Players")
    local LP = Players.LocalPlayer
    local host = (gethui and gethui()) or game:GetService("CoreGui")
    local folder = Instance.new("Folder")
    folder.Name = "SneizzyGroupESP"
    folder.Parent = host

    local C_SON_GOOD  = Color3.fromRGB( 60, 140, 255)
    local C_FMLY_GOOD = Color3.fromRGB( 90, 220, 160)
    local C_BAD       = Color3.fromRGB(240,  90,  90)
    local C_KAWAIFU   = Color3.fromRGB(255, 120, 200)
    local C_BRAIN     = Color3.fromRGB(255, 215,   0)

    local bills = {}
    local function removeBill(plr)
        local b = bills[plr]
        if b then pcall(function() b.gui:Destroy() end); bills[plr] = nil end
    end
    local function labelFor(plr)
        local u = plr.Name
        if Config.EspSon and _G.JAF_ESP_SonStatus then
            local s = _G.JAF_ESP_SonStatus(u)
            if s then return "SON " .. string.upper(s) .. " BOY", (s == "good") and C_SON_GOOD or C_BAD end
        end
        if Config.EspFmly and _G.JAF_ESP_FmlyStatus then
            local s = _G.JAF_ESP_FmlyStatus(u)
            if s then return "FMLY " .. string.upper(s) .. " BOY", (s == "good") and C_FMLY_GOOD or C_BAD end
        end
        if Config.EspKawaifuBraintopia and _G.JAF_ESP_KB then
            local g = _G.JAF_ESP_KB(u)
            if g == "Kawaifu" then return "KAWAIFU", C_KAWAIFU
            elseif g == "Braintopia" then return "BRAINTOPIA", C_BRAIN end
        end
        return nil
    end
    local function ensureBill(plr, text, color)
        local char = plr.Character
        local head = char and char:FindFirstChild("Head")
        if not head then removeBill(plr); return end
        local b = bills[plr]
        if not b then
            local gui = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
            gui.Name = "GroupTag"; gui.Size = UDim2.new(0, 220, 0, 22)
            gui.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, 3.2, 0); gui.AlwaysOnTop = true
            gui.MaxDistance = 1000; gui.Adornee = head; gui.Parent = folder
            local lbl = Instance.new("TextLabel")
            lbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1; lbl.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
            lbl.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold; lbl.TextSize = 14
            lbl.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.4; lbl.Parent = gui
            b = { gui = gui, lbl = lbl }; bills[plr] = b
        end
        if b.gui.Adornee ~= head then b.gui.Adornee = head end
        b.lbl.Text = text; b.lbl.TextColor3 = color
    end

    task.spawn(function()
        while true do
            task.wait(0.5)
            local anyOn = Config.EspSon or Config.EspFmly or Config.EspKawaifuBraintopia
            if not anyOn then
                for plr in pairs(bills) do removeBill(plr) end
            else
                for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
                    if plr ~= LP then
                        local text, color = labelFor(plr)
                        if text then ensureBill(plr, text, color) else removeBill(plr) end
                    end
                end
                for plr in pairs(bills) do
                    if not plr.Parent then removeBill(plr) end
                end
            end
        end
    end)
    Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(plr) removeBill(plr) end)
end

-- ============================================================
-- FACE AWAY  (ported from Extras.txt "Face Away")
-- Continuously rotates the character to face AWAY from a target (base owner of
-- the plot you're standing on, or the nearest player). Driven by the Movement
-- tab toggle via _G.SneizzyFaceAway. Persists through the hub Config.
-- ============================================================
do
    local Players    = game:GetService("Players")
    local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
    local LP = Players.LocalPlayer

    local FA = { enabled = false, mode = "baseowner" }
    -- restore saved state if the hub Config is reachable here
    pcall(function()
        if Config then
            if Config.FaceAwayEnabled ~= nil then FA.enabled = Config.FaceAwayEnabled == true end
            if type(Config.FaceAwayMode) == "string" then FA.mode = Config.FaceAwayMode end
        end
    end)

    -- base-owner resolution (ported)
    local function getPlotAtPosition(pos)
        local plots = workspace:FindFirstChild("Plots")
        if not plots then return nil end
        local best, bestDist = nil, math.huge
        for _, plot in ipairs(plots:GetChildren()) do
            local pp
            if plot:IsA("Model") then
                pp = (plot.PrimaryPart and plot.PrimaryPart.Position) or plot:GetPivot().Position
            else
                pp = plot.Position
            end
            if pp then
                local d = math.sqrt((pos.X - pp.X)^2 + (pos.Z - pp.Z)^2)
                if d < bestDist then bestDist = d; best = plot end
            end
        end
        return (best and bestDist < 72) and best or nil
    end
    local function getPlotOwner(plot)
        if not plot then return nil end
        local sign = plot:FindFirstChild("PlotSign")
        local lbl  = sign and sign:FindFirstChild("SurfaceGui")
            and sign.SurfaceGui:FindFirstChild("Frame")
            and sign.SurfaceGui.Frame:FindFirstChild("TextLabel")
        if lbl then
            local nick = (lbl.Text and lbl.Text:match("^(.-)'")) or lbl.Text
            if nick and nick ~= "" then
                for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
                    if p.DisplayName == nick or p.Name == nick then return p end
                end
            end
        end
        return nil
    end
    local function getRoot(player)
        local c = player and player.Character
        return c and c:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    end
    local function resolveBaseOwner()
        local hrp = getRoot(LP)
        if not hrp then return nil end
        local owner = getPlotOwner(getPlotAtPosition(hrp.Position))
        return (owner ~= LP) and owner or nil
    end
    local function findNearest(myRoot)
        local closest, closestDist = nil, math.huge
        for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
            if player ~= LP then
                local root = getRoot(player)
                if root then
                    local dist = (root.Position - myRoot.Position).Magnitude
                    if dist < closestDist then closest, closestDist = player, dist end
                end
            end
        end
        return closest
    end
    local function resolveTarget(myRoot)
        if FA.mode == "nearest" then return findNearest(myRoot) end
        return resolveBaseOwner()
    end

    local function step(dt)
        if not FA.enabled then return end
        local myRoot = getRoot(LP)
        if not myRoot then return end
        local char = LP.Character
        local hum  = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if hum and hum.AutoRotate then hum.AutoRotate = false end
        local targetRoot = getRoot(resolveTarget(myRoot))
        if not targetRoot then return end
        local flat = Vector3.new(
            targetRoot.Position.X - myRoot.Position.X, 0,
            targetRoot.Position.Z - myRoot.Position.Z)
        if flat.Magnitude < 0.05 then return end
        myRoot.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(myRoot.Position, myRoot.Position - flat.Unit)
        local av = myRoot.AssemblyAngularVelocity
        if av.Y ~= 0 then myRoot.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.new(av.X, 0, av.Z) end
    end
    RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(step)
    RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(step)

    local function setEnabled(v)
        FA.enabled = v and true or false
        if not FA.enabled then
            local char = LP and LP.Character
            local hum  = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            if hum then pcall(function() hum.AutoRotate = true end) end
        end
    end

    _G.SneizzyFaceAway = {
        get        = function() return FA.enabled end,
        getMode    = function() return FA.mode end,
        setEnabled = setEnabled,
        setMode    = function(m) if m == "nearest" or m == "baseowner" then FA.mode = m end end,
    }
end

                    if #IG.holdCallbacks > 0 or #IG.triggerCallbacks > 0 or #IG.holdEndCallbacks > 0 then

                local function oG(IG)

                local function IG(pG)

                local function pG()

                local function S(CG)

                R.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
                    local k7Visible = _G.SNEIZZY_K7_ENABLED == true

                            sneizzyBarWasVisible = nil

                    k7SecLbl.Text = (_G.SneizzyCamp and _G.SneizzyCamp.active == true) and "BASE CAMP" or "NEAREST"
                    if not k7Visible then

                            zG = nil

                        return

                    if iG > #S then

                    end

                    end

                    if not CG or YG(CG.animalData) then

                    if not S or not S.Parent then
                        S = b(CG.animalData)
                    end
                    if S then
                        oG(S, CG.uid)
                    end
                end)
                task.spawn(function()
                    while task.wait(0.5) do
                        sG(nG, TG())
                    end
                end)
                task.spawn(function()
                    task.wait(1)
                    P.ListNeedsRedraw = true
                    sG(nG, TG())
                end)
                task.spawn(function()
                    while true do
                        P.AllAnimalsCache = yG
                        task.wait(0.5)
                    end
                end)
                -- Removed from Test 13: target tracer beam and heartbeat renderer
            end)
            -- Removed from Test 11: stale float, reset, kick watcher, and removed-feature keybind handlers
            -- Removed from Test 7: hidden settings plus post-UI feature tail (auto-TP, speed, sentry, mine ESP)
            -- Removed from Test 2: FPS tool-mesh tracker and error-GUI cleaner
            -- Removed from Test 1: job joiner UI and teleport loop
            k7Started = true
            k7Starting = false
        end)
    end

    _G.SNEIZZY_K7_SHUTDOWN = function()
        controllerAlive = false
        _G.SNEIZZY_K7_ENABLED = false
        if type(_G.SNEIZZY_K7_RESTORE_NORMAL_BAR) == "function" then
            pcall(_G.SNEIZZY_K7_RESTORE_NORMAL_BAR)
        end
        _G.SNEIZZY_K7_OWNS_STEAL = true
        if capturedSetNearest then pcall(capturedSetNearest, false) end
        if capturedSetInstant then pcall(capturedSetInstant, false) end
        _G.SNEIZZY_K7_OWNS_STEAL = false
    end

    task.spawn(function()
        local applied = nil
        local wasReady = false
        while controllerAlive do
            local wanted = sneizzyK7Wanted()
            if wanted and not k7Started then startSneizzyK7() end
            local ready = k7Started
                and type(_G.K7SetStealNearest) == "function"
                and type(_G.K7SetInstantSteal) == "function"
            if ready and not capturedSetNearest then
                capturedSetNearest = _G.K7SetStealNearest
                capturedSetInstant = _G.K7SetInstantSteal
            end

            -- The prompt watcher obeys this immediately, even while K7 is starting.
            _G.SNEIZZY_K7_ENABLED = wanted

            if ready and (applied ~= wanted or not wasReady) then
                -- Keep Sneizzy paused for the entire transition so the engines never overlap.
                _G.SNEIZZY_K7_OWNS_STEAL = true
                if wanted then
                    -- Instant first: K7 never passes through its normal-steal mode.
                    pcall(capturedSetInstant, true)
                    pcall(capturedSetNearest, true)
                else
                    -- Targeting first: K7 is stopped before Instant is lowered.
                    pcall(capturedSetNearest, false)
                    pcall(capturedSetInstant, false)
                    _G.SNEIZZY_K7_OWNS_STEAL = false
                end
                applied = wanted
            elseif not ready then
                -- During startup, pause Sneizzy only if K7 was requested.
                _G.SNEIZZY_K7_OWNS_STEAL = wanted and (k7Starting or k7Started)
            elseif wanted then
                _G.SNEIZZY_K7_OWNS_STEAL = true
            else
                _G.SNEIZZY_K7_OWNS_STEAL = false
            end

            wasReady = ready
            task.wait(0.1)
        end
    end)
end


-- ===== RYMOGS PUB HUB =====
local _RP, _RW = print, warn
_G.RyPrivStealWhy = "boot"
_G.RyPrivStealLog = {}
_G.RyPrivStealSay = function(msg)
    -- Fast path for an identical repeat, which is the common case: the steal
    -- tick reports the same reason on every frame for as long as nothing
    -- changes ("steal mode OFF", "no target", "cooldown"). Bumping the counter
    -- is all that is needed, so skip the tostring, the os.clock, the log walk
    -- and the debug branch. Only a message that actually changed does the
    -- full path below.
    if msg == _G.RyPrivStealWhy then
        local L0 = _G.RyPrivStealLog
        local last0 = L0[#L0]
        if last0 then last0.n = last0.n + 1 end
        return
    end
    msg = tostring(msg)
    _G.RyPrivStealWhy = msg
    local L = _G.RyPrivStealLog
    local now = os.clock()
    local last = L[#L]
    if last and last.msg == msg then
        last.n = last.n + 1
        last.t = now
    else
        L[#L + 1] = { msg = msg, t = now, t0 = now, n = 1 }
        while #L > 8 do table.remove(L, 1) end
    end
    if _G.RyPrivStealDebug then
        if now - (_G._mkLastSay or 0) >= (tonumber(_G.RyPrivStealDebugGap) or 0.5) then
            _G._mkLastSay = now
            pcall(_RP, "[steal] " .. msg)
        end
    end
end

_G.RyPrivScanProfile = function(mode)
    if mode == "fast" then
        _G.RyPrivScanMode     = "fast"
        _G.RyPrivPanelScanGap = tonumber(_G.RyPrivFastPanelGap)    or 0.12
        _G.RyPrivRepickGap    = tonumber(_G.RyPrivFastRepickGap)   or 0.10
        _G.RyPrivInRangeGap   = tonumber(_G.RyPrivFastInRangeGap)  or 0.10
        _G.RyPrivWatchdogTick = tonumber(_G.RyPrivFastWatchdogTick) or 0.15
        _G.RyPrivSyncScanGap  = tonumber(_G.RyPrivFastSyncGap)     or 0.05
        _G.RyPrivAutoTPPoll   = tonumber(_G.RyPrivFastTPPoll)      or 0.03
    else
        _G.RyPrivScanMode     = "normal"
        _G.RyPrivPanelScanGap = tonumber(_G.RyPrivNormPanelGap)    or 0.6
        _G.RyPrivRepickGap    = tonumber(_G.RyPrivNormRepickGap)   or 0.5
        _G.RyPrivInRangeGap   = tonumber(_G.RyPrivNormInRangeGap)  or 0.3
        _G.RyPrivWatchdogTick = tonumber(_G.RyPrivNormWatchdogTick) or 0.3
        _G.RyPrivSyncScanGap  = tonumber(_G.RyPrivNormSyncGap)     or 0.25
        _G.RyPrivAutoTPPoll   = tonumber(_G.RyPrivNormTPPoll)      or 0.05
    end
    if _G.RyPrivStealSay then _G.RyPrivStealSay("scan profile -> " .. tostring(_G.RyPrivScanMode)) end
end
_G.RyPrivScanProfile("fast")
task.delay(tonumber(_G.RyPrivFastWindow) or 60, function()
    if _G.RyPrivScanMode == "fast" then _G.RyPrivScanProfile("normal") end
end)
local print = function() end
local warn  = function() end
_G.RyPrivInvisAuto = false
_G.RyPrivAutoKickOnSteal = false
_G.RyPrivAutoBuy = false
if _G.RyPrivStealMode == nil then _G.RyPrivStealMode = "priority" end
-- Teleport movement mode: "normal" is the velocity flight this hub has always
-- used, "fling" is goonpriv's CFrame-tween drag. Guarded so the loader wins.
if _G.RyPrivTPMode == nil then _G.RyPrivTPMode = "normal" end
-- Animations were always suppressed before this was a setting, so the default
-- keeps that rather than changing how the hub behaves for existing users.
if _G.RyPrivDisableAnims == nil then _G.RyPrivDisableAnims = true end
-- ESP defaults. Every one is `== nil` guarded so the settings loader, which
-- runs after this, keeps whatever was saved.
if _G.RyPlayerESP       == nil then _G.RyPlayerESP       = false end
if _G.ESP_Stealer       == nil then _G.ESP_Stealer       = false end
if _G.ESP_BaseOwner     == nil then _G.ESP_BaseOwner     = false end
if _G.ESP_Brainrot      == nil then _G.ESP_Brainrot      = false end
if _G.ESP_Trap          == nil then _G.ESP_Trap          = false end
-- Turret ESP has no working backend, so the flag stays off permanently and the
-- hazard pass skips it. There is deliberately no switch for it.
_G.ESP_Turret = false
if _G.ESP_MaxDistance   == nil then _G.ESP_MaxDistance   = 700 end
if _G.ESP_BrainrotTop   == nil then _G.ESP_BrainrotTop   = 5 end
if _G.ESP_BoxSize       == nil then _G.ESP_BoxSize       = 4.5 end
if _G.ESP_BoxTransp     == nil then _G.ESP_BoxTransp     = 0.5 end
-- INSTANT STEAL: the prompt-burst engine ported from the pub method. Off by
-- default; Base Camp turns it on for you and puts it back off when camp ends.
if _G.RyPrivInstantSteal == nil then _G.RyPrivInstantSteal = false end
if _G.RyPrivAutoTP == nil then _G.RyPrivAutoTP = true end
-- How see-through every panel in the hub is. The Utility panel's Settings
-- popout drives this, and each panel reads it on its repaint tick.
if _G.RyPrivAlpha == nil then _G.RyPrivAlpha = 0.12 end
-- Anti-ragdoll recovery; the Invis panel's AUTO RECOVER row.
if _G.RyPrivAntiRagdoll == nil then _G.RyPrivAntiRagdoll = true end

-- TP safety: prefer a slightly slower, more stable route over hard misses/deaths.
if _G.RyPrivTPSafeMode == nil then _G.RyPrivTPSafeMode = true end
if _G.RyPrivTPSafeSpeed == nil then _G.RyPrivTPSafeSpeed = 300 end
if _G.RyPrivTPSafeVerticalSpeed == nil then _G.RyPrivTPSafeVerticalSpeed = 110 end
if _G.RyPrivTPReachTolerance == nil then _G.RyPrivTPReachTolerance = 4.5 end
if _G.RyPrivTPRetryCount == nil then _G.RyPrivTPRetryCount = 2 end
if _G.RyPrivTPRetryDelay == nil then _G.RyPrivTPRetryDelay = 0.08 end
if _G.RyPrivVoidRecover == nil then _G.RyPrivVoidRecover = true end

if not game:IsLoaded() then game.Loaded:Wait() end

--[[ Net env-spoof: DISABLED ----------------------------------------------------
     This used to require ReplicatedStorage.Packages.Net and then write into the
     game module's own environment:
         env.getfenv                  = <our function>
         setreadonly(env.debug, false)
         env.debug.getmemorycategory  = function() return "--" end
     re-applied 80x over 8 seconds.

     That is the loudest signal in this script, and it is self-defeating. The
     Net wrapper calls debug.getmemorycategory() to identify its caller. Legit
     game code returns a real script category; this returned the literal "--",
     which is not a valid category -- so anything validating the returned value
     against a known set sees "--" and flags immediately. Leaving env.debug
     writable via setreadonly is independently checkable (table.isfrozen).

     RyPriv doesn't need it: the grapple now resolves the UseItem
     RemoteEvent structurally and calls FireServer on the raw Instance, which
     never enters the Net wrapper.

     Set _G.RyPrivNetSpoofEnable = true to restore the old behaviour.
--------------------------------------------------------------------------- ]]
do
    local RS = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
    local _spoofOk = false
    local function _applySpoof()
        if _G.RyPrivNetSpoofEnable ~= true then return false end
        local ok = pcall(function()
            local Net = require(RS:WaitForChild("Packages"):WaitForChild("Net"))
            local og = getfenv
            if type(og) ~= "function" then return end
            for _, fname in ipairs({ "RemoteEvent", "RemoteFunction", "UnreliableRemoteEvent" }) do
                local f = rawget(Net, fname)
                if type(f) == "function" then
                    local env = og(f)
                    if type(env) == "table" then
                        env.getfenv = function() return og(f) end
                        if type(env.debug) == "table" then
                            if setreadonly then pcall(setreadonly, env.debug, false) end
                            env.debug.getmemorycategory = function() return "--" end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            _spoofOk = true
        end)
        return ok and _spoofOk
    end
    _G.RyPrivNetSpoof = _applySpoof
    _G.RyPrivNetSpoofReady = function() return _spoofOk end
    if _G.RyPrivNetSpoofEnable == true then
        _applySpoof()
        task.spawn(function()
            for _ = 1, 80 do
                if _applySpoof() then end
                task.wait(0.1)
            end
        end)
    end
end

pcall(function() if setfpscap then setfpscap(9999) end end)


task.spawn(function()
    local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")
    local LocalPlayer = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer
    if not Workspace.StreamingEnabled then return end
    local plots
    local t0 = os.clock()
    repeat plots = Workspace:FindFirstChild("Plots"); if not plots then task.wait(0.1) end
    until plots or (os.clock() - t0) > 25
    if not plots then return end
    local function plotPos(plot)
        local ok, pv = pcall(function() return plot:GetPivot().Position end)
        if ok and pv and pv.Magnitude > 1 then return pv end
        if plot.PrimaryPart then return plot.PrimaryPart.Position end
        local bp = plot:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
        return bp and bp.Position or nil
    end
    local pending = 0
    for _, plot in ipairs(plots:GetChildren()) do
        local pos = plotPos(plot)
        if pos then
            pending = pending + 1
            task.spawn(function()
                pcall(function() LocalPlayer:RequestStreamAroundAsync(pos) end)
                pending = pending - 1
            end)
        end
    end
    local sw = os.clock()
    while pending > 0 and os.clock() - sw < 10 do task.wait(0.05) end
end)

_G.RyPrivBootDelay = tonumber(_G.RyPrivBootDelay) or 6
if _G.RyPrivWaitForTools == nil then _G.RyPrivWaitForTools = true end
_G.RyPrivToolWait = tonumber(_G.RyPrivToolWait) or 35
do
    local _bootT0 = os.clock()
    local _BOOT_TOOLS = {
        "Flying Carpet", "Waverider", "Santa's Sleigh", "Witch's Broom", "Cupid's Wings",
        "Grapple Hook", "Grappling Hook", "Grapple", "Hook", "Web Slinger", "Grapple Gun", "GrappleHook",
    }
    local function _hasTool(n)
        local plr = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer
        if not plr then return false end
        local char = plr.Character
        local bp = plr:FindFirstChild("Backpack")
        local t = (char and char:FindFirstChild(n)) or (bp and bp:FindFirstChild(n))
        return t ~= nil and t:IsA("Tool")
    end
    local function _toolsReady()
        if type(_G.RyPrivCarpetTool) == "string" and _G.RyPrivCarpetTool ~= "" and _hasTool(_G.RyPrivCarpetTool) then return true end
        for _, n in ipairs(_BOOT_TOOLS) do
            if _hasTool(n) then return true end
        end
        return false
    end
    _G.RyPrivToolsReady = _toolsReady
    _G.RyPrivBootWait = function()
        local d = tonumber(_G.RyPrivBootDelay) or 8
        while os.clock() - _bootT0 < d do task.wait(0.25) end
        if _G.RyPrivWaitForTools == false then return end
        local cap = tonumber(_G.RyPrivToolWait) or 30
        local t0 = os.clock()
        while os.clock() - t0 < cap do
            local ok, ready = pcall(_toolsReady)
            if ok and ready then
                task.wait(0.35)
                return
            end
            task.wait(0.2)
        end
        warn("[Rymogs priv] tools never loaded within " .. cap .. "s, continuing anyway")
    end

    -- ── UI GATE ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    -- Panels do not need a finished world or a loaded backpack to be drawn --
    -- only the engines do. Several windows were gated on RyPrivBootWait, so
    -- they sat invisible for the whole 6s boot delay plus however long the
    -- tool wait took, which is why parts of the hub turned up seconds after
    -- the rest. All a panel actually needs is somewhere to parent itself.
    _G.RyPrivUIWait = function()
        local plr = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer
        if not plr then return end
        if plr:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui") then return end
        local t0 = os.clock()
        while not plr:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui") and os.clock() - t0 < 10 do
            task.wait(0.05)
        end
    end
end

        local raw
        pcall(function() raw = readfile("SideTP.json") end)
